title: Proof of Execution: Runtime Verification for Governed AI Agent Actions
comments: 14 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables, 1 algorithm; includes formal soundness and replay theorems with witness constructions in appendix
summary: Agent systems increasingly execute rather than advise. When an AI agent queries regulated data, invokes effectful tools, and mutates persistent state, correctness is not captured by whether a terminal output looks plausible. The operative questions are whether each step was authorized under a contract, whether the recorded history is tamper-evident, and whether the trajectory can be reconstructed deterministically. We formalize this as runtime proof of execution. An execution is a triple $x = (C, T, R)$: a contract $C$, an Execution Causal Event Stream (ECES) $T$, and a replay context $R$. A well-formedness predicate and five validator-checkable invariants form the PoE validity predicate. Five semantic guarantees describe authorization, path compliance, null effect on deny, history integrity, and replayability. We prove soundness under explicit cryptographic and deployment assumptions: any PPT adversary that produces a PoE-valid execution violating a semantic guarantee yields a signature forgery, a hash collision, or a quantified deployment-failure event. The Prime Execution Model (PEM) separates planning, enforcement, effect, and recordkeeping into distinct authority planes; a lemma reduces trace completeness to Effector-exclusive credentialing. An Execution Attestation Certificate is issued only when PoE = 1. In a single-node TypeScript prototype, PoE adds approximately 2.7 ms on a minimal flow and 4.4% overhead on concurrent batch workloads; a standard eight-event trace compresses to approximately 1.1 KB; injected Gateway-bypass and trace-mutation attacks are rejected. PoE does not replace consensus, TEEs, or zkVMs; it binds authorization, effect, history, and replay into a single runtime-checkable object so that governed execution becomes attestable under contract.
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables, 1 algorithm; includes formal soundness and replay theorems with witness constructions in appendix

AI.title_translation: 执行证明：受控AI Agent行为的运行时验证
AI.tldr: 提出一种“执行证明”（PoE）技术，通过形式化验证方法确保AI Agent在执行任务时的行为符合合同规范，且具备防篡改和可重放特性，同时保持了高效的运行性能。
AI.motivation: 随着AI Agent从单纯的建议转向实际执行任务（如查询敏感数据、调用工具和修改状态），现有的评估方式无法保证执行步骤的授权合规性、历史记录的防篡改性以及执行路径的可重构性。
AI.method: 提出“执行证明”（PoE）框架，定义了包含合同、因果事件流和重放上下文的三元组。设计了包含五个验证器可检查不变量的有效性谓词，并构建了Prime Execution Model（PEM）架构，通过分离规划、执行、效果和记录平面，实现对Agent行为的强制治理。
AI.result: PoE在TypeScript原型测试中表现出极低的开销（单节点增加约2.7ms，并发负载下增加4.4%），生成的执行证明文件体积小（8事件轨迹约1.1KB），并能有效防御网关绕过和轨迹篡改攻击。
AI.conclusion: PoE框架成功实现了AI Agent执行过程的运行时验证，通过形式化定义和密码学保证，确保了Agent行为的授权合规性、历史完整性和可重放性，且在实际测试中表现出低性能开销。
AI.translation: Agent系统越来越多地执行任务，而不仅仅是提供建议。当AI Agent查询受监管的数据、调用有效工具并改变持久状态时，其正确性不能仅通过最终输出看起来是否合理来判断。核心问题在于：每一步是否都在合同授权下进行、记录的历史是否防篡改、轨迹是否可确定性地重构。我们将此形式化为运行时“执行证明”（PoE）。执行被定义为一个三元组 x = (C, T, R)：合同 C、执行因果事件流 (ECES) T 以及重放上下文 R。格式良好谓词和五个验证器可检查的不变量构成了 PoE 有效性谓词。五个语义保证描述了授权、路径合规、拒绝时的零效果、历史完整性和可重放性。我们在明确的密码学和部署假设下证明了其稳健性：任何产生违反语义保证的 PoE 有效执行的 PPT 对手都会导致签名伪造、哈希碰撞或量化的部署失败事件。Prime 执行模型 (PEM) 将规划、强制执行、效果和记录保存分离到不同的权限平面中；引理将轨迹完整性归约为 Effector 独占的凭据。仅当 PoE = 1 时才颁发执行证明证书。在单节点 TypeScript 原型中，PoE 在最小流上增加了约 2.7 毫秒的开销，在并发批处理工作负载上增加了 4.4% 的开销；标准的八事件轨迹压缩至约 1.1 KB；注入的网关绕过和轨迹篡改攻击均被拒绝。PoE 不会取代共识、TEE 或 zkVM；它将授权、效果、历史和重放绑定到一个单一的运行时可检查对象中，从而使受控执行在合同下变得可证明。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“执行证明”（PoE）框架，旨在为AI Agent的受控执行提供运行时验证。通过将合同、因果事件流和重放上下文形式化为可验证对象，并结合Prime Execution Model（PEM）架构，该框架能够确保Agent行为的授权合规、路径合规及历史完整，同时在保持极低性能开销的情况下提供了强密码学保证。
AI.keywords: AI Agent, 执行证明, 运行时验证, 合规性, 可信执行
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入“执行证明”（PoE）框架，填补了AI Agent在受控环境执行任务时缺乏可验证性的空白。其创新之处在于将合同、因果事件流和重放上下文绑定为一个可验证的运行时对象，既保证了执行的合规性，又兼顾了性能开销。尽管该方法不替代共识机制或TEE，但它为构建可审计的AI自治系统提供了一种轻量级的解决方案。

title: How Personas Can Influence Agents to Play Split or Steal
summary: Personas are often employed to guide large language model agents, yet their effectiveness in shaping strategic behavior in social dilemma settings remains uncertain. To address this, we examined the impact of persona prompts in an iterated Split or Steal game where persona-driven agents interacted with a Virtual Human (VH) controlled by a fixed prompt. Agents were instantiated from four open models (Ministral 3:3b, phi4:14b, Gemma3:12b, and Gemma4:e4b) at two temperature settings (0.3 and 0.7) and deterministic decision with zero temperature, while the VH was powered by GPT 4.1 mini. Across 160 sessions of 15 rounds each conducted in European Portuguese, mutual Split outcomes dominated (roughly 74 percent of rounds), with exploitation occurring in fewer than 11 percent of rounds. Model choice significantly influenced behavior: phi4 and Ministral 3:3b remained consistently cooperative across temperatures, whereas Gemma3:12b and Gemma4:e4b exhibited more varied strategies and outcomes. Analyses based on Big Five personality traits indicated that Prosocial and Principled personas were most consistently cooperative, while Analytical personas were more likely to exploit the VH. Topic analysis revealed that friendship-related dialogue aligns with Split decisions, whereas money and vengeance-related content is more prevalent in Steal outcomes; sentiment labels were predominantly neutral or happy and provided limited additional explanatory value. These findings characterize the interaction between persona prompts and model differences in repeated trust games and serve as a baseline for planned virtual reality studies involving human participants interacting with an embodied VH.

AI.title_translation: 人格如何影响代理在“分裂或窃取”博弈中的行为
AI.tldr: 通过实验发现，模型类型与人格提示词（如亲社会型 vs 分析型）显著影响大语言模型在社会博弈中的合作与背叛行为。
AI.motivation: 尽管人格提示词常用于引导大语言模型代理，但其在社会困境等复杂博弈场景中塑造战略行为的有效性尚不明确，需要通过实验进行验证。
AI.method: 在迭代的Split or Steal博弈中，使用四种开源大模型作为代理，并赋予不同的人格提示词，与由GPT-4.1 mini驱动的虚拟人类（VH）进行160场、每场15轮的博弈。通过分析模型选择、温度设置、大五人格特征及对话主题对博弈结果（Split或Steal）的影响进行评估。
AI.result: 实验发现合作占据主导地位（约74%），剥削行为少于11%。phi4和Ministral模型表现出更稳定的合作倾向，而Gemma模型策略波动较大。对话内容分析显示，友谊相关话题与合作决策相关，而金钱与复仇倾向于导致背叛。
AI.conclusion: 人格提示词对代理的行为有显著影响，其中亲社会和原则性人格倾向于合作，而分析型人格更容易采取剥削策略。此外，模型本身的基础能力差异（如phi4与Gemma系列）对策略稳定性具有决定性作用。
AI.translation: 人格通常被用来引导大语言模型代理，然而它们在塑造社会困境设置中的战略行为方面的有效性仍然不确定。为了解决这个问题，我们检查了在迭代的“分裂或窃取”（Split or Steal）游戏中人格提示词的影响，其中人格驱动的代理与由固定提示词控制的虚拟人类（VH）进行交互。代理是从四个开源模型（Ministral 3:3b、phi4:14b、Gemma3:12b和Gemma4:e4b）中实例化的，设置了两种温度（0.3和0.7）以及零温度下的确定性决策，而VH由GPT 4.1 mini驱动。在以欧洲葡萄牙语进行的160场每场15轮的会话中，相互“分裂”（Split）的结果占主导地位（约占轮次的74%），而剥削发生在不到11%的轮次中。模型选择显著影响了行为：phi4和Ministral 3:3b在不同温度下保持了一致的合作，而Gemma3:12b和Gemma4:e4b表现出更多样化的策略和结果。基于大五人格特质的分析表明，亲社会和原则性人格最始终如一地合作，而分析型人格更有可能剥削VH。主题分析显示，与友谊相关的对话与“分裂”决定一致，而金钱和与复仇相关的内容在“窃取”（Steal）结果中更为普遍；情感标签主要是中性或快乐的，提供的额外解释价值有限。这些发现描述了人格提示词与模型差异在重复信任博弈中交互的特征，并为计划中涉及人类参与者与体现化VH交互的虚拟现实研究提供了基准。
AI.summary: 本文研究了人格提示词对大语言模型代理在Split or Steal博弈中战略决策的影响。通过对不同模型和人格设置的实验分析，发现模型架构差异与人格特征共同决定了代理的合作水平，并为后续的人机交互研究建立了基准。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 人格提示词, Split or Steal博弈, 社会困境, 人机交互
AI.comments: 该研究通过系统性的实验，揭示了LLM代理的底层模型架构与预设人格提示词如何共同影响其在社会困境（Split or Steal）中的合作与背叛行为。其创新之处在于量化了人格特征（如大五人格）对策略行为的预测能力，并指出了不同模型在处理复杂社会博弈时的鲁棒性差异，为未来人机交互研究提供了宝贵的基准参考。

title: Benchmarking KV-Cache Optimizations across Task Quality and System Performance for Long-Context Serving
summary: Large language model serving is increasingly limited by KV-cache growth under long-context workloads, yet existing KV-cache compression techniques are difficult to compare because they were evaluated on different models, tasks, budgets, and serving stacks. This paper presents a workload-aware benchmark of representative KV-cache optimization mechanisms spanning quantization, pruning, and merging, including KIVI, TurboQuant, SnapKV, and CaM, evaluated on LongBench-style multi-document QA, single-document QA, few-shot learning, and summarization workloads using Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3. The benchmark measures task quality, mean output throughput, mean time-to-first-token, and realized compression ratio across context-length buckets. The results show that the compression ratio alone is a poor predictor of end-to-end performance. KIVI4 provides the most stable quality across models, SnapKV delivers the strongest long-context throughput, and CaM yields large gains on selected QA workloads but exhibits substantial workload sensitivity in both quality and realized compression ratio. These findings motivate workload-aware selection of KV-cache mechanisms rather than one-size-fits-all compression and provide deployment guidance for long-context serving systems.

AI.title_translation: 长上下文推理中KV缓存优化方案的任务质量与系统性能基准测试
AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个长上下文KV缓存优化技术的基准测试，揭示了压缩率并非性能的唯一指标，并强调应根据具体任务需求选择合适的优化机制。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型处理长上下文的需求增加，KV缓存增长成为主要瓶颈。然而，现有的各类KV缓存压缩技术缺乏统一的评估标准，导致难以在不同模型、任务和系统配置下进行公平的性能对比。
AI.method: 构建了一个工作负载感知的基准测试框架，对KIVI、TurboQuant、SnapKV和CaM等代表性KV缓存优化机制进行了系统评估。测试涵盖了多文档问答、单文档问答、少样本学习和摘要任务，并在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3模型上，对比了任务质量、吞吐量、首字延迟和实际压缩比等多项指标。
AI.result: 研究发现，压缩比不能准确预测端到端性能。实验结果显示，KIVI4在模型间表现出最稳定的质量，SnapKV在长上下文吞吐量上表现最佳，而CaM虽在特定问答任务中表现出色，但对工作负载高度敏感。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，不存在通用的KV缓存压缩方案，应根据具体工作负载的特性（如任务类型、上下文长度）来选择最合适的优化策略，以平衡质量与性能。
AI.translation: 大语言模型服务日益受到长上下文工作负载下KV缓存增长的限制，然而现有的KV缓存压缩技术由于在不同的模型、任务、预算和系统栈上进行评估，因此难以相互比较。本文提出了一个工作负载感知的基准测试，涵盖了量化、剪枝和合并等代表性KV缓存优化机制，包括KIVI、TurboQuant、SnapKV和CaM。该基准测试在Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3模型上，针对LongBench风格的多文档问答、单文档问答、少样本学习和摘要工作负载进行了评估。基准测试测量了跨上下文长度区间的任务质量、平均输出吞吐量、平均首字延迟和实际压缩比。结果表明，仅凭压缩比无法很好地预测端到端性能。KIVI4在不同模型间提供了最稳定的质量，SnapKV提供了最强的长上下文吞吐量，而CaM在选定的问答工作负载上收益显著，但在质量和实际压缩比方面表现出明显的工作负载敏感性。这些发现促使人们在选择KV缓存机制时应考虑工作负载，而非采用“一刀切”的压缩方式，并为长上下文服务系统的部署提供了指导。
AI.summary: 本文针对长上下文大模型推理中的KV缓存优化问题，开发了一个综合基准测试框架。通过对比KIVI、TurboQuant、SnapKV和CaM等多种技术，评估了它们在不同任务和模型下的表现。研究揭示了任务质量与系统性能之间的复杂权衡，强调了基于工作负载选择优化策略的必要性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, KV缓存优化, 长文本推理, 基准测试, 系统性能
AI.comments: 该论文填补了长文本推理中KV缓存优化技术缺乏统一评估标准的空白。其创新之处在于构建了一个综合性的基准测试框架，强调了任务质量与系统性能之间的权衡，指出单一压缩率指标的局限性，为实际部署提供了极具参考价值的工作负载感知建议。

title: Performance Optimization and Comparative Analysis of Generative AI Models on Advanced Accelerators
summary: Generative AI models, such as Large Language Models (LLMs) and diffusion models, have demonstrated impressive performance across a wide range of tasks. Despite these advances, deployment remains challenging due to substantial memory requirements, extended inference latency, significant computational demands, and high hardware costs. These issues are further complicated when evaluating models across heterogeneous platforms, where differences in numerical formats, memory bandwidths, and software stacks interact with model architecture and workload characteristics in complex ways. To address these challenges, we present a systematic study focused on performance optimization and comparative analysis of several Generative AI models across diverse downstream tasks. This work introduces a novel mixed-precision post-training quantization evaluation, examines fine-tuning strategies, and assesses performance across modern high-performance computing (HPC) systems and advanced accelerators.

title: Catalyst Papers in Artificial Intelligence Research: A Landscape on ICLR from 2017 to 2025
summary: A small number of methodological contributions, including word2vec, the Transformer, large-scale pre-training, and reinforcement learning from human feedback, have reshaped NLP and AI research over the past decade. OpenReview now makes numeric reviewer scores and accept/reject decisions public for every ICLR submission. Whether such review signals identify trajectory-changing papers at submission time, however, remains untested at corpus scale. We answer this question on $36{,}113$ papers from ICLR 2017--2025, identifying \emph{catalysts}: papers whose descendants measurably redirect future research. We compare four disruptiveness measures (the Consolidation/Destabilization (CD) index, node2vec, the direction-aware Embedding Disruptiveness Measure (EDM), and an LLM-based semantic rater) and define a five-type operational catalyst taxonomy (topic initiator, topic bridge, within-topic redirector, simultaneous, and recognition-misaligned). EDM leads at identifying highly cited ICLR papers (AUC $0.83$ vs.\ $0.60$ for CD, $0.49$ for node2vec, and $0.42$ for the LLM rater). Topic initiators precede a $7.55{\times}$ topic-share growth and topic bridges precede an $11.52{\times}$ growth in cross-topic citation flow versus year-matched controls. We found that the peer review scores are essentially orthogonal to future disruptiveness ($|ρ|{\leq}0.005$; accepted and rejected papers have indistinguishable mean EDM, $p{=}0.11$).

AI.title_translation: 人工智能研究中的催化剂论文：2017年至2025年ICLR景观分析
AI.tldr: 对ICLR历年论文的大规模分析显示，同行评审分数无法预测论文的长期学术影响力和颠覆性，评审机制与未来科研突破方向存在显著脱节。
AI.motivation: 旨在探究ICLR会议公开的同行评审分数是否能够有效识别在提交时即具有“催化剂”潜质、能够重塑未来研究轨迹的颠覆性论文。
AI.method: 研究分析了2017年至2025年间ICLR会议的36,113篇论文，对比了四种颠覆性度量指标（CD指数、node2vec、EDM和LLM语义评估），构建了五种类型的“催化剂”论文分类法，并定量评估了评审分数与未来引用轨迹的相关性。
AI.result: EDM在识别高被引论文方面表现最优（AUC 0.83）；“催化剂”论文（如主题发起者和桥梁）显著带动了后续研究领域的增长；但同行评审分数与论文的未来颠覆性表现几乎完全无关（相关系数绝对值≤0.005）。
AI.conclusion: ICLR的同行评审分数无法有效预测论文的长期学术影响力或颠覆性，顶级会议的决策机制可能更偏向于增量式研究而非真正的科研催化剂。
AI.translation: 少数方法论上的贡献（如word2vec、Transformer、大规模预训练以及人类反馈强化学习）在过去十年中重塑了NLP和人工智能研究。OpenReview现在公开了每一篇ICLR投稿的数值评审分数及录用/拒稿决定。然而，这些评审信号是否能在投稿时识别出改变研究轨迹的论文，在大规模语料库上仍未得到验证。我们通过分析2017年至2025年ICLR的36,113篇论文回答了这一问题，并识别出了“催化剂”：即那些后继研究能明显改变研究方向的论文。我们对比了四种颠覆性度量指标（CD指数、node2vec、方向感知嵌入颠覆性度量（EDM）以及基于LLM的语义评估器），并定义了五种类型的催化剂分类法（主题发起者、主题桥梁、主题内重定向者、同步者和识别错位者）。EDM在识别高被引ICLR论文方面处于领先地位（AUC为0.83，而CD为0.60，node2vec为0.49，LLM评估器为0.42）。与年份匹配的对照组相比，主题发起者预示着主题份额增长7.55倍，主题桥梁预示着跨主题引用流增长11.52倍。我们发现同行评审分数与未来的颠覆性本质上是正交的（|ρ|≤0.005；录用和拒稿论文的平均EDM无明显差异，p=0.11）。
AI.summary: 本文通过对2017-2025年ICLR的36,113篇论文进行大规模科学计量分析，探讨了同行评审分数与论文颠覆性影响之间的关系。研究发现，尽管可以利用EDM等指标识别具有重塑研究方向能力的“催化剂”论文，但现有的同行评审分数与论文的未来颠覆性表现并无相关性。
AI.keywords: 人工智能, 科学计量学, 同行评审, 颠覆性度量, ICLR
AI.comments: 该研究通过大规模量化分析揭示了同行评审分数与论文长期学术影响力（颠覆性）之间的脱节，这一发现对当前的学术评价体系具有重要的警示作用。其创新之处在于定义了“催化剂”论文分类法，并对比了多种颠覆性度量指标，为科学计量学研究提供了新视角。局限性在于仅局限于ICLR单一会议，结果能否推广至其他领域仍需进一步验证。

title: Ethics and EU AI Act in Cases of Work Disability Risk and Alzheimer's Disease Risk Prediction
comments: Preprint version (2025-09) of paper presented at The 2026 International Conference of Breakthroughs in AI (BAI'26)
summary: Improvements in AI technologies have made it feasible to develop new types of medical AI tools. However, these tools raise new kinds of questions, especially in relation to the ethics and AI Act compliance. We analyzed two cases of AI tools developed to predict medical risks, the risk of work disability (case A) and the risk of getting Alzheimer's disease (case B). We observed both cases using the ethical AI and the EU AI Act as frameworks, noted that they classify as high-risk systems, and that bringing them from the research environment to production would require a lot of work and compliance due to the related regulation.

title: AI tools in Arab University English classrooms: Looking back and forward
summary: This paper aims to synthesize empirical research on AI tools used to support English as a second/foreign language (EL2) learners in Arab University classrooms (AUCs) between Jan 1st 2023 and Aug 31st 2025. We utilized 3 large datasets, namely Google Scholar, Web of Science, and Scopus as the data sources. Using PRISMA-guided searches across these well-known databases, we included only published articles. The search process results in 184 studies, but only 11 studies met the inclusion criteria. Findings unveil that EL2 learners have positive attitudes towards AI for drafting, revision, and practice. Empirical gains were most consistent for surface-level outcomes improvements in higher-order writing quality and speaking proficiency was mixed and often contingent on teacher mediation. The paper concludes by proposing a research agenda and practical guidelines for Arab universities seeking evidence-based AI integration in EL2 instruction. It also recommends scaffolded integration, teacher training, reflective tasks to reduce over-reliance on AI tools.

title: The Jagged Global Economy: Frontier AI Unevenly Exposes National Economies
summary: Frontier AI's labor-market effects matter to workers, firms, and policymakers, but current evidence generally comes from a handful of high-income economies. The capabilities of frontier AI are jagged across work tasks and national economies diverge in how they allocate human labor. We introduce a national AI exposure metric that combines occupation-level exposure scores and international employment data for 141 countries. We find that high income countries are substantially more exposed than low income countries and that Europe and Central Asia are 50 percent more exposed than Sub-Saharan Africa. We also find a gender gap: women are more exposed than men in 91 percent of countries, driven by their concentration in white-collar and sales occupations. The exceptions are countries where women's employment remains concentrated in agriculture and household enterprises. We validate our national AI exposure estimates by showing they predict national AI adoption statistics published by Anthropic, Microsoft, and OpenAI. Beyond direct exposure, we identify a new mechanism for indirect exposure due to cross-country income dependencies. Some nations such as Tajikistan depend heavily on foreign workers remitting money back to their home countries: Tajikistan's direct exposure to frontier AI is below-average but because 37 percent of Tajikistan GDP is Russian remittance and Russia is very exposed, Tajikistan's remittance-accounted exposure becomes above-average. Our research shows that national variation in exposure is large enough that policy responses calibrated to U.S. or European labor markets will not generalize.

title: CCBENCH: Assessing LLM Cultural Competence via Implicitly Signaled Norms using Health Queries
summary: To interact with users fairly and without stereotyping, AI models must display cultural competency, i.e., the ability to infer and adapt to a user's implicitly signaled cultural values, rather than relying on static demographic traits. We introduce CCBENCH, a framework for evaluating cultural competency in large language models (LLMs), treating culture as a continuum of norm adherence states rather than as a binary state of cultural belongingness. As a case study on health, we create CCBENCH-Health, which includes 60 theoretically grounded personas exhibiting varied norm-adherence states across six cultures, each engaging in 18 realistic dialogues. Each persona is evaluated on 52 authentic healthcare questions drawn from real user forums, yielding 3,120 unique interactions. Benchmarking five leading models reveals that even the best achieve culturally appropriate responses only 20-30% of the time. When explicitly prompted to focus on culturally relevant cues from the conversational history (CoT), performance improves modestly by 3-5% on average. We find that models perform best when personas avoid cultural norms rather than follow them, revealing a persistent asymmetry, suggesting a preference in the models to align with built-in biases than adapt to cultural cues. This is especially observed in the Afghan context (Avg: 8.8%), where cultural cues rarely yield appropriate health advice. Finally, we find that models sometimes adapt more readily to implicit, cultural conversational styles than to explicitly stated cultural practices, though this varies across cultures.

title: A Guiding Framework for K-12 Teachers in Creating AI-powered Learning Technologies through Vibe Coding
summary: Large language models generate code from natural language prompts, enabling "vibe coding," which allows non-programmers to develop computational solutions. Vibe coding for teachers amplifies the value of teachers-as-designers, improving technology integration while fostering AI literacy. However, structured guidance on supporting this process is lacking. We propose GAIDE (A Guiding Framework for AI-Integrated Design for Educators), a framework that supports K-12 teachers in creating AI-powered learning technologies through vibe coding. The initial framework, built on Design Thinking and INTERACT, was validated through a CORDTRA interaction analysis of three teachers and four faculty mentors in an eight-week workshop to derive the final framework. Additionally, the qualitative analysis of pre- and post-interviews found an enhancement of teachers' AI literacy. Findings highlight the potential of learning-by-creating for professional development.

AI.title_translation: 通过Vibe Coding辅助K-12教师创建AI教学技术的指导框架
AI.tldr: GAIDE框架利用自然语言编程（vibe coding）赋能K-12教师，使其能自主开发AI教学工具，并有效提升了教师的AI素养。
AI.motivation: 尽管大语言模型使得非专业人士通过自然语言提示编写代码（vibe coding）成为可能，这有助于教师作为设计者开发技术，但目前缺乏结构化的框架来支持教师进行此类AI集成设计。
AI.method: 基于设计思维（Design Thinking）和INTERACT模型构建GAIDE框架，并通过为期八周的研讨会，采用CORDTRA交互分析法对三名教师和四名导师的实践过程进行验证。
AI.result: 研究最终确定了GAIDE框架，并证实该框架能有效支持教师开发AI教学工具，同时 qualitative 分析表明教师的AI素养在参与后得到了显著提升。
AI.conclusion: GAIDE框架能够有效支持K-12教师利用自然语言编程（vibe coding）开发AI教学技术，并能显著增强教师的AI素养，验证了“在创造中学习”模式在教师专业发展中的价值。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型能够根据自然语言提示生成代码，从而实现“vibe coding”，使非程序员能够开发计算解决方案。教师进行vibe coding放大了“教师作为设计者”的价值，改善了技术整合并培养了AI素养。然而，目前缺乏支持这一过程的结构化指导。我们提出了GAIDE（教师AI集成设计指导框架），这是一个支持K-12教师通过vibe coding创建AI教学技术的框架。该初步框架建立在设计思维和INTERACT的基础上，通过对三名教师和四名教员导师在为期八周的研讨会中的CORDTRA交互分析进行了验证，从而导出了最终框架。此外，对访谈前后的定性分析发现，教师的AI素养得到了增强。研究结果强调了“在创造中学习”对于专业发展的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了GAIDE框架，旨在通过“vibe coding”技术支持K-12教师自主开发AI教学工具。该研究通过八周的研讨会验证了框架的有效性，并证明这种“在创造中学习”的方式能显著提升教师的AI素养与技术集成能力。
AI.keywords: vibe coding, AI赋能教学, K-12教师, 设计思维, AI素养
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入“vibe coding”概念，为非编程背景的K-12教师开发AI教学工具提供了实操路径。其创新点在于将设计思维与交互分析方法结合，为教师赋能，不仅解决了技术门槛问题，还促进了教师的AI素养提升，是教师专业发展的有力补充。

title: Position: Preventing AI-Generated CSAM Necessitates New Approaches to AI Safety
comments: Accepted (spotlight) in ICML 2026, Position Paper Track. The first two authors contributed equally and may list their names interchangeably
summary: Modern artificial intelligence (AI) systems present profound new risks to child safety. AI is increasingly being misused to create AI-generated child sexual abuse material, facilitate child sexual exploitation, and reduce barriers to harm. In this paper, we argue that protecting children from AI-facilitated sexual abuse requires new approaches to AI safety. Existing safety techniques assume data accessibility, transparency, and evaluation practices that are incompatible with the ethical and legal constraints surrounding child sexual abuse material. We examine how these constraints create new technical challenges, such as limitations on dataset auditing, red teaming, and fine-tuning prevention. In turn, we outline *15 open problems* in online child sexual exploitation and abuse across the AI development lifecycle, from dataset curation and model design to deployment and long-term maintenance. We propose targeted recommendations for researchers, developers, and policymakers to bridge the gap between theoretical AI safety and the realities of child protection. Our work aims to reframe preventing AI-facilitated child sexual abuse as a central, safety-critical dimension for AI research, motivating work that translates responsible AI principles into concrete safeguards against the exploitation of children.

title: Life Cycle Assessment of Pre-training the Lucie 7B Open-Source Large Language Model on the Jean Zay Supercomputer
comments: 12 pages, 2 tables, 1 figure. OpenLLM-France Environmental Report v1, January 2026. CC BY-SA 4.0
summary: The environmental impact of training large language models (LLMs) is increasingly scrutinised, yet most published estimates focus on operational energy and disclose little about manufacturing (embodied) emissions, water consumption, or the underlying highperformance computing (HPC) infrastructure. We present a life cycle assessment (LCA) of the pre-training of Lucie 7B, an open-source multilingual Foundation Model developed by the OpenLLM-France consortium and trained on the NVIDIA H100 partition of the Jean Zay supercomputer operated by IDRIS (CNRS). The assessment is framed by the AFNOR SPEC 2314 "Frugal AI" reference and applies the Labos 1point5 methodology for greenhouse gas(GHG) accounting in computing. The study scope extends from data preparation to model validation, and integrates the full life cycle of the hardware infrastructure: manufacturing (including raw-material extraction), use (compute, temporary storage, system administration, cooling), and end-of-life. We report (i) an annual footprint of 417.5 tCO2eq for the Jean Zay H100 partition, split almost equally between manufacturing and operation; (ii) an effective intensity of 36.7 gCO2eq per H100 GPU-hour; (iii) a total training footprint of 21 tCO2eq for Lucie 7B (574 564 H100 GPU-hours), inclusive of amortised hardware manufacturing; (iv) on-site water consumption of approximately 76m3 for the training campaign and an annual Water Usage Effectiveness (WUE) of 0.07 L/kWh for IDRIS; (v) a heat-reuse factor (ERF) of 0.37 thanks to waste-heat recovery into the urban heating network. The study contributes one of the few publicly documented LCAs of an LLM training campaign that explicitly couples operational data with embodied emissions decomposed by subsystem (compute, storage, power chain, cooling), and discusses the implications for the design of frugal-by-construction AI systems in Europe.
comment: 12 pages, 2 tables, 1 figure. OpenLLM-France Environmental Report v1, January 2026. CC BY-SA 4.0

AI.title_translation: Lucie 7B开源大语言模型在Jean Zay超级计算机上预训练的生命周期评估
AI.tldr: 本研究对Lucie 7B模型训练进行了全面的生命周期评估，涵盖了从硬件制造到运营的碳排放和水资源消耗，揭示了高性能计算基础设施在AI可持续性设计中的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 现有的大多数大型语言模型（LLM）训练环境影响评估仅关注运营能源，缺乏对硬件制造（隐含排放）、水资源消耗以及高性能计算基础设施整体生命周期的透明度。
AI.method: 遵循 AFNOR SPEC 2314 “节俭AI”标准，采用 Labos 1point5 方法论，对数据准备到模型验证的全过程进行生命周期评估（LCA），并详细计算了硬件制造、运行、冷却及废热回收等环节的碳排放和水消耗。
AI.result: Lucie 7B训练的总碳足迹为21吨二氧化碳当量（包含摊销后的硬件制造），训练期间现场水消耗约为76立方米，并实现了0.37的热再利用系数。此外，评估得出每GPU小时的有效排放强度为36.7克二氧化碳当量。
AI.conclusion: Lucie 7B的训练过程展示了通过高效基础设施和余热回收可以显著优化AI模型训练的环境足迹，强调了在AI系统设计中采用“节俭AI”原则的必要性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）训练的环境影响正受到越来越多的审查，但大多数已发表的估计主要集中在运营能源上，很少披露制造（隐含）排放、水消耗或底层高性能计算（HPC）基础设施的相关信息。我们对Lucie 7B的预训练进行了生命周期评估（LCA），这是一款由OpenLLM-France联盟开发的多语言基础模型，在IDRIS（CNRS）运营的Jean Zay超级计算机的NVIDIA H100分区上进行训练。该评估以AFNOR SPEC 2314“节俭AI”标准为框架，并应用了Labos 1point5方法进行计算中的温室气体（GHG）核算。研究范围从数据准备延伸到模型验证，并整合了硬件基础设施的完整生命周期：制造（包括原材料提取）、使用（计算、临时存储、系统管理、冷却）和报废。我们报告了：（i）Jean Zay H100分区每年的足迹为417.5吨二氧化碳当量，制造和运营几乎各占一半；（ii）每H100 GPU小时的有效强度为36.7克二氧化碳当量；（iii）Lucie 7B的总训练足迹为21吨二氧化碳当量（574,564个H100 GPU小时），包括摊销的硬件制造；（iv）训练期间现场水消耗约为76立方米，IDRIS的年度水使用效率（WUE）为0.07升/千瓦时；（v）得益于城市供热网络对废热的回收，热再利用系数（ERF）为0.37。该研究贡献了少数公开记录的LLM训练活动LCA之一，它明确地将运营数据与按子系统（计算、存储、电力链、冷却）分解的隐含排放相结合，并讨论了其对欧洲“节俭构建”AI系统设计的影响。
AI.summary: 本研究对OpenLLM-France开发的Lucie 7B模型进行了全面的生命周期评估（LCA）。通过结合AFNOR SPEC 2314标准，该研究量化了从硬件制造到运营的全方位环境影响，包括碳排放、水消耗和废热回收效率，为构建更环保、可持续的AI系统提供了实证数据和方法参考。
AI.keywords: 生命周期评估 (LCA), 大型语言模型 (LLM), 碳足迹, 高性能计算 (HPC), 节俭AI
AI.comments: 该研究在AI可持续性领域具有重要意义，因为它不仅关注运营能源，还详细纳入了硬件制造（隐含碳排放）和水资源消耗，为量化大型语言模型训练的真实环境影响提供了透明的基准。该研究的局限性在于其结果高度依赖于Jean Zay超级计算机的具体基础设施配置，在不同地理位置或硬件环境下可能难以直接推广。

title: Automated Recommendation of Programming Learning Content Using Pattern-based Knowledge Components
comments: Paper accepted to the 10th Educational Data Mining in Computer Science Education (CSEDM) Workshop in Seoul, Korea
summary: Introductory programming instruction relies on hands-on practice and short learning activities to support mastery of foundational concepts. Although many such learning resources exist, organizing and linking these items in instructionally meaningful ways is challenging without time-intensive expert curation. This study investigates the use of pattern-based Knowledge Components (KCs) to automatically identify code-based learning resources targeting similar concepts. In our approach, pattern-based KCs are extracted from each code sample, and related activities are identified by measuring similarity between the KC sets associated with each activity. By leveraging alignment at the level of semantically important programming patterns, this method supports contextually appropriate and pedagogically useful recommendations. We evaluate our approach on an expert-organized corpus of introductory Python materials in which instructors grouped items into bundles based on conceptual similarity. Results show that our pattern-based KC approach retrieves resources that align with this expert organization, and outperformed representative KC- and embedding-based baselines across standard ranking evaluations. Overall, the framework supports targeted, concept-oriented guidance for programming learners and can help instructors organize, bundle, and recommend instructional content at scale.
comment: Paper accepted to the 10th Educational Data Mining in Computer Science Education (CSEDM) Workshop in Seoul, Korea

AI.title_translation: 使用基于模式的知识组件自动推荐编程学习内容
AI.tldr: 提出了一种利用编程模式语义匹配自动组织与推荐编程学习资源的方法，在保持教学相关性的同时，效果优于现有的基准模型。
AI.motivation: 入门编程教学依赖于大量的练习和学习活动，但人工组织和链接这些资源既耗时又困难，缺乏有效的自动化手段来根据教学概念对资源进行分类和推荐。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于模式的知识组件（KC）提取方法，通过识别代码中的语义编程模式，并计算不同学习活动之间KC集合的相似度，从而实现编程学习资源的自动化匹配与推荐。
AI.result: 在Python入门课程语料库上的实验表明，该方法在资源检索上与专家组织的分类高度一致，且在标准排名评估中表现优于代表性的基于KC和嵌入的基准模型。
AI.conclusion: 基于模式的知识组件提供了一种有效的自动化方法，能够根据教学概念对编程学习资源进行组织与推荐，其性能优于传统的基于嵌入和现有知识组件的方法。
AI.translation: 入门编程教学依赖于动手实践和简短的学习活动，以支持对基础概念的掌握。尽管存在许多此类学习资源，但若没有耗时的人工策划，以具有教学意义的方式组织和链接这些项目是一项挑战。本研究调查了使用基于模式的知识组件（KC）来自动识别针对相似概念的基于代码的学习资源。在我们的方法中，从每个代码样本中提取基于模式的KC，并通过测量与每个活动相关的KC集合之间的相似度来识别相关的活动。通过在语义上重要的编程模式层面上进行对齐，该方法支持上下文适当且具有教学意义的推荐。我们在一个由专家组织的Python入门材料语料库上评估了我们的方法，其中讲师根据概念相似性将项目分组为捆绑包。结果表明，我们的基于模式的KC方法检索到的资源与这种专家组织相一致，并且在标准排名评估中优于具有代表性的基于KC和基于嵌入的基准。总的来说，该框架支持针对编程学习者的概念导向指导，并可以帮助讲师大规模地组织、捆绑和推荐教学内容。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种利用基于模式的知识组件（KC）自动推荐编程学习内容的方法。通过从代码样本中提取语义编程模式，并利用这些模式计算活动间的相似度，该系统能够实现上下文相关且具有教学价值的资源推荐，有效减轻了教师手动组织教学内容的负担。
AI.keywords: 编程教育, 推荐系统, 知识组件, 模式识别, 自动化教学内容组织
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入“基于模式的知识组件（KC）”来解决编程教育资源自动化组织的难题。其创新点在于从代码中提取语义化的编程模式作为匹配基础，而非简单的文本特征或通用嵌入，这在教育场景下具有更高的可解释性和针对性。局限性在于其有效性主要在Python入门课程中验证，对于更复杂或多语言的编程环境，其泛化能力尚需进一步研究。

title: CANONIC: Governance Is Compilation
comments: 28 pages, 4 figures. Pre-registered cross-provider evaluation harness and per-regime results at github.com/canonic-canonic/canonic-pub. Construction claims resolve to commands run at the evidence-window-close ref (see Appendix C)
summary: We present CANONIC: governed intelligence that compiles digital artifacts into an evidence ledger at scale. Large language models generate prose faster than anyone can check it, the failure Oxford Languages named 'slop', its 2025 Word of the Year. CANONIC governs whether content may enter a corpus the way a compiler decides whether a program is well-formed: mechanically, by a grammar, at the boundary of admission. Governance reduces to three axioms (Triad, Inheritance, Introspection) that map one-to-one onto compiler theory's syntax, scope-resolution, and type-system layers, and admission is a decidable, linear-time check. We then ask, with a pre-registered cross-provider benchmark across four regimes, whether structural admission keeps slop out. It does not: no prose-reading gate reliably separates reliable from unreliable content. Slop is not a property an algorithm computes. It is a verdict of domain expertise. So a governance layer does not decide slop; it keeps the record auditable -- every claim anchored to a definition, a commit, and an evidence window, reproducible and checkable end to end.
comment: 28 pages, 4 figures. Pre-registered cross-provider evaluation harness and per-regime results at github.com/canonic-canonic/canonic-pub. Construction claims resolve to commands run at the evidence-window-close ref (see Appendix C)

AI.title_translation: CANONIC：治理即编译
AI.tldr: CANONIC通过编译器原理将内容治理转化为可审计的证据账本，虽然无法自动过滤“slop”，但能确保所有内容 claims 的可追溯性和透明度。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型生成内容的速度过快，导致大量低质量内容（“slop”）充斥，现有的自动化过滤手段难以有效区分可靠与不可靠内容。
AI.method: 提出了CANONIC架构，通过三条公理（Triad、Inheritance、Introspection）映射编译器理论的语法、作用域解析和类型系统，对内容进行线性时间的准入检查。
AI.result: 实验表明，没有任何自动化的语义阅读机制能够可靠地过滤“slop”，因为“slop”本质上是领域专家的主观结论，而非算法可计算的属性。
AI.conclusion: 治理层无法自动区分高质量内容与“slop”，但可以通过将内容编译为可审计的证据账本来实现内容的透明度与可追溯性。
AI.translation: 我们提出了CANONIC：一种治理智能，它能将数字制品大规模地编译为证据账本。大型语言模型生成散文的速度超过了人类的审核速度，牛津语言将其描述为“slop”（2025年度词汇）。CANONIC像编译器判断程序是否格式良好一样，通过语法在准入边界机械地治理内容是否可以进入语料库。治理被简化为三个公理（Triad、Inheritance、Introspection），它们与编译器理论中的语法、作用域解析和类型系统层一一对应，且准入检查是可判定的线性时间过程。随后，我们通过四个方案的预注册跨提供商基准测试，探讨结构化准入是否能阻挡“slop”。结果显示：不能，没有任何阅读散文的机制能可靠地将可靠内容与不可靠内容分开。“slop”不是一种算法可计算的属性，而是领域专家的结论。因此，治理层并不决定什么是“slop”，而是保持记录的可审计性——每一项声明都锚定在定义、提交记录和证据窗口中，实现端到端的复现与校验。
AI.summary: CANONIC是一种将编译原理应用于内容治理的框架。它通过将内容准入过程类比为程序编译，建立了一个证据账本，旨在确保所有内容 Claims 均可追溯、可验证且透明，从而解决大规模生成内容带来的质量挑战。
AI.keywords: 治理, 编译器理论, 生成式AI, 可审计性, 证据账本
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一个独特的视角，将数字内容治理与编译器原理相结合，强调了“治理即编译”的概念。其核心洞察在于承认自动化系统无法完美区分“slop”（低质量内容），因此将目标从“自动过滤”转向“可审计性”和“可追溯性”，这在当前大规模生成式AI内容泛滥的背景下具有很高的现实意义。

title: The GenAI Skill Bypass: Mapping Divergent Pathways of University Students and Staff AI Literacy
summary: Higher education institutions are increasingly expected to ensure that both students and staff develop Generative AI (GenAI) literacies. In response, they are introducing professional development programs and embedding GenAI skills within student curricula. However, current educational frameworks typically assume a linear progression of GenAI literacy, implying that foundational technical understanding must precede creative application. This paper challenges such an assumption through a psychometric analysis of a taxonomy-based self-assessment instrument (n = 158). We applied Rasch measurement theory and Guttman ordering to map the latent perceived order of difficulty of GenAI skills across students, academics, and professional staff. Results reveal a fundamental divergence in perceived competence profiles: while academics follow a more traditional linear path, students exhibit an "inverted" profile, frequently mastering high-level creation tasks before acquiring foundational conceptual understanding. Furthermore, the correlation of skill difficulty between students and academics was weak (r = 0.188). We argue that this "skill bypass" creates a fragile sense of fluency, where high self-efficacy in prompting masks low literacy in AI mechanics. These findings challenge the "one-size-fits-all" curricula and provide the empirical basis for diagnostic-driven, modular interventions that foster genuine human-AI synergy.

AI.title_translation: 生成式AI的“技能绕过”：绘制大学生与教职员工AI素养的不同路径
AI.tldr: 研究发现学生在学习AI时常跳过基础概念直接进行高阶创作，这种“技能绕过”现象挑战了传统的线性教育假设，建议采用模块化的诊断式教学。
AI.motivation: 当前高等教育普遍假设GenAI素养遵循“基础技术理解先于创意应用”的线性路径，作者质疑这一假设，旨在探讨不同群体真实的AI素养发展路径。
AI.method: 采用心理测量分析法，使用基于分类学的自我评估工具（n=158），应用Rasch测量理论和Guttman排序来映射学生、学者和专业人员对GenAI技能感知难度及顺序的差异。
AI.result: 研究发现学生与学者在能力配置上存在显著分歧：学者遵循传统线性路径，而学生呈现“倒置”配置，即在掌握基础概念前先行掌握了高水平创作任务；且两者的技能难度相关性极弱（r=0.188），存在“技能绕过”现象。
AI.conclusion: 教育机构应摒弃“一刀切”的线性教学框架，转而采用基于诊断的模块化干预措施，以解决学生在生成式AI能力上出现的“技能绕过”风险。
AI.translation: 高等教育机构日益被期望确保学生和教职员工都能培养生成式AI（GenAI）素养。为此，他们正在引入专业发展项目并将GenAI技能融入学生课程。然而，目前的教育框架通常假设GenAI素养呈线性进展，暗示基础技术理解必须先于创意应用。本文通过对基于分类学的自我评估工具（n=158）进行心理测量分析，挑战了这一假设。我们应用Rasch测量理论和Guttman排序来映射学生、学者和专业人员对GenAI技能潜在感知难度。结果揭示了感知能力配置的根本差异：学者遵循更传统的线性路径，而学生表现出“倒置”配置，即在获得基础概念理解之前就经常掌握高水平的创作任务。此外，学生和学者之间的技能难度相关性很弱（r = 0.188）。我们认为这种“技能绕过”创造了一种脆弱的流畅感，即高提示词自我效能感掩盖了对AI机制的低素养。这些发现挑战了“一刀切”的课程设置，并为诊断驱动的模块化干预提供了实证基础，以促进真正的人机协同。
AI.summary: 本文通过心理测量分析揭示了高等教育中学生与教职员工在生成式AI素养发展路径上的本质差异。研究指出学生倾向于在缺乏底层机制理解的情况下直接进行高阶创意应用，这种“技能绕过”现象导致了脆弱的流畅感。研究结果呼吁教育界放弃统一的线性课程模式，转向更具针对性的诊断式教学。
AI.keywords: 生成式AI素养, 心理测量学, 高等教育, 技能绕过, 教学干预
AI.comments: 该研究通过心理测量学方法，揭示了学生与教职员工在生成式AI能力习得路径上的显著差异，挑战了传统的线性教育假设。其创新之处在于量化了“技能绕过（skill bypass）”现象，为个性化、诊断驱动的AI教育干预提供了实证依据，具有很高的教育实践价值。

title: Why does AI unlock new possibilities in STEM education? A Bibliometric Analysis of Trends and Future Agenda
summary: STEM education faces challenges in personalization and interdisciplinary integration. AI technology has brought new possibilities, but the mechanisms by which AI reshapes the STEM education ecosystem require systematic investigation. This study employs bibliometric methods to analyze 242 publications from 2015-2025, constructing knowledge maps to reveal the evolutionary trajectory. The findings show that the field has transformed from intelligent tutoring systems to inquiry-based learning and computational thinking cultivation driven by LLMs. AI's key contribution lies in providing intelligent scaffolding that lowers the threshold for understanding knowledge. In this sense, AI is a core driving force promoting its shift from knowledge transmission to capability development.

AI.title_translation: 为什么人工智能能为STEM教育解锁新机遇？趋势与未来议程的文献计量分析
AI.tldr: 本研究通过文献计量分析，揭示了人工智能如何通过智能支架降低知识理解门槛，推动STEM教育从知识传授转向能力发展。
AI.motivation: STEM教育在个性化和跨学科整合方面面临挑战，尽管AI技术带来了新可能性，但AI重塑STEM教育生态系统的具体机制尚需系统性调查。
AI.method: 本研究采用文献计量方法，分析了2015-2025年间的242篇出版物，并构建知识图谱以揭示该领域的演变轨迹。
AI.result: 研究发现，该领域已从智能辅导系统转变为由大型语言模型驱动的探究式学习和计算思维培养。人工智能的关键贡献在于提供智能支架，降低知识理解的门槛。
AI.conclusion: 人工智能是推动STEM教育从知识传授转向能力发展，并解锁新可能性的核心驱动力。
AI.translation: STEM教育在个性化和跨学科整合方面面临挑战。人工智能技术带来了新的可能性，但人工智能重塑STEM教育生态系统的机制需要系统性调查。本研究采用文献计量方法，分析了2015-2025年间的242篇出版物，构建知识图谱以揭示演变轨迹。研究结果表明，该领域已从智能辅导系统转变为由大型语言模型驱动的探究式学习和计算思维培养。人工智能的关键贡献在于提供智能支架，降低知识理解的门槛。从这个意义上说，人工智能是促进其从知识传授转向能力发展的核心驱动力。
AI.summary: 本研究通过对2015-2025年间242篇出版物进行文献计量分析，探讨了人工智能在STEM教育中解锁新机遇的机制。研究揭示，该领域已从智能辅导系统发展至由大型语言模型驱动的探究式学习和计算思维培养。AI通过提供智能支架有效降低知识理解门槛，是推动STEM教育从知识传授转向能力发展的核心驱动力。
AI.keywords: STEM教育, 人工智能, 文献计量分析, 智能支架, 大型语言模型
AI.comments: 这项研究通过文献计量分析，系统地揭示了人工智能如何从技术层面推动STEM教育理念和实践的转变，特别是强调了LLMs的作用和智能支架的价值，为理解AI在教育领域的深层影响提供了有益的视角。

title: Measuring the Invisible: Evaluating the Impact of Public Funding on Open Source Software
summary: Open Source Software (OSS) forms a critical layer of contemporary digital infrastructure, yet remains largely overlooked by the institutions and societies that depend on it. Despite growing institutional interest, the causal impact of public funding on OSS project sustainability remains empirically unresolved. Existing literature is divided between econometric and socio-technical approaches with few attempts at causal identification. This work aims to bridge that divide by combining a Goal-Question-Metric framework with the Generalized Synthetic Control Method to estimate the causal effect of the Sovereign Tech Fund on OSS repository activity. Counterfactual trajectories are constructed from a matched donor pool of unfunded projects, enabling identification of what funded repositories would have looked like in the absence of intervention. The main results show that the funding has a significant positive effect on project velocity metrics: commits, pull requests --both merged and new ones--, and new issues. There is no significant effect on the number of releases, contributors or closed issues. This indicates that the STF funding mobilises existing development activity rather than expanding the contributor base or accelerating backlog resolution. These findings carry practical implications for the design of public OSS funding evaluation frameworks, where assessment metrics should be matched to programme objectives rather than applied uniformly across interventions.

AI.title_translation: 衡量无形：评估公共资金对开源软件的影响
AI.tldr: 本研究利用目标-问题-度量框架和广义合成控制方法，评估主权技术基金对开源软件项目活动（如提交、拉取请求和新问题）的因果影响，发现资金显著增加了开发活动，但未扩大贡献者基础或加速积压解决。
AI.motivation: 开源软件（OSS）是当代数字基础设施的关键层，但其价值常被依赖它的机构和社会所忽视。尽管机构兴趣日益增长，公共资金对OSS项目可持续性的因果影响在实证上仍未解决。现有文献在计量经济学和社会技术方法之间存在分歧，很少尝试因果识别。
AI.method: 本研究结合了目标-问题-度量（Goal-Question-Metric）框架和广义合成控制方法（Generalized Synthetic Control Method），以估计主权技术基金（Sovereign Tech Fund）对OSS仓库活动的因果效应。通过从一组未获资助的匹配捐赠项目中构建反事实轨迹，来识别如果未干预，获得资助的仓库会是什么样子。
AI.result: 研究主要结果显示，资金对项目速度指标（如提交、拉取请求——包括已合并和新增的——以及新问题）有显著的积极影响。然而，对发布数量、贡献者数量或已关闭问题数量没有显著影响。这表明STF资金动员了现有的开发活动，而不是扩大贡献者基础或加速积压解决。
AI.conclusion: 公共资金对开源软件项目速度指标有显著的积极影响，但并未扩大贡献者基础或加速积压解决。这些发现对公共OSS资金评估框架的设计具有实践意义，评估指标应与项目目标匹配，而非统一应用于所有干预措施。
AI.translation: 开源软件（OSS）构成了当代数字基础设施的关键层，但很大程度上被依赖它的机构和社会所忽视。尽管机构兴趣日益增长，公共资金对OSS项目可持续性的因果影响在实证上仍未解决。现有文献在计量经济学和社会技术方法之间存在分歧，很少尝试因果识别。这项工作旨在通过将目标-问题-度量框架与广义合成控制方法相结合，估计主权技术基金对OSS仓库活动的因果效应来弥合这一分歧。反事实轨迹是从一组匹配的未资助项目捐赠池中构建的，从而能够识别在没有干预的情况下，获得资助的仓库会是什么样子。主要结果表明，该资金对项目速度指标（如提交、拉取请求——包括已合并和新增的——以及新问题）具有显著的积极影响。对发布数量、贡献者数量或已关闭问题数量没有显著影响。这表明STF资金动员了现有的开发活动，而不是扩大贡献者基础或加速积压解决。这些发现对公共OSS资金评估框架的设计具有实践意义，评估指标应与项目目标匹配，而不是统一应用于所有干预措施。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在通过结合目标-问题-度量框架和广义合成控制方法，量化公共资金（具体是主权技术基金）对开源软件项目可持续性的因果影响。研究发现，公共资金显著提升了项目的开发速度指标，如提交、拉取请求和新问题，但对贡献者数量或问题解决速度没有显著影响。这表明资金主要促进了现有开发活动的活跃度。研究结果为公共OSS资金评估框架的设计提供了实用建议，强调评估指标应与项目目标相匹配。
AI.keywords: 开源软件, 公共资金, 因果效应, 广义合成控制, 项目速度
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于它首次尝试使用因果识别方法（广义合成控制方法）来评估公共资金对开源软件的实际影响，弥合了现有文献中计量经济学和社会技术方法的鸿沟。其重要性在于为公共资金资助开源软件的有效性提供了实证证据，并对未来评估框架的设计提出了具体的、数据驱动的建议。

title: How Stable Is a PNT Resilience Score? Decision-Instability of Single-Number Resilience Ratings under Framework-Aligned Weighting
comments: 6 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Open-source scoring engine, study artifact, and figure pipeline (AGPL-3.0); deterministic (fixed seed). Aligned to DHS RPCF v2.0; a simulation-derived self-assessment, not a certification
summary: Authoritative positioning, navigation, and timing (PNT) resilience frameworks (the DHS Resilient PNT Conformance Framework, RPCF, and peers) define what resilience means but supply only self-attestation: a checklist or a maturity Level, with no engine and no measurement. We build the missing measurement layer as an open, deterministic scoring engine over a PNT simulator, emitting per-dimension sub-scores traceable to a scenario and an oracle, and ask whether a single composite score or maturity Level is a stable basis for a decision. Across seven architectures spanning cross-dimension tradeoffs, a Dirichlet simplex over the seven RPCF categories, and a five-threat ensemble, the answer splits in two. The composite winner is stable under active denial and under near-equal weightings (about 1 percent flip rate), so a single number is safe precisely where one design dominates; but re-weighting alone flips it in up to 22 percent of draws under nominal conditions, where designs contend, a known composite-indicator sensitivity. The sharper, weighting-invariant failure is categorical: a weakest-link maturity Level (our minimum-over-categories operationalization of the RPCF ladder, not the framework's rule) depends on the threat assumed, not the architecture, changing for one architecture in seven. Because the composite rewards declared techniques, a constructed single-band receiver declaring all seven outscores a more resilient system: self-attestation can be gamed by declaration. And apparent fourfold GNSS redundancy reduces, by the definition of a shared common-mode failure domain, to an effective diversity of one. Conclusions hold under +/-20 percent perturbation of every driver within the reduction. We report per-dimension sub-scores with provenance and a rank range, not a phantom single number. A self-assessment aligned to RPCF v2.0, not a certification.
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 1 table. Open-source scoring engine, study artifact, and figure pipeline (AGPL-3.0); deterministic (fixed seed). Aligned to DHS RPCF v2.0; a simulation-derived self-assessment, not a certification

AI.title_translation: PNT弹性评分有多稳定？基于框架权重下的单一弹性等级的决策不稳定性分析
AI.tldr: PNT弹性不能仅靠单一分数或成熟度等级来衡量，因为这种评估方式极易受权重设置和自我声明操纵的影响，缺乏决策稳定性。
AI.motivation: 现有的PNT弹性框架（如RPCF）仅提供缺乏度量机制的自我声明式检查表或成熟度等级，缺乏科学的评估手段，且单一指标能否作为决策依据尚未得到验证。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于PNT模拟器的开放式确定性评分引擎，涵盖七种架构、五种威胁组合以及Dirichlet单纯形权重分配，通过分析权重变化对复合分数和成熟度等级的影响来验证稳定性。
AI.result: 单一复合分数在设计占优时相对稳定，但在设计竞争激烈时，权重调整可导致高达22%的排名反转；此外，“最弱环节”成熟度等级高度依赖于威胁假设，且自我声明机制易被投机性设计操纵，GNSS冗余在存在共模失效时效果大打折扣。
AI.conclusion: 单一的弹性评分或成熟度等级在面对权重变化时具有高度的不稳定性，且易受自我声明的操纵。评估PNT弹性应采用基于维度、具有来源溯源的子分数，而非虚幻的单一数值。
AI.translation: 权威的定位、导航和授时（PNT）弹性框架（如DHS的RPCF及同类框架）定义了弹性的含义，但仅提供自我声明：即一份检查表或一个成熟度等级，缺乏引擎支撑和量化手段。我们构建了一个缺失的测量层，作为一个基于PNT模拟器的开放式、确定性评分引擎，输出可追溯至特定场景和参考标准的各维度子分数，并探讨单一复合分数或成熟度等级是否为决策的稳定依据。通过涵盖跨维度权衡的七种架构、RPCF七个类别的Dirichlet单纯形以及五种威胁组合的实验，结论呈现两面性。复合优胜者在主动拒止和权重近乎相等的情况下表现稳定（翻转率约1%），即在单一设计占优时单值是安全的；但在名义条件下，仅通过权重调整即可导致高达22%的排名反转。更为严峻的是，最弱环节的成熟度等级（我们对RPCF阶梯的最低值操作化定义）取决于所假设的威胁而非架构本身。由于复合指标奖励所声明的技术，一个声明了全部七项技术的单一频段接收机得分反而高于更具弹性的系统：自我声明可以被通过声明来博弈。此外，四重GNSS冗余在共模失效域的定义下，有效多样性降为一。即使在所有驱动因子±20%的扰动下，上述结论依然成立。我们建议报告具有来源溯源和排名范围的各维度子分数，而非虚幻的单一数值。这是一种与RPCF v2.0对齐的自我评估，而非认证。
AI.summary: 本文通过构建确定性评分引擎，评估了PNT弹性框架下单一评分指标的稳定性。研究发现，单一复合分数和成熟度等级在面对权重调整和威胁假设变化时表现出显著的不稳定性，且易受自我声明式评估的操纵，因此不应作为决策的唯一依据。
AI.keywords: 定位导航授时(PNT), 弹性框架, 决策稳定性, 评分引擎, 复合指标敏感性
AI.comments: 本文揭示了当前PNT弹性框架中“单一分数”或“成熟度等级”评估方式的严重缺陷。其创新之处在于提出了一种确定性的评分引擎，量化了权重敏感性，并指出自我声明式评估容易受到博弈操纵。研究结果对评估关键基础设施的弹性具有重要的现实指导意义。

title: Text Distance from Nested and Hierarchical Repetitions: A Compression-Based Perspective
summary: We present a new method for structural sequence analysis grounded in Algorithmic Information Theory (AIT). At its core is the Ladderpath approach, which extracts nested and hierarchical relationships among repeated substructures in linguistic sequences -- an instantiation of AIT's principle of describing data through minimal generative programs. These structures are then used to define three distance measures: a normalized compression distance (NCD), and two alternative distances derived directly from the Ladderpath representation. Integrated with a $k$-nearest neighbor classifier, these distances achieve strong and consistent performance across in-distribution, out-of-distribution (OOD), and few-shot text classification tasks. In particular, all three methods outperform both gzip-based NCD and BERT under OOD and low-resource settings. These results demonstrate that the structured representations captured by Ladderpath preserve intrinsic properties of sequences and provide a lightweight, interpretable, and training-free alternative for text modeling. This work highlights the potential of AIT-based approaches for structural and domain-agnostic sequence understanding.

AI.title_translation: 基于嵌套和层次重复的文本距离：一种基于压缩的视角
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Ladderpath的无需训练的文本分析方法，通过捕捉文本的层次结构，在少样本和分布外任务中实现了优于BERT的分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本建模方法（如BERT）通常需要大量数据训练，且在分布外（OOD）和低资源场景下表现不佳，研究者旨在利用算法信息论原理，通过捕捉文本的内在结构化特征，开发一种轻量级、无需训练且具备良好泛化能力的序列分析方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为Ladderpath的结构化序列分析方法，通过提取重复子结构的嵌套和层次关系，并基于此定义了归一化压缩距离（NCD）及两种改进的距离度量，结合k-近邻分类器进行文本分类。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在分布内、分布外（OOD）和少样本任务中表现强劲，且在OOD和低资源设置下性能超越了gzip-based NCD和BERT。
AI.conclusion: Ladderpath方法成功地将算法信息论应用于序列分析，证明了基于结构压缩的距离度量在处理分布外和少样本任务时优于gzip和BERT，展现了其在结构化和领域无关序列理解方面的广泛应用前景。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种基于算法信息论（AIT）的结构化序列分析新方法。其核心是Ladderpath方法，它能够提取语言序列中重复子结构之间的嵌套和层次关系——这是AIT通过最小生成程序描述数据原则的一种实例化。这些结构随后被用于定义三种距离度量：归一化压缩距离（NCD）以及直接从Ladderpath表示中导出的两种替代距离。将这些距离与k-近邻分类器相结合，在分布内、分布外（OOD）和少样本文本分类任务中均取得了强大且一致的性能。特别是，这三种方法在OOD和低资源设置下均优于基于gzip的NCD和BERT。这些结果表明，Ladderpath捕获的结构化表示保留了序列的内在属性，并为文本建模提供了一种轻量级、可解释且无需训练的替代方案。这项工作突显了基于AIT的方法在结构化和领域无关的序列理解方面的潜力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于算法信息论的Ladderpath方法，通过提取序列中重复子结构的嵌套与层次关系，构建了三种文本距离度量。该方法结合k-近邻分类器，在多种文本分类任务中展现出优于gzip和BERT的性能，证明了其作为一种轻量级、可解释且无需训练的文本建模方案的有效性。
AI.keywords: 算法信息论, 序列分析, 文本分类, 嵌套结构, 压缩距离
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于利用算法信息论（AIT）原理，通过Ladderpath方法提取文本中的嵌套和层次结构，从而在无需训练的情况下实现高效的文本分类。其优势在于其轻量级、可解释性强以及在OOD和低资源场景下的鲁棒性，为大模型之外的文本建模提供了一个极具潜力的替代方向。

title: A Survey of Learn-to-Compute Paradigms for Rate-Distortion-Type Problems
comments: 12 pages, 3 figures, accepted by IEEE BITS
summary: Rate-distortion (RD) theory and its related formulations play a central role in understanding efficient information representation, but computing these quantities remains challenging in high-dimensional settings. Classical iterative methods such as the Blahut-Arimoto algorithm become impractical in high-dimensional domains due to the curse of dimensionality and the intractability of mutual-information terms. Recent advances in neural modeling and differentiable optimization offer a promising alternative through a learn-to-compute paradigm, in which probability distributions and objective functionals are represented by flexible neural parameterizations. This survey presents an overview of neural approaches for evaluating the RD-type objectives. We present three representative families of methods: variational inference, neural mutual-information estimation, and dual-form optimization. By reviewing their theoretical principles, algorithmic techniques, and consistency properties, we elucidate how these methods collectively transform classical RD-type problems into scalable differentiable objectives suitable for deep learning, though challenges remain in large-scale applications. Together, these perspectives offer promising avenues for scaling information-theoretic computation to complex, high-dimensional machine learning systems.
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, accepted by IEEE BITS

title: Contrastive Predictive Coding with Compression for Enhanced Channel State Feedback in Wireless Networks
comments: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems
summary: Accurate and timely channel state information (CSI) is essential for next-generation wireless systems, yet existing works treat CSI compression and CSI prediction as separate problems, both in academia and in current 3GPP studies. Consequently, channel aging remains insufficiently addressed within standardized CSI feedback pipelines. In this article, we propose a unified compression-prediction framework that integrates Contrastive Predictive Coding (CPC) directly into the 3GPP-compliant CSI compression architecture. Instead of predicting high-dimensional CSI matrices, our approach forecasts future latent representations and jointly optimizes reconstruction fidelity and temporal predictive coherence via a combined 1-SGCS and InfoNCE objective. This design enables temporal representation learning without increasing feedback overhead. We present two variants: CPC-before-Compression, which performs autoregressive modeling on encoded features prior to quantization, and CPC-after-Compression, which shifts temporal modeling to the base-station to reduce the complexity of users' devices. Evaluations on 3GPP-compliant datasets from Nokia, Oppo, and CATT show that CPC-before-Compression achieves over 90% reconstruction accuracy with 32x lower decoder GFLOPs than the 3GPP baseline, while CPC-after-Compression preserves an identical encoder footprint and the same 64-bit feedback overhead. By unifying compression and prediction within a standardized pipeline, the proposed framework provides an age-aware, computationally efficient CSI feedback solution. The source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/AhmedRadwan02/cpc-3gpp

AI.title_translation: 基于压缩的对比预测编码：增强无线网络中的信道状态反馈
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种将对比预测编码（CPC）整合进3GPP CSI反馈架构的统一框架，通过在潜在空间进行时序预测，在不增加反馈开销的前提下，显著提升了信道状态信息的时效性与准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的研究将CSI压缩和CSI预测视为两个独立的问题，导致无线通信中信道老化问题未能得到充分解决。因此，需要一种统一的框架来同时处理压缩与预测，以提高CSI的准确性和时效性。
AI.method: 提出了一种统一的压缩-预测框架，将对比预测编码（CPC）集成到3GPP CSI压缩架构中。通过1-SGCS和InfoNCE目标函数联合优化重构保真度和时序预测一致性。具体包含两种变体：CPC-before-Compression（编码前进行自回归建模）和CPC-after-Compression（将时序建模移至基站以降低终端计算复杂度）。
AI.result: 在Nokia、Oppo和CATT的3GPP数据集上验证表明，CPC-before-Compression实现了超过90%的重构精度，且解码器计算复杂度（GFLOPs）比3GPP基准降低了32倍；CPC-after-Compression则在保持原有编码器开销和64-bit反馈负载的同时，有效提升了性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功统一了CSI压缩与预测，通过在潜在空间引入时序建模，在不增加额外反馈开销的前提下，显著提升了信道状态信息的准确性和时效性，为未来无线通信系统提供了一种高效的解决方案。
AI.translation: 准确且及时的信道状态信息（CSI）对于下一代无线系统至关重要，然而现有的学术研究和3GPP标准工作均将CSI压缩与CSI预测视为独立的问题。因此，在标准化的CSI反馈管道中，信道老化问题仍未得到充分解决。本文提出了一个统一的压缩-预测框架，将对比预测编码（CPC）直接集成到符合3GPP标准的CSI压缩架构中。我们的方法不是直接预测高维CSI矩阵，而是预测未来的潜在表示，并通过结合1-SGCS和InfoNCE的目标函数，联合优化重构保真度和时序预测一致性。该设计在不增加反馈开销的情况下实现了时序表示学习。我们提出了两种变体：CPC-before-Compression，在量化前对编码特征进行自回归建模；以及CPC-after-Compression，将时序建模转移到基站端以降低用户设备的复杂度。在Nokia、Oppo和CATT的3GPP合规数据集上的评估显示，CPC-before-Compression实现了超过90%的重构精度，且解码器GFLOPs比3GPP基准低32倍；而CPC-after-Compression则保持了相同的编码器占用空间和64-bit反馈开销。通过在标准化流水线中统一压缩与预测，该框架提供了一种具备时效感知且计算高效的CSI反馈解决方案。源代码已在GitHub公开。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种将对比预测编码（CPC）集成到3GPP CSI反馈架构中的统一框架，旨在解决信道老化问题。该方法通过在潜在空间而非高维空间进行预测，并联合优化重构与时序预测，在不增加反馈开销的情况下提升了CSI的精度与时效性，且具备良好的工业标准兼容性。
AI.keywords: 信道状态信息 (CSI), 对比预测编码 (CPC), 无线网络, 数据压缩, 时序预测
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将对比预测编码（CPC）有机地嵌入到标准的3GPP CSI反馈架构中，解决了传统方法中压缩与预测割裂的问题。通过在潜在空间进行预测，有效缓解了信道老化带来的性能下降，同时保持了反馈开销不变，在工业标准兼容性和性能之间取得了极佳平衡。

title: When AI Classifies: What Counts as Public Administration?
summary: This study examines how alternative systems of scholarly representation identify and characterize broad public administration (PA) and artificial intelligence related public administration (AI-in-PA) scholarship. Using Web of Science and OpenAlex, it compares five approaches based on author-defined, citation-driven, and AI-assisted representations. The results highlight substantial differences in corpus size, publication types, publishing outlets, temporal development, and thematic clustering and structure. The alternative approaches often identify different knowledge domains instead of varied subsets of the same scholarship and therefore produce distinct representations, as evidenced by no overlap in publications and publishing outlets across representations. The findings suggest that algorithmic knowledge organization increasingly influences how interdisciplinary scholarship is classified, structured, and understood and, epistemologically, how its visibility, intellectual structure, and boundaries are represented. AI-enabled scholarly classifications and representations are not neutral but interpretative, likely self-reinforcing, and potentially constrain the evolution and adaptation of disciplinary boundaries. Human disciplinary judgment is essential and is complemented rather than replaced.

AI.title_translation: 当AI进行分类时：何为公共行政？
AI.tldr: 不同的学术分类方法（尤其是AI驱动的方法）会产生完全不同的学科版图，这表明算法分类并非中立，且可能固化学科边界，因此人类的判断依然必不可少。
AI.motivation: 探讨不同的学术代表性系统（特别是AI驱动的系统）如何对公共行政及人工智能相关领域的学术文献进行识别与分类，并分析这些分类方法对学科边界和知识理解的影响。
AI.method: 对比分析法。研究利用Web of Science和OpenAlex数据库，对比了五种基于作者定义、引文驱动和AI辅助的学术代表性分类方法，分析其在语料库规模、出版物类型、主题结构等方面的差异。
AI.result: 五种分类方法在文献规模、主题聚类及出版渠道上存在显著差异，甚至出现无重叠的情况。研究表明，算法分类不仅影响学术的可见性，还可能通过自我强化机制限制学科的演进与适应。
AI.conclusion: AI辅助的学术分类具有解释性且非中立，容易导致知识结构的自我强化，因此人类的专业判断在界定学科边界时依然至关重要。
AI.translation: 本研究考察了不同的学术代表性系统如何识别和表征广泛的公共行政（PA）及人工智能相关的公共行政（AI-in-PA）学术成果。通过使用Web of Science和OpenAlex，研究比较了五种基于作者定义、引文驱动和AI辅助的分类方法。结果突显了在语料库规模、出版类型、出版渠道、时间发展以及主题聚类和结构方面的巨大差异。这些替代性方法往往识别出不同的知识领域，而非同一学术领域的不同子集，因此产生了截然不同的学术表征，这体现在不同分类方法之间在出版物和出版渠道上几乎没有重叠。研究结果表明，算法化的知识组织正日益影响跨学科研究的分类、结构和理解方式，并在认识论层面影响其可见性、知识结构和边界的呈现。AI驱动的学术分类和表征并非中立，而是具有解释性的、可能是自我强化的，并可能限制学科边界的演进与适应。人类的学科判断至关重要，且应是互补而非被取代的。
AI.summary: 本研究通过对比五种不同的学术分类方法（包括AI辅助和传统方法），揭示了不同系统在定义“公共行政”及“AI在公共行政中的应用”这一领域时，会产生截然不同的知识图谱。研究指出，算法分类具有高度的解释性和非中立性，会对学科结构的认知产生深远影响。
AI.keywords: 公共行政, 人工智能, 学术分类, 知识组织, 算法偏见
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了学术分类系统并非中立的工具，而是具有解释性的，这对于理解跨学科领域（如AI-in-PA）的知识边界构建具有重要意义。研究强调了在依赖算法进行学术评价与知识组织时，人类判断仍然不可或缺，提醒学者需警惕算法分类可能带来的偏见与学科演进的固化。

title: Procedural Volumetric Modeling of Plant Branching Structures for Finite Element Analysis
summary: Precision agriculture, smart breeding, and agricultural robotics require accurate and automated plant modeling. These models provide high-fidelity three-dimensional (3D) representations of plant architecture. They provide the geometric foundation for simulations of water and nutrient transport, light interception, structural loading, and crop lodging. Unlike static plant modeling pipelines, procedural modeling frameworks not only generate accurate 3D plant geometries but also support the generative modeling of crop diversity and the dynamic modeling of plant growth. While terrestrial laser scanning, LiDAR, photogrammetry, and neural reconstruction-based approaches have made 3D plant reconstruction possible, the resulting data are typically in the form of point clouds, which cannot be directly utilized for high-fidelity simulations. We present an automated volumetric procedural modeling framework for plant branching structures that generates analysis-suitable hexahedral meshes from input skeletons or 3D point clouds. The input skeleton is first converted into a rooted graph representation that captures the plant branching topology. Each graph edge is then represented by a smooth centerline B-spline curve, around which a cylindrical tensor-product B-spline volume is constructed. At each junction, incident B-spline volume control lattices are joined using blending operations. The resulting volumetric parameterization is evaluated to generate a smooth and conforming hexahedral mesh of the whole plant. We demonstrate the framework on three diverse plant datasets, namely mung bean, tomato, and walnut trees, generating meshes with both uniform and spatially varying branch radii. The framework also supports dynamic mesh generation suitable for modeling plant growth by locally updating newly added branches without reconstructing the full plant geometry.

title: Optimism as a Vulnerability: Deceptive Stackelberg Control of UCB Bandit Followers
comments: Accepted to the NExT-Game Workshop (New Frontiers in Game-Theoretic Learning) at ICML 2026. To be presented July 11, 2026, Seoul, South Korea
summary: Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) algorithms guarantee sublinear regret for agents learning unknown stochastic environments, yet the same principle that makes them statistically efficient (optimism in the face of uncertainty) induces a predictable strategic vulnerability against an omniscient adaptive leader. Classical strong Stackelberg equilibrium (SSE) assumes that the follower immediately best-responds to the leader's committed mixed action; it therefore supplies no mechanism-design prescription for a leader facing a boundedly rational follower who constructs and acts on empirical reward histories. We formalize this conflict in a finite-horizon repeated Stackelberg game and give exact constructive proofs for a deceptive leader mechanism. In a honeypot phase, the leader pays a finite signaling cost to inflate the UCB index of a designated follower action. In a trap phase, the leader switches to a selfish action distribution while the follower remains locked into the designated action because the manipulated empirical history and exploration bonus dominate competing indices. Under explicit separation and payoff assumptions, the leader's cumulative utility strictly exceeds the classical SSE ceiling, and the manipulation cost is bounded by a regret calculation of order $O(\sqrt{T\ln T})$. The results identify a formal incompatibility between static equilibrium prescriptions and dynamically learned empirical incentives.

title: Linking Hadith Narrator Identities Across Heterogeneous Arabic Biographical Databases: A Multi-Signal Entity Resolution Pipeline
comments: 16 pages, the data sets available at DOI: 10.1016/j.dib.2022.108065
summary: The transmission chains (sanad) of Islamic Hadith literature encode relationships among tens of thousands of historical narrators whose biographical records are dispersed across independently maintained digital databases that share no common identifier. We present a two-phase entity resolution pipeline that links narrator names from the Sanadset 650K corpus - 650,986 Hadith records from 926 books containing 185,216 unique narrator name variants - to two biographical databases: Hadithtransmitters (Hawramani; 100,915 entries) and Muslimscholars (25,247 entries). Phase 1 matches Sanadset names to Hawramani using name-only similarity (Sanadset carries no metadata), yielding 94,628 links (51.1%; HIGH 39,938 / MED 54,690). Phase 2 cross-references Hawramani against Muslimscholars via a weighted multi-signal function combining name similarity, death-year proximity, and reliability grade polarity, yielding 95,573 links (94.7% of Hawramani; HIGH 18,245 / MED 71,546 / LOW 5,782). Chaining the two phases gives Sanadset narrators transitive access to Muslimscholars data. The linked data enable construction of a 185,216-node, 814,093-edge directed transmission graph enriched with cross-source biographical metadata. The annotated link corpora and enriched graph are released as open resources.
comment: 16 pages, the data sets available at DOI: 10.1016/j.dib.2022.108065

AI.title_translation: 跨异构阿拉伯传记数据库链接圣训叙述者身份：一种多信号实体解析流水线
AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种两阶段算法，将分散的伊斯兰圣训叙述者数据整合，构建了一个包含丰富传记元数据的关联传输图谱。
AI.motivation: 圣训传输链中涉及数万名历史叙述者，但其传记记录分散在互不兼容的数字数据库中，缺乏统一标识符，导致无法进行大规模的关联分析。
AI.method: 提出了一个两阶段实体解析流水线：第一阶段使用基于名称相似度的匹配将圣训叙述者链接至Hadithtransmitters库；第二阶段通过加权多信号函数（结合名称相似度、死亡年份接近度、可靠性等级极性）将Hadithtransmitters与Muslimscholars库进行交叉引用。
AI.result: 第一阶段成功链接了94,628条记录；第二阶段链接了95,573条记录。通过级联匹配，最终构建了一个包含185,216个节点和814,093条边的有向传输图谱，并开源了相关数据集。
AI.conclusion: 研究成功构建了一个两阶段实体解析流水线，实现了圣训叙述者在不同数据库间的身份映射，并发布了包含丰富元数据的传输图谱，为后续的计算历史学研究奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 圣训文献的传输链（sanad）编码了数万名历史叙述者之间的关系，他们的传记记录分散在独立维护且无共同标识符的数字数据库中。我们提出了一个两阶段实体解析流水线，将Sanadset 650K语料库（来自926本书的650,986条圣训记录，包含185,216个独特的叙述者名称变体）中的叙述者名称链接到两个传记数据库：Hadithtransmitters（100,915条目）和Muslimscholars（25,247条目）。第一阶段使用仅基于名称的相似度将Sanadset名称与Hadithtransmitters匹配（Sanadset不含元数据），产生94,628个链接（51.1%；高置信度39,938 / 中置信度54,690）。第二阶段通过结合名称相似度、死亡年份接近度和可靠性等级极性的加权多信号函数，将Hadithtransmitters与Muslimscholars进行交叉引用，产生95,573个链接（占Hadithtransmitters的94.7%；高置信度18,245 / 中置信度71,546 / 低置信度5,782）。将这两个阶段链接起来，使Sanadset叙述者能够传递性地访问Muslimscholars数据。链接后的数据能够构建一个包含185,216个节点和814,093条边的有向传输图，并辅以跨来源的传记元数据。标注的链接语料库和丰富的图谱作为开放资源发布。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种两阶段实体解析流水线，旨在将分散在不同数据库中的伊斯兰圣训叙述者身份进行关联。通过名称相似度匹配与包含死亡年份及可靠性等多信号的加权交叉引用，实现了跨库的数据整合，构建并发布了包含丰富元数据的叙述者传输网络图谱。
AI.keywords: 圣训研究, 实体解析, 数字人文, 历史人物数据库, 传输图谱
AI.comments: 该研究通过多信号实体解析技术解决了历史文献中人物身份跨库匹配的难题，不仅为伊斯兰圣训研究提供了宝贵的数据工具，也为数字人文领域处理异构历史人物数据提供了一种可复用的方法论框架。其局限性在于匹配结果存在置信度差异，且完全依赖于现有数据库的质量。

title: Women Enter Too, but Men Persist:The Temporal Structure of Gender Inequality in the Global Citation Elite
summary: In this research, I analyze the gender dynamics of the global citation elite using annual top 2% Stanford/Elsevier lists for 2019-2024. My database includes 1.22 million person-year observations (N=1,221,363), which corresponds to 465,707 unique scientists and scholars from more than 150 countries. I move away from static representations of women in the citation elite toward analyses of entry, exit, and permanent membership in the durable core of this elite. The share of women in the annual citation elite increased from 18.39% in 2019 to 20.98% in 2024. However, women are more strongly represented among first-observed entrants than among continuing members, and their share decreases with the persistence of their presence among the citation elite expressed in years: from 22.19% among single-year members to 17.84% among scientists and scholars present in all six annual lists. Women are generally located closer to the lower boundary of the elite in terms of the citation index deciles - and men are closer to top deciles. My logistic regression models estimate a lower probability of women s membership in the durable core of the citation elite (odds ratio estimate OR=0.69). Women are also more weakly represented in the all-career elite than in the annual elite (15.87% vs. 20.98%). I draw conclusions about gender dynamics within the global citation elite and gender inequalities in science more generally.

AI.title_translation: 女性也在进入，但男性更具持久力：全球引用精英中性别不平等的时序结构
AI.tldr: 尽管越来越多的女性进入全球顶尖科学家行列，但由于她们在精英群体中的留存率较低，且难以进入核心层，性别不平等在科学界依然长期存在。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注女性在精英群体中的静态比例，缺乏对女性如何进入、退出以及在精英群体中长期留存（即“持久核心”）动态过程的研究。
AI.method: 利用2019-2024年斯坦福/Elsevier全球前2%顶尖科学家名单，构建包含122万个观察值的数据库，通过逻辑回归模型分析进入、退出及持续留在精英群体中的性别差异。
AI.result: 女性在引用精英群体中的比例虽从18.39%升至20.98%，但她们在持续留存成员中的比例随时间推移而下降（从单年成员的22.19%降至全勤成员的17.84%），且女性在精英群体中的排名通常偏低，进入“持久核心”的概率仅为男性的0.69倍。
AI.conclusion: 尽管女性进入全球引用精英群体的比例在逐年上升，但她们在精英群体中的持续性较弱，且更难进入该群体的核心层，这表明科学界内部存在持续的性别不平等。
AI.translation: 在本研究中，我利用2019-2024年斯坦福/Elsevier年度前2%榜单，分析了全球引用精英的性别动态。我的数据库包含122万个人-年观察值（N=1,221,363），对应来自150多个国家的465,707名独特科学家和学者。我摒弃了对引用精英中女性的静态描述，转而分析进入、退出以及作为该精英群体持久核心的成员身份。年度引用精英中女性的比例从2019年的18.39%增加到2024年的20.98%。然而，女性在首次入选者中的代表性比在持续成员中的代表性更强，并且她们的份额随着在引用精英中存在年限的增加而减少：从单年成员的22.19%降至所有六年榜单中均在列的科学家和学者的17.84%。就引用指数十分位数而言，女性通常位于精英群体的下边界，而男性则更接近顶部十分位数。我的逻辑回归模型估计，女性成为引用精英持久核心成员的概率较低（优势比估计OR=0.69）。女性在全职业生涯精英中的代表性也比在年度精英中更为薄弱（15.87% vs. 20.98%）。我据此得出了关于全球引用精英内部性别动态以及科学界更广泛存在的性别不平等的结论。
AI.summary: 本文利用2019-2024年的全球顶尖科学家数据，分析了引用精英群体中的性别动态。研究发现，虽然女性进入该群体的比例有所增加，但由于女性在精英群体中的持续性较低且更难进入核心层，学术界依然存在显著的性别不平等。
AI.keywords: 性别不平等, 引用精英, 科学职业生涯, 纵向分析, 学术性别差距
AI.comments: 该研究通过大规模纵向数据揭示了学术界“漏斗效应”的动态机制，不仅关注女性进入精英群体的比例，更深入探讨了持续性（persistence）这一关键维度，对于理解科学界性别不平等具有重要意义。

title: CHARLIE: An On-Premise Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation System for Evidential Reasoning in Forensic Science
comments: 10 pages, 1 figure. Archival version of a paper presented at RELAF 2026: 1st Workshop on Reasoning with Evidence in Law Enforcement and Forensics, co-located with ICAIL 2026, Singapore, June 2026
summary: We present Charlie, an on-premise multi-agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for structured evidential processing in digital forensic environments. Contemporary forensic workflows must handle large volumes of heterogeneous and unstructured documents under strict requirements of traceability, confidentiality, and legal compliance. Charlie addresses this challenge through a controlled agent architecture that combines local retrieval, task decomposition, structured memory, and verification mechanisms. Unlike cloud-based systems, it operates entirely within institutional infrastructure, preserving data sovereignty and evidential integrity. We describe the systems architecture, including its transition from classical RAG to agent-based orchestration, and demonstrate its application in real-world forensic scenarios. Case studies show that Charlie enables scalable multi-document data extraction and supports longitudinal forensic intelligence generation while maintaining traceability and auditability. Our results indicate that agent-orchestrated, on-premise RAG architectures can effectively support evidential workflows without compromising legal and institutional constraints. Charlie provides a practical and reproducible blueprint for deploying AI systems in high-stakes forensic environments. This manuscript is an archival version of a paper presented at the RELAF 2026 Workshop.

AI.title_translation: CHARLIE：一个用于法庭科学证据推理的本地化多智能体检索增强生成系统
AI.tldr: Charlie是一个运行在本地的、具备高安全性和可追溯性的多智能体RAG系统，专门用于解决法庭科学中复杂证据的处理与分析难题。
AI.motivation: 现代法庭科学工作流面临处理海量异构文档的挑战，且对可追溯性、保密性和法律合规性有极高要求，现有的云端系统无法满足这些安全与数据主权需求。
AI.method: 设计了一套基于本地基础设施的受控多智能体RAG架构，包含任务分解、结构化记忆、验证机制以及从传统RAG向智能体编排的演进方案。
AI.result: 案例研究表明，Charlie系统实现了可扩展的多文档数据提取和长效法庭情报生成，同时保持了良好的可追溯性和可审计性。
AI.conclusion: Charlie系统证明了在严格的法律和机构约束下，通过本地化部署的多智能体RAG架构，可以有效实现高效、可追溯且合规的证据推理工作流。
AI.translation: 我们提出了Charlie，一个用于数字取证环境中结构化证据处理的本地化多智能体检索增强生成（RAG）系统。当代的取证工作流必须在严格的可追溯性、保密性和法律合规性要求下处理大量异构且非结构化的文档。Charlie通过一种结合了本地检索、任务分解、结构化记忆和验证机制的受控智能体架构来应对这一挑战。与云端系统不同，它完全在机构基础设施内运行，从而保护了数据主权和证据完整性。我们描述了该系统的架构，包括其从传统RAG向基于智能体的编排的过渡，并展示了其在现实取证场景中的应用。案例研究表明，Charlie能够在保持可追溯性和可审计性的同时，实现可扩展的多文档数据提取并支持长期的法庭情报生成。我们的结果表明，基于智能体编排的本地化RAG架构可以在不损害法律和机构约束的前提下，有效支持证据工作流。Charlie为在高风险取证环境中部署AI系统提供了一个实用且可复制的蓝图。本手稿是RELAF 2026研讨会上发表的一篇论文的存档版本。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Charlie，一个专为法庭科学环境设计的本地化多智能体RAG系统。该系统通过受控的智能体架构，在确保数据主权和法律合规的前提下，实现了对复杂证据的自动化处理、结构化分析与验证。
AI.keywords: 多智能体, 检索增强生成, 法庭科学, 数据主权, 证据推理
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将多智能体架构与本地化RAG系统结合，解决了法庭科学领域对数据主权、合规性和可追溯性的严苛要求。其价值在于为高风险、敏感性环境下的AI部署提供了一个可落地的技术蓝图。

title: Grover-Based PLS: AUD and Beamforming with Artificial Noise in CD-NOMA
summary: Sixth-Generation (6G) networks will require massive connectivity, ultra-low latency, and robust security, making reliable Active User Detection (AUD) essential for interference control and physical layer protection. This letter proposes a Grover-based physical layer security (PLS) framework for a code-domain non-orthogonal multiple access (CD-NOMA) network, where the base station employs artificial-noise (AN)-assisted beamforming and identifies the active set via Grover's quantum search algorithm. We consider two threat models: passive eavesdroppers formed by detected inactive users, and active eavesdroppers selected as the top f% most frequent transmitters among detected active users. By aligning beams and AN with the Grover-based AUD output, the proposed scheme enlarges the main-wiretap rate gap and significantly improves the average secrecy rate compared with compressive sensing and classical correlation receiver baselines, while approaching maximum-likelihood detection performance with a quadratic reduction in search complexity. The impact of the information/AN power split, the base station transmit power, and the fraction of highly active users treated as eavesdroppers on secrecy is characterized through numerical simulations, and design insights are extracted for 6G PLS under both passive and active eavesdropping.

AI.title_translation: 基于Grover算法的物理层安全：CD-NOMA网络中的活跃用户检测与人工噪声波束成形
AI.tldr: 提出了一种利用Grover量子搜索算法提升CD-NOMA网络活跃用户检测效率和物理层安全性的新框架。
AI.motivation: 6G网络对大规模连接、超低延迟及强安全性的需求，使得在CD-NOMA网络中实现可靠的活跃用户检测（AUD）对于干扰控制和物理层保护至关重要。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于Grover量子搜索算法的活跃用户检测（AUD）框架，并结合人工噪声（AN）辅助的波束成形技术，通过将波束和AN与AUD输出对齐来增强物理层安全。
AI.result: 该方案显著扩大了主-窃听速率差，提高了平均保密速率，搜索复杂度实现了二次方降低，且性能接近最大似然检测。
AI.conclusion: 基于Grover的AUD框架结合人工噪声波束成形，在CD-NOMA网络中有效提升了物理层安全性，不仅在性能上优于传统压缩感知和相关接收机，还在搜索复杂度上具备显著优势。
AI.translation: 第六代（6G）网络将需要大规模连接、超低延迟和稳健的安全性，这使得可靠的活跃用户检测（AUD）对于干扰控制和物理层保护至关重要。本快报提出了一种用于码域非正交多址（CD-NOMA）网络的基于Grover的物理层安全（PLS）框架，其中基站采用人工噪声（AN）辅助波束成形，并通过Grover量子搜索算法识别活跃集。我们考虑了两种威胁模型：由检测到的非活跃用户构成的被动窃听者，以及被选为检测到的活跃用户中频率最高的前f%的主动窃听者。通过将波束和AN与基于Grover的AUD输出对齐，所提出的方案扩大了主-窃听速率差，并显著提高了平均保密速率，优于压缩感知和传统相关接收机基准，同时在搜索复杂度降低的情况下逼近最大似然检测性能。通过数值模拟表征了信息/AN功率分配、基站发射功率以及被视为窃听者的高活跃用户比例对保密性的影响，并为被动和主动窃听下的6G PLS提取了设计见解。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种面向CD-NOMA网络的量子辅助物理层安全框架，通过利用Grover算法进行高效的用户活跃度检测，并结合人工噪声波束成形技术，有效对抗被动与主动窃听，显著提升了系统的保密性能与计算效率。
AI.keywords: 6G, CD-NOMA, 活跃用户检测, 物理层安全, Grover算法
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将量子计算中的Grover搜索算法应用于6G CD-NOMA网络中的活跃用户检测（AUD），在保持接近最大似然检测性能的同时，实现了计算复杂度的二次方下降。这为解决6G高密度连接下的安全和干扰管理提供了一种极具潜力的量子辅助物理层安全方案。

title: Abductive Corroboration of Probabilistic AI Models for Forensic Synthetic Media Detection
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI) models, at their core, apply general learnings from broad datasets to individual circumstances using probabilistic behaviour. This inductive approach stands in contrast to deductive reasoning approaches which seek to prove conclusions from their premises. However, research has shown that deductive reasoning with AI models is a challenging problem and in the real-world it may not always be feasible. An alternative way forward is to leverage abductive reasoning, seeking to corroborate the output of multiple approaches to identify the most likely conclusion from the factual matrix. We apply this to synthetic media detection in forensic settings, and find we are able to disproportionately lower the risk of false positives to true positive recall. We also provide the first empirical evaluation of OpenAI's rollout of SynthID on synthetic images and evaluate how complementary different synthetic media detection approaches are.

AI.title_translation: 面向取证合成媒体检测的概率AI模型溯因验证
AI.tldr: 通过溯因推理整合多种AI检测模型，可有效降低合成媒体取证中的假阳性率。
AI.motivation: 现有AI模型主要基于归纳法，在处理特定案例时存在概率不确定性，且演绎推理在AI中实现困难，因此需要一种新的推理框架来提高取证分析的准确性。
AI.method: 采用溯因推理（Abductive reasoning）方法，通过整合多种不同的检测模型输出，对证据矩阵进行验证，并对OpenAI的SynthID进行了首次实证评估。
AI.result: 研究表明，溯因推理能显著降低假阳性风险，同时保持较好的真阳性召回率，并证实了多种检测方法结合具有显著的互补性。
AI.conclusion: 通过溯因推理整合多种检测方法，可以有效平衡合成媒体检测中的假阳性率与召回率，并验证了不同检测模型间的互补性。
AI.translation: 人工智能（AI）模型的核心在于将来自广泛数据集的通用学习应用于具有概率行为的个体情况。这种归纳方法与旨在从前提中证明结论的演绎推理方法形成了对比。然而，研究表明，AI模型的演绎推理是一个具有挑战性的问题，在现实世界中可能并不总是可行的。一种替代的前进方向是利用溯因推理，寻求通过多种方法的输出来相互印证，从而从事实矩阵中确定最可能的结论。我们将此应用于取证环境中的合成媒体检测，发现我们能够不成比例地降低假阳性风险，同时保持真阳性召回率。我们还提供了OpenAI在合成图像上推出SynthID的首个实证评估，并评估了不同合成媒体检测方法的互补性。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了利用溯因推理来增强AI模型在合成媒体取证检测中的表现。通过整合多个模型的输出以验证结论，研究证明该方法能有效降低假阳性率，并对OpenAI的SynthID在图像检测中的表现进行了实证评估。
AI.keywords: 溯因推理, 合成媒体检测, 取证分析, 概率模型, 模型互补性
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入溯因推理（Abductive reasoning）来处理AI模型的概率性输出，为解决取证领域中假阳性率高的问题提供了一种切实可行的新思路，特别是在当前合成媒体泛滥的背景下具有重要的应用价值。

title: Bibby AI: An Editor-Native Agentic Platform for Academic Research, Writing, and Publishing
summary: Academic output is produced across a fragmented toolchain: literature discovery in one application, reference management in another, writing in a LaTeX editor, formatting against venue templates by hand, and submission through yet another portal. Each boundary between tools forces a context switch, a format conversion, or a manual copy-paste step, and the cumulative cost dominates the time researchers spend on activities that are not research. We present Bibby AI, an editor-native platform that collapses this toolchain into a single Research-Write-Publish pipeline built around a cloud LaTeX editor. Unlike assistants that attach to an existing editor through a browser extension, Bibby AI owns the full document state, compilation pipeline, and revision history, which allows its agents to perform retrieval-grounded citation insertion, structural edits, and template-compliant reformatting as first-class, verifiable operations rather than text suggestions. The platform integrates (i) ingestion pipelines that convert PDF, DOCX, and handwritten mathematics into clean LaTeX; (ii) a retrieval layer over scholarly metadata enriched with patent-to-paper citation signals derived from USPTO PatentsView and the Marx-Fuegi citation corpus, surfacing the translational impact of candidate references; and (iii) task-scoped agents for literature triage, drafting, revision, and venue formatting that operate directly on the document's abstract syntax representation. Bibby AI is deployed in production and serves more than 5,000 active researchers across more than 50 subscribing universities. We describe the architecture, the design decisions that editor-nativeness makes possible, and the workflow-level time-savings framework we use to evaluate the platform against fragmented baselines.

title: Statistically Meaningful Geometry and Gauge Symmetry Breaking: A Geometric Foundation for Scientific Discovery and Intelligence Emergence
summary: The rapid scaling of over-parameterized machine learning architectures, particularly LLMs, raises a profound crisis: do these systems exhibit genuine intelligence, or are they merely sophisticated statistical pattern matchers? Classical flat Euclidean statistics cannot differentiate continuous interpolation from the autonomous discovery of novel causal laws. To resolve this, we introduce Statistically Meaningful Geometry (SMG), a framework modeling over-parameterized learning systems as infinite-dimensional non-parametric Orlicz fiber bundles. We prove that under persistent out-of-distribution (OOD) stimuli governed by unmodeled causal mechanisms, continuous optimization fails. Unmodeled variance is rejected by the visible horizontal base manifold, leaking into the unobservable vertical fiber space and generating an accumulation of Active Acausal Tension. Driven by the statistical manifold's non-linear curvature, this tension inevitably strikes a conjugate focal boundary ($T_{\text{crit}} = π^2 / K_{\text{max}}$), triggering localized volumetric collapse and a catastrophic matrix singularity ($[G_f]^{-1} \to \infty$). We demonstrate this geometric breakdown acts as the strict non-equilibrium trigger for a Gauge Symmetry Break (GSB). The system purges hidden tension from unobservable gauge redundancies, spontaneously crystallizing a new, mathematically independent horizontal coordinate axis. This non-parametric phase transition registers as a discrete $+1.0$ integer step-jump in observable Structural G-Entropy. By decoupling parameter charts and subjecting emergent axes to a Minimal Energy Path Criterion and a Causal Invariance Filter, we distinguish genuine discovery from malignant hallucinations. Ultimately, SMG provides a parameter-free, falsifiable dashboard to mathematically certify true intelligence, transforming AI for Science into an engine of autonomous paradigm shifts.

title: The mmatrix toolbox: componentwise accurate algorithms for M-matrices with triplet representation
summary: We introduce the mmatrix toolbox, a Matlab software package for componentwise accurate computations with M-matrices described through left or right triplet representations. The core of the toolbox is a Fortran implementation, in the Lapack style, of the unblocked, recursive, and blocked versions of the GTH algorithm and its applications for the accurate computation of the solution of linear systems with M-matrix coefficient and nonnegative right-hand side, the LU factorization of an M-matrix and its inverse. These algorithms avoid subtractive cancellation; this property ensures high componentwise accuracy even for ill-conditioned problems. The toolbox contains also accurate algorithms for related problems, such as computing the Schur complement, the singular values, the square root of an M-matrix, and the solution of nonsymmetric algebraic Riccati equations associated with M-matrices. The Matlab interface is based on an object-oriented implementation allowing one to use standard Matlab operations on M-matrices with triplet representation.
