AI.title_translation: RSF-GLLM：通过循环软流和解耦LLM生成弥合多跳知识图谱问答中的语义鸿沟
AI.tldr: RSF-GLLM通过可微分的图推理和解耦的LLM生成，解决了多跳知识图谱问答中检索器无法弥合语义鸿沟的问题，实现了高效且有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 传统检索-阅读管道在多跳知识图谱问答中存在可微性问题，导致检索器无法学习弥合中间节点与查询之间缺乏词汇重叠的语义鸿沟。
AI.method: 本文提出了RSF-GLLM框架，将可微分图推理与答案生成解耦。RSF模块采用GRU引导的查询更新器传播连续相关性分数，利用动态门控机制通过结构线索遍历语义不相似的桥接节点。引入流稀疏正则化以保证从软概率到离散推理路径的收敛。提取并文本化这些路径来微调大型语言模型（LLM），确保生成基于事实拓扑。
AI.result: 在WebQSP和CWQ数据集上的实验表明，RSF-GLLM实现了有竞争力的性能，并且与基于LLM的计算昂贵方法相比，具有卓越的推理效率。
AI.conclusion: RSF-GLLM通过解耦的可微分图推理和LLM生成，有效解决了多跳知识图谱问答中的语义鸿沟问题，并在性能和效率上表现出色。
AI.translation: 多跳知识图谱问答面临一个关键挑战：传统的“检索-然后-阅读”管道破坏了可微性，阻止了检索器学习弥合语义鸿沟，即中间节点与查询缺乏词汇重叠。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了RSF-GLLM，一个将可微分图推理与答案生成解耦的框架。我们的循环软流（RSF）模块采用GRU引导的查询更新器来传播连续相关性分数，利用动态门控机制通过结构线索遍历语义不相似的桥接节点。我们引入了流稀疏正则化，从理论上保证了从软概率到离散推理路径的收敛。这些路径被提取并文本化以微调大型语言模型（LLM），确保生成基于事实拓扑。在WebQSP和CWQ上的实验表明，与基于LLM的计算昂贵方法相比，RSF-GLLM实现了有竞争力的性能和卓越的推理效率。
AI.summary: 本文提出了RSF-GLLM框架，旨在解决多跳知识图谱问答中因语义鸿沟导致检索器学习困难的问题。该框架将可微分图推理与答案生成解耦，其中RSF模块通过GRU和动态门控机制传播连续相关性分数，并利用流稀疏正则化确保推理路径的收敛。提取的路径用于微调LLM，以实现基于事实拓扑的答案生成。实验证明RSF-GLLM在性能上具有竞争力，且推理效率优于其他基于LLM的方法。
AI.keywords: 多跳知识图谱问答, 语义鸿沟, 可微分图推理, 大型语言模型, 循环软流
AI.comments: RSF-GLLM的创新之处在于其将可微分图推理与LLM生成解耦，并通过循环软流机制有效解决了多跳知识图谱问答中语义鸿沟问题，特别是在处理缺乏词汇重叠的桥接节点方面。其流稀疏正则化保证了推理的收敛性，同时在效率上超越了传统的LLM方法，具有重要的实践意义。

title: Trust-Aware Citation Cartel Ranking in Scholarly Knowledge Graphs
summary: Citation-based systems usually treat each citation as an equal signal of scholarly influence, although citations can express very different relationships: direct method use, result comparison, broad background, or weak ceremonial acknowledgement. This distinction is crucial for citation-cartel analysis because dense internal citation alone is not suspicious; legitimate research communities are also densely connected. We present a trust-aware pipeline that combines citation graph structure with semantic citation intent to rank suspicious paper-level communities for audit. On a DBLP-derived graph with 500,000 papers and 4.87M citation edges, we use an LLM teacher to label 205,897 citation pairs, train a SciBERT student, and scale citation-intent typing to 2.04M unique graph edges. We then compute a Composite Cartel Index (CCI) that integrates internal density, citation inflation, reciprocity, semantic superficiality, degree assortativity, and trust-weighted PageRank shift. The highest-ranked community contains 1,079 papers and 8,603 internal citations, with 254.3x more internal citations than expected and 64.2% of them superficial. Comparisons against density-only, inflation-only, semantic-only, and random baselines show that CCI cannot be reduced to a single heuristic. Edge excision validation further shows that CCI-selected communities behave differently from matched random removals. The result is a reproducible, curator-facing ranking framework for prioritising communities that warrant closer inspection.

AI.title_translation: 学术知识图谱中基于信任的引文卡特尔排名
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种信任感知的管道，结合引文图结构和语义引文意图，对可疑的论文级社区进行排名，以识别引文卡特尔。通过LLM和SciBERT对引文意图进行分类，并计算综合卡特尔指数（CCI），该指数在识别高排名的可疑社区方面优于单一启发式方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于引文的系统通常将每次引文视为学术影响的平等信号，但引文可以表达非常不同的关系。这种区别对于引文卡特尔分析至关重要，因为仅凭密集的内部引文并不足以判断可疑性；合法的研究社区也可能紧密相连。因此，需要一个能够区分引文类型并识别真正可疑引文卡特尔的方法。
AI.method: 该研究提出了一个信任感知的管道，结合引文图结构和语义引文意图来排名可疑的论文级社区。具体方法包括：1) 在一个包含50万篇论文和4.87M引文边的DBLP衍生图上，使用LLM教师标注205,897对引文，然后训练一个SciBERT学生模型，将引文意图分类扩展到2.04M独特的图边。2) 计算一个综合卡特尔指数（CCI），该指数整合了内部密度、引文膨胀、互惠性、语义肤浅性、度同配性和信任加权PageRank漂移。
AI.result: 最高排名的社区包含1,079篇论文和8,603个内部引文，其内部引文比预期多254.3倍，其中64.2%是肤浅的。与仅基于密度、仅基于膨胀、仅基于语义和随机基线的比较表明，CCI不能简化为单一启发式方法。边切除验证进一步表明，CCI选择的社区与匹配的随机删除行为不同。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一个可复现、面向策展人的排名框架，用于优先处理值得进一步审查的社区。该框架通过整合引文图结构和语义引文意图，有效地识别了学术知识图谱中的引文卡特尔。
AI.translation: 基于引文的系统通常将每次引文视为学术影响的平等信号，尽管引文可以表达非常不同的关系：直接方法使用、结果比较、广泛背景或微弱的礼仪性承认。这种区别对于引文卡特尔分析至关重要，因为仅凭密集的内部引文本身并不值得怀疑；合法的研究社区也紧密相连。我们提出了一个信任感知的管道，结合引文图结构和语义引文意图，对可疑的论文级社区进行排名以供审计。在一个包含50万篇论文和4.87M引文边的DBLP衍生图上，我们使用一个LLM教师来标注205,897对引文，训练一个SciBERT学生模型，并将引文意图分类扩展到2.04M独特的图边。然后，我们计算一个综合卡特尔指数（CCI），该指数整合了内部密度、引文膨胀、互惠性、语义肤浅性、度同配性和信任加权PageRank漂移。最高排名的社区包含1,079篇论文和8,603个内部引文，其内部引文比预期多254.3倍，其中64.2%是肤浅的。与仅基于密度、仅基于膨胀、仅基于语义和随机基线的比较表明，CCI不能简化为单一启发式方法。边切除验证进一步表明，CCI选择的社区与匹配的随机删除行为不同。结果是一个可复现、面向策展人的排名框架，用于优先处理值得 closer inspection 的社区。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一个名为“信任感知管道”的新框架，用于在学术知识图谱中识别和排名引文卡特尔。该框架通过结合引文图结构和引文的语义意图来解决传统引文分析中将所有引文视为同等信号的局限性。具体而言，它利用大型语言模型（LLM）和SciBERT对引文意图进行分类，并开发了一个综合卡特尔指数（CCI），该指数考虑了多种结构和语义特征。实验结果表明，CCI能够有效识别出高度可疑的引文社区，且其性能优于单一的启发式方法，为学术审查提供了可复现的工具。
AI.keywords: 引文卡特尔, 学术知识图谱, 信任感知, 引文意图, 综合卡特尔指数
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将引文的语义意图与图结构分析相结合，以更精确地识别引文卡特尔，这超越了传统方法仅关注引文数量或网络密度的局限性。利用LLM作为教师模型来训练SciBERT进行大规模引文意图分类，展示了在学术数据分析中结合先进NLP技术的潜力。CCI的构建考虑了多个维度，使其鲁棒性更强。该框架对于维护学术诚信、帮助期刊编辑和机构审计具有重要意义。

title: Life Style Levels: Neighborhood Delineation using Geospatial Data
summary: Fine-scale socioeconomic information is often unavailable across rapidly ur-banizing regions of the developing world, like India, limiting the ability to delineate intra-urban variations in affluence and deprivation. This study pro-poses a scalable, grid-based urban delineation framework using building morphology derived from open-source satellite imagery. Urban areas across 59 Indian cities and towns are partitioned into high-resolution spatial grids and characterized using interpretable morphological indicators, which are combined into a transparent, rule-based scoring framework to delineate areas with contrasting levels of urban affluence. The resulting classifications are validated through ground-level Google Street View observations, revealing a sharp contrast between the grid classes which are consistent with the ex-pected effects of the lifestyle affluence indicators. We further investigate density-based clustering of building footprints in Mumbai to identify dense urban settlements, demonstrating that the resulting clusters exhibit substan-tial spatial overlap with known informal settlements across the city. Finally, we conduct an exploratory analysis mapping consumer loan delinquency across the derived affluence classes. By relying entirely on publicly available geospatial data, the proposed framework provides a scalable, interpretable, and cost-effective approach for granular urban affluence mapping across In-dian cities.

AI.title_translation: 生活方式水平：使用地理空间数据进行社区划定
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种可扩展的、基于网格的城市划定框架，利用开源卫星图像的建筑形态来绘制印度城市的城市富裕程度，并验证了其有效性，同时识别了非正式住区并分析了消费贷款拖欠情况。
AI.motivation: 在印度等发展中世界快速城市化的地区，精细的社会经济信息通常不可用，这限制了划定城市内部贫富差异的能力。
AI.method: 该研究提出了一种可扩展的、基于网格的城市划定框架，利用开源卫星图像的建筑形态。将59个印度城市和城镇的城市区域划分为高分辨率空间网格，并使用可解释的形态指标进行表征。这些指标结合到一个透明的、基于规则的评分框架中，以划定具有不同城市富裕水平的区域。通过地面谷歌街景观察验证分类结果，并进一步调查孟买建筑足迹的基于密度的聚类以识别密集的城市住区。最后，对衍生的富裕阶层中的消费贷款拖欠情况进行探索性分析。
AI.result: 分类结果通过地面谷歌街景观察得到验证，揭示了网格类别之间的鲜明对比，这与生活方式富裕指标的预期效果一致。基于密度的聚类结果显示与孟买已知的非正式住区存在实质性的空间重叠。该框架提供了一种可扩展、可解释且经济高效的方法，用于印度城市精细的城市富裕度测绘。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的完全依赖于公开可用的地理空间数据的框架，为印度城市精细的城市富裕度测绘提供了一种可扩展、可解释且经济高效的方法。
AI.translation: 发展中世界（如印度）快速城市化地区通常缺乏精细的社会经济信息，这限制了划分城市内部贫富差异的能力。本研究提出了一种可扩展的、基于网格的城市划定框架，利用开源卫星图像衍生的建筑形态。印度59个城市和城镇的城市区域被划分为高分辨率空间网格，并使用可解释的形态指标进行表征，这些指标结合到一个透明的、基于规则的评分框架中，以划定具有不同城市富裕水平的区域。所得分类通过地面谷歌街景观察进行验证，揭示了网格类别之间与生活方式富裕指标预期效果一致的鲜明对比。我们进一步调查了孟买建筑足迹的基于密度的聚类，以识别密集的城市住区，结果表明所得聚类与该市已知的非正式住区存在实质性的空间重叠。最后，我们对衍生的富裕阶层中的消费贷款拖欠情况进行了探索性分析。通过完全依赖公开可用的地理空间数据，所提出的框架为印度城市精细的城市富裕度测绘提供了一种可扩展、可解释且经济高效的方法。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种可扩展的、基于网格的城市划定框架，利用开源卫星图像导出的建筑形态来解决发展中国家缺乏精细社会经济信息的问题。该框架将印度59个城市划分为高分辨率网格，并使用形态指标和基于规则的评分系统来划定城市富裕水平。分类结果通过谷歌街景验证，并发现与生活方式富裕指标一致的显著对比。此外，研究还通过建筑足迹的密度聚类识别了孟买的非正式住区，并分析了不同富裕阶层中的消费贷款拖欠情况。该方法完全依赖公开地理空间数据，提供了一种可扩展、可解释且经济高效的城市富裕度测绘方案。
AI.keywords: 地理空间数据, 城市划定, 建筑形态, 印度城市, 富裕度测绘
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于利用开源卫星图像和建筑形态数据，构建了一个可扩展且经济高效的城市划定框架，以解决发展中国家精细社会经济信息不足的问题。其方法论透明且可解释，并通过多重验证（谷歌街景和与已知非正式住区的重叠）增强了结果的可靠性。该研究对于城市规划、政策制定以及理解城市内部贫富差距具有重要意义。

title: The Large Cancer Assistant (LCA): A Model-Agnostic Orchestration Framework for Scalable Clinical Decision Support in Oncology
comments: 22 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables, 9 appendices, 14 references, Elsevier JBI format
summary: - Objective: Multimodal deep learning models in oncology are currently limited by monolithic designs that rigidly couple data ingestion, clinical routing, and artificial intelligence (AI) inference. To address this inflexibility, we propose the Large Cancer Assistant (LCA), a model-agnostic, post-hoc orchestration framework designed for scalable clinical decision support. - Methods: The LCA is mathematically formalized as a 7-tuple architecture grounded in the principle of Algorithmic Impermeability, ensuring the orchestration logic remains strictly independent of underlying black-box AI models. We introduce the Entry Theory, leveraging Geometric Deep Learning (GDL) to standardize multimodal patient data along distinct structural and medical axes. The system dynamically orchestrates data via a Cancer Switching Module and intentionally isolates the core AI execution from volatile hospital IT infrastructures by outputting a Standardized Intermediate Payload (SIP). - Results: A Proof of Concept (PoC) validated the orchestration logic across four technical scenarios. The framework executed a nominal flow with negligible orchestration overhead. It empirically demonstrated algorithmic impermeability by maintaining an invariant routing projection during AI model swaps, and it validated strict failure-safety by achieving a 100\% recall rate in generating targeted Supplementary Data Requests (SDR) under injected data anomalies. Multi-protocol execution capability was also successfully verified. - Conclusion: By structurally decoupling multimodal ingestion from feature inference, the LCA provides a highly adaptable and modular orchestration foundation. The SIP establishes a clear architectural boundary, natively setting the stage for downstream Electronic Medical Record (EMR) interoperability as an independent future paradigm.

AI.title_translation: 大型癌症助手（LCA）：一个用于肿瘤学中可扩展临床决策支持的模型无关编排框架
AI.tldr: LCA是一个模型无关的编排框架，旨在通过解耦数据摄取和AI推理，为肿瘤学提供可扩展的临床决策支持，解决了现有模型设计僵化的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的肿瘤学多模态深度学习模型受限于整体式设计，将数据摄取、临床路由和AI推理紧密耦合，导致灵活性不足。为解决这一问题，本文提出了大型癌症助手（LCA）框架。
AI.method: LCA被数学形式化为基于“算法不渗透性”原则的7元组架构，确保编排逻辑独立于底层黑盒AI模型。它引入了“入口理论”，利用几何深度学习（GDL）标准化多模态患者数据。系统通过“癌症切换模块”动态编排数据，并通过输出“标准化中间载荷”（SIP）将核心AI执行与医院IT基础设施隔离。
AI.result: 概念验证（PoC）验证了LCA在四种技术场景下的编排逻辑，编排开销可忽略不计。它通过在AI模型交换期间保持不变的路由投影，经验性地证明了算法不渗透性；通过在注入数据异常时实现100%召回率生成目标补充数据请求（SDR），验证了严格的故障安全性。多协议执行能力也得到了成功验证。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构性地解耦多模态摄取与特征推理，LCA提供了一个高度适应性和模块化的编排基础。标准化中间载荷（SIP）建立了清晰的架构边界，为下游电子病历（EMR）互操作性奠定了基础，使其成为一个独立的未来范式。
AI.translation:
- 目的：肿瘤学中的多模态深度学习模型目前受到整体式设计的限制，这些设计将数据摄取、临床路由和人工智能（AI）推理僵化地耦合在一起。为了解决这种不灵活性，我们提出了大型癌症助手（LCA），一个模型无关的后验编排框架，旨在实现可扩展的临床决策支持。
- 方法：LCA被数学形式化为基于算法不渗透性原则的7元组架构，确保编排逻辑严格独立于底层的黑盒AI模型。我们引入了入口理论，利用几何深度学习（GDL）沿不同的结构和医学轴标准化多模态患者数据。该系统通过癌症切换模块动态编排数据，并通过输出标准化中间载荷（SIP）将核心AI执行有意地与不稳定的医院IT基础设施隔离。
- 结果：一个概念验证（PoC）验证了四种技术场景下的编排逻辑。该框架以可忽略的编排开销执行了名义流。它通过在AI模型交换期间保持不变的路由投影，经验性地证明了算法不渗透性，并通过在注入数据异常时实现100%的召回率生成目标补充数据请求（SDR），验证了严格的故障安全性。多协议执行能力也得到了成功验证。
- 结论：通过结构性地解耦多模态摄取与特征推理，LCA提供了一个高度适应性和模块化的编排基础。SIP建立了清晰的架构边界，原生为下游电子病历（EMR）互操作性奠定了一个独立的未来范式。
AI.summary: 本文提出了大型癌症助手（LCA），一个模型无关的编排框架，旨在解决肿瘤学中多模态深度学习模型因僵化耦合数据摄取、临床路由和AI推理而导致的设计局限性。LCA采用7元组架构，基于算法不渗透性原则，利用几何深度学习标准化数据，并通过标准化中间载荷（SIP）隔离AI执行。概念验证结果表明，LCA具有低开销、算法不渗透性、严格的故障安全性和多协议执行能力，为肿瘤学提供了适应性强、模块化的临床决策支持基础，并为EMR互操作性奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: 肿瘤学, 临床决策支持, 模型无关, 编排框架, 算法不渗透性
AI.comments: LCA框架的创新之处在于其“模型无关”和“算法不渗透性”设计，通过解耦核心AI模型与编排逻辑及IT基础设施，显著提升了临床决策支持系统的灵活性、可扩展性和鲁棒性。特别是SIP的引入，为未来与EMR系统的无缝集成提供了清晰的架构边界，具有重要的实践意义和前瞻性。

title: GraphBU: MILP Instance Generation with Graph-Native Block Units
summary: Mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) instances used for solver development are hard to obtain when models come from private or application-specific pipelines. A generator must keep the structure that solvers and learned policies rely on. Existing general generators usually choose their generation unit from a formulation template, summary statistics, local graph edits, or blocks found after recombination. These units do not explicitly record how a local part of the MILP is coupled to the rest of the instance. We propose GraphBU, a graph-native generator whose basic unit is a local subproblem plus its interface. The method promotes coupling nodes into master constraints or boundary variables and uses the resulting block units for compatibility-checked replacement. The analysis focuses on the properties needed by this construction: promotion separates interfaces, replacement can preserve feasibility under an interface-slack condition, and the graph construction is invariant to row-column permutations. On MILP instances generation, this unit keeps graph statistics close to the source family, preserves feasibility on most datasets, and improves downstream Predict-and-Search training. Genrated by GraphBU, The average graph-statistical similarity was approximately 0.934, the average feasibility was approximately 96.7%, and the average increase in the main index of downstream PS was approximately 8.0%.

AI.title_translation: GraphBU：使用图原生块单元生成MILP实例
AI.tldr: GraphBU是一种使用图原生块单元生成MILP实例的新方法，它能保持结构特性并改善下游训练。
AI.motivation: 用于求解器开发的混合整数线性规划（MILP）实例在模型来源于私有或特定应用管线时难以获取。现有通用生成器未能显式记录MILP局部如何与实例其他部分耦合。
AI.method: 提出GraphBU，一种图原生生成器，其基本单位是局部子问题及其接口。该方法将耦合节点提升为主约束或边界变量，并使用由此产生的块单元进行兼容性检查的替换。分析了其属性：提升分离接口，在接口松弛条件下替换可以保持可行性，且图结构对行列置换不变。
AI.result: GraphBU生成的MILP实例在图统计数据上接近源族，在大多数数据集上保持可行性，并改善了下游预测搜索训练。具体数据包括平均图统计相似度约0.934，平均可行性约96.7%，下游PS主要指标平均提升约8.0%。
AI.conclusion: GraphBU是一种有效的图原生MILP实例生成器，通过显式建模局部与整体的耦合，克服了现有方法的局限性，生成了高质量的实例，有利于求解器开发和学习策略。
AI.translation: 用于求解器开发的混合整数线性规划（MILP）实例在模型来源于私有或特定应用管线时难以获取。生成器必须保持求解器和学习策略所依赖的结构。现有通用生成器通常从公式模板、汇总统计数据、局部图编辑或重组后发现的块中选择其生成单元。这些单元没有明确记录MILP的局部如何与实例的其余部分耦合。我们提出了GraphBU，一个图原生生成器，其基本单元是局部子问题加上其接口。该方法将耦合节点提升为主约束或边界变量，并使用由此产生的块单元进行兼容性检查的替换。分析侧重于此构造所需的属性：提升分离接口，在接口松弛条件下替换可以保持可行性，并且图构造对行列置换是不变的。在MILP实例生成方面，该单元使图统计数据接近源族，在大多数数据集上保持可行性，并改善了下游预测搜索训练。由GraphBU生成，平均图统计相似度约为0.934，平均可行性约为96.7%，下游PS主要指标平均增加约为8.0%。
AI.summary: GraphBU通过提出一种以局部子问题及其接口为基本单元的图原生生成器，解决了MILP实例生成难题。该方法显式建模了局部与整体的耦合方式，实现了兼容性检查的替换。它保持了结构特性，保证了可行性，并改善了下游训练，实现了高统计相似度和可行性。
AI.keywords: 混合整数线性规划, MILP实例生成, 图原生, 块单元, 求解器开发
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了“图原生块单元”并显式建模了“局部子问题加接口”来捕捉MILP局部与整体的耦合，这是现有生成器未能有效处理的问题。这对于MILP实例生成，特别是难以获取实例的应用场景，是一个重要的进步，有望提升求解器开发和学习策略的效率和质量。

title: Quantum-inspired methods for finite-element discretizations of the high-dimensional Poisson equation
summary: In recent years, quantum linear system algorithms have been applied to partial differential equations (PDEs), particularly in high-dimensional settings, demonstrating an exponential speedup in dimension. Concurrently, randomized and quantum-inspired classical linear solvers have emerged, showing computational complexity comparable to their quantum counterparts in many application areas. In this paper, we investigate the applicability of these quantum-inspired classical algorithms to PDEs. We provide both upper and lower bounds on their computational complexity, proving that these methods cannot achieve exponential speedup in dimension for discretizations of high-dimensional Poisson problems. Our theoretical findings definitively demonstrate that quantum-inspired classical algorithms are not competitive with quantum algorithms for solving PDEs, confirming that quantum methods retain a significant advantage for high-dimensional problems.

AI.title_translation: 高维泊松方程有限元离散化的量子启发方法
AI.tldr: 量子启发式经典算法在高维泊松方程离散化中无法实现指数级加速，不如量子算法。
AI.motivation: 量子线性系统算法在处理高维偏微分方程(PDEs)时展现出指数级加速。同时，量子启发式经典线性求解器在许多应用中显示出与量子算法相当的计算复杂性。本文旨在探究这些量子启发式经典算法是否适用于PDEs，并能否保持指数级加速。
AI.method: 本文研究了量子启发式经典算法在偏微分方程上的适用性。通过在高维泊松问题离散化中，对这些方法的计算复杂性给出了上限和下限的理论证明。
AI.result: 理论研究表明，这些量子启发式经典方法无法在高维泊松问题离散化中实现维度的指数级加速。
AI.conclusion: 量子启发式经典算法在解决偏微分方程方面不具备与量子算法的竞争力，证实了量子方法在高维问题中保留了显著优势。
AI.translation: 近年来，量子线性系统算法已被应用于偏微分方程（PDEs），特别是在高维环境中，展示了维度的指数级加速。与此同时，随机化和量子启发式经典线性求解器也应运而生，在许多应用领域显示出与量子对应算法相当的计算复杂性。在本文中，我们研究了这些量子启发式经典算法对PDEs的适用性。我们提供了其计算复杂度的上限和下限，证明这些方法无法在高维泊松问题离散化中实现维度的指数级加速。我们的理论发现明确表明，量子启发式经典算法在解决PDEs方面不具备与量子算法的竞争力，证实了量子方法在高维问题中保留了显著优势。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了量子启发式经典算法在高维偏微分方程（特别是泊松方程）中的应用。尽管量子算法在PDEs中展示了维度的指数级加速，且量子启发式经典求解器在其他领域表现出与量子算法相当的复杂性，本研究通过理论分析给出了这些量子启发式方法的计算复杂度的上下限。结论是，这些方法无法在高维泊松问题中实现指数级加速，从而证实了真正的量子算法在此类问题中具有显著优势。
AI.keywords: 量子启发算法, 偏微分方程, 泊松方程, 计算复杂度, 量子优势
AI.comments: 该论文为量子启发式经典算法在高维偏微分方程领域的局限性提供了关键的理论见解。它有助于澄清真正的量子优势所在，防止对经典近似的过度估计，并指导未来的研究方向，聚焦于量子方法真正具有卓越性能的问题。

title: CAIRN: Cross-Room 3D Scene Understanding with Topology-Aware Large Multimodal Models
summary: Existing 3D scene-grounded Large Language Models (3D-LLMs) focus on answering questions grounded in simplified single-room 3D scenes, lacking the ability to reason over real-world household environments containing multiple interconnected rooms and diverse object categories. We introduce CAIRN, a topology-aware 3D-LLM for multi-room 3D scene understanding. CAIRN aligns transformer attention with scene hierarchy, giving the model explicit awareness of object-level relations and room-level connectivity. It enriches object tokens with room-local relational context via a graph neural network, introduces learned room tokens for room-level abstraction, and applies a hierarchical attention mask with geometric bias to route information according to scene topology. CAIRN is developed on CAIRN-MR, a benchmark we introduce on HM3D for multi-room 3D scene understanding, covering grounding, captioning, and four question-answering tasks that progressively evaluate from intra-room perception to cross-room reasoning. Experiments show that CAIRN outperforms prior 3D-LLMs by a large margin across all CAIRN-MR tasks while remaining competitive on five single-room benchmarks.

AI.title_translation: CAIRN：基于拓扑感知的多模态大模型实现跨房间3D场景理解
AI.tldr: CAIRN是一个拓扑感知的3D-LLM，用于多房间3D场景理解，通过对场景层次结构对齐Transformer注意力，并在新的CAIRN-MR基准测试中显著优于现有模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D场景接地大语言模型（3D-LLMs）专注于简化后的单房间3D场景，缺乏对包含多个互连房间和多样对象类别的真实世界家庭环境进行推理的能力。
AI.method: CAIRN通过以下方式实现：1) 将Transformer注意力与场景层次结构对齐，使其明确感知对象级关系和房间级连接。2) 通过图神经网络丰富对象token的房间局部关系上下文。3) 引入学习到的房间token进行房间级抽象。4) 应用具有几何偏差的分层注意力掩码，根据场景拓扑路由信息。CAIRN在HM3D上引入的CAIRN-MR基准上开发。
AI.result: CAIRN在所有CAIRN-MR任务中均大幅优于先前的3D-LLMs，同时在五个单房间基准测试中保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: CAIRN通过拓扑感知设计，显著提升了3D-LLMs在多房间3D场景理解方面的能力，并在新基准测试中表现出色。
AI.translation: 现有3D场景接地大语言模型（3D-LLMs）专注于回答基于简化单房间3D场景的问题，缺乏对包含多个互连房间和多样对象类别的真实世界家庭环境进行推理的能力。我们引入了CAIRN，一个用于多房间3D场景理解的拓扑感知3D-LLM。CAIRN将Transformer注意力与场景层次结构对齐，使模型明确感知对象级关系和房间级连接。它通过图神经网络丰富了对象token的房间局部关系上下文，引入了学习到的房间token进行房间级抽象，并应用了具有几何偏差的分层注意力掩码，以根据场景拓扑路由信息。CAIRN是在CAIRN-MR上开发的，这是我们在HM3D上引入的一个用于多房间3D场景理解的基准，涵盖了接地、描述和四个问答任务，这些任务逐步评估从房间内感知到跨房间推理的能力。实验表明，CAIRN在所有CAIRN-MR任务中均大幅优于先前的3D-LLMs，同时在五个单房间基准测试中保持竞争力。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了CAIRN，一个拓扑感知的3D-LLM，旨在解决现有模型在多房间3D场景理解方面的局限性。CAIRN通过将Transformer注意力与场景层次结构对齐，并引入图神经网络、学习到的房间token和分层注意力掩码来增强模型的拓扑感知能力。该模型在一个新引入的CAIRN-MR基准上进行了开发和评估，实验结果表明CAIRN在多房间任务中显著优于现有3D-LLMs，并在单房间任务中保持竞争力。
AI.keywords: 3D场景理解, 拓扑感知, 多模态大模型, 多房间环境, CAIRN
AI.comments: CAIRN的创新之处在于其拓扑感知设计，通过显式地将场景层次结构（对象级关系和房间级连接）整合到模型中，克服了现有3D-LLMs在复杂多房间环境中的推理限制。引入CAIRN-MR基准也为未来研究提供了重要的评估工具。这对于推动3D场景理解在真实世界应用中的发展具有重要意义。

title: Neural-ESO: A Dual-Pathway Architecture for Provably Robust Learning-Based Control
summary: A learning-enabled disturbance-rejection framework based on a Neural Extended State Observer (Neural-ESO) is presented in this letter. Unlike existing learning-based control methods that largely rely on the learned model once deployed, Neural-ESO adopts a dual-pathway architecture: a predictive pathway uses a neural network to provide a feedforward disturbance estimate that accelerates convergence, while a corrective pathway employs a conventional ESO to compensate prediction errors and prevent over-reliance on the neural component. Using Lyapunov theory and a small-gain analysis, we show that enforcing a Lipschitz bound on the learning component guarantees uniform ultimate boundedness of the closed-loop error dynamics. The proposed framework is validated on a quadrotor landing task subject to strong ground-effect disturbances across normal and out-of-distribution scenarios, demonstrating accuracy-robustness trade-off and greater operational reliability during training, deployment, and transfer compared with state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.title_translation: 神经扩展状态观测器：一种可证明鲁棒的基于学习的控制双通路架构
AI.tldr: Neural-ESO是一种基于学习的扰动抑制框架，采用双通路架构（神经网络进行预测，传统ESO进行校正），提供可证明的鲁棒性保证，并在四旋翼着陆任务中表现出更高的操作可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于学习的控制方法在部署后过度依赖学习模型，本研究旨在解决这一问题，提高学习型控制系统的鲁棒性和可靠性。
AI.method: 本研究提出了Neural-ESO，一种双通路架构的扰动抑制框架。其中，一个预测通路使用神经网络提供前馈扰动估计以加速收敛，而一个校正通路则采用传统的扩展状态观测器（ESO）来补偿预测误差并防止过度依赖神经网络组件。通过李雅普诺夫理论和小增益分析，证明了对学习组件施加Lipschitz界限可保证闭环误差动力学的均匀最终有界性。
AI.result: 对学习组件施加Lipschitz界限可以保证闭环误差动力学的均匀最终有界性。该框架在受到强地面效应扰动的四旋翼飞行器着陆任务中进行了验证，在正常和超出分布场景下，与现有最先进的基线相比，展示了精度-鲁棒性权衡和在训练、部署和传输过程中更高的操作可靠性。
AI.conclusion: Neural-ESO框架提供了一种可证明鲁棒的基于学习的控制解决方案，具有增强的操作可靠性和改进的精度-鲁棒性权衡，解决了现有方法过度依赖学习模型的局限性。
AI.translation: 这篇论文提出了一种基于神经扩展状态观测器（Neural-ESO）的、支持学习的扰动抑制框架。与现有的大多数在部署后严重依赖学习模型的基于学习的控制方法不同，Neural-ESO 采用了双通路架构：一个预测通路使用神经网络提供前馈扰动估计以加速收敛，而一个校正通路则采用传统的 ESO 来补偿预测误差并防止过度依赖神经网络组件。通过李雅普诺夫理论和小增益分析，我们证明对学习组件施加 Lipschitz 界限可以保证闭环误差动力学的均匀最终有界性。所提出的框架在四旋翼飞行器着陆任务中进行了验证，该任务受到正常和超出分布场景下的强地面效应扰动，与最先进的基线相比，它在训练、部署和传输过程中展示了精度-鲁棒性权衡和更高的操作可靠性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为Neural-ESO的、支持学习的扰动抑制框架，它采用双通路架构以增强基于学习的控制的鲁棒性。该架构结合了用于前馈扰动估计的神经网络（加速收敛）和用于误差校正的传统扩展状态观测器（ESO），从而减轻了对神经网络组件的过度依赖。通过李雅普诺夫理论和小增益分析，并通过对学习组件施加Lipschitz界限，该框架提供了可证明的稳定性保证。在具有强扰动的四旋翼飞行器着陆任务上的验证表明，与现有方法相比，Neural-ESO展示了改进的精度-鲁棒性权衡和更高的操作可靠性。
AI.keywords: Neural-ESO, 双通路架构, 鲁棒控制, 基于学习的控制, 扩展状态观测器
AI.comments: Neural-ESO的双通路架构，将神经网络的加速能力与传统ESO的鲁棒性相结合，是一项显著的创新。通过李雅普诺夫理论和小增益分析实现可证明的鲁棒性，解决了基于学习的控制中一个关键的安全问题，使其在安全关键型应用中特别有价值。它在超出分布场景下的良好表现进一步凸显了其在实际应用中的重要性。

title: UniLM-Nav: A Unified Framework for Zero-Shot Last-Mile Navigation
summary: Mobile manipulation requires a robot to navigate to a target object or receptacle and then perform intended manipulation. However, reaching the vicinity of the target does not guarantee a manipulation-ready base pose, a problem known as last-mile navigation. Prior methods for last-mile navigation either rely on manual pose annotation or task-specific training, limiting their scalability to open-vocabulary settings with fine-grained spatial constraints. We propose UniLM-Nav, a unified framework for zero-shot open-vocabulary last-mile navigation. UniLM-Nav decomposes last-mile navigation into view selection, task-conditioned affordance grounding, and geometry-aware base-pose reasoning, all resolved with a shared multimodal large language model (MLLM) backend. Specifically, UniLM-Nav first selects a reference view that best captures the target object or receptacle from recently collected observations. It then grounds task-relevant affordance point in the selected view and lifts the result into the robot-centric coordinate frame. Finally, conditioned on the grounded affordance, task context, and robot geometry, it infers a manipulation-ready base pose for the robot. We evaluate UniLM-Nav on the OVMM benchmark, where it outperforms the previous state-of-the-art method, MoTo, by 3.13 percentage points. Analyses show that the components of our method are crucial to final performance, and that the choice of MLLM also has a substantial effect. We further deploy UniLM-Nav on a Unitree B2 quadruped robot with a 6-DoF Unitree Z1 manipulator, validating its applicability to real-world mobile manipulation tasks.

AI.title_translation: UniLM-Nav：零样本最后一英里导航的统一框架
AI.tldr: UniLM-Nav是一个统一框架，利用多模态大语言模型实现零样本开放词汇最后一英里导航，通过分解任务并优于现有技术。
AI.motivation: 移动操作机器人需要导航到目标并执行操作，但到达目标附近并不保证操作就绪的姿态，即“最后一英里导航”问题。现有方法依赖手动标注或特定任务训练，限制了其在开放词汇和精细空间约束下的可扩展性。
AI.method: UniLM-Nav是一个统一的零样本开放词汇最后一英里导航框架。它将任务分解为视图选择、任务条件下的可供性基础化和几何感知的基础姿态推理。所有这些都由一个共享的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）后端解决。具体步骤包括：1) 从最近的观察中选择最佳参考视图；2) 在选定视图中将任务相关的可供性点基础化并转换为机器人坐标系；3) 根据基础化的可供性、任务上下文和机器人几何形状推断操作就绪的基础姿态。
AI.result: 在OVMM基准测试中，UniLM-Nav超越了现有最先进方法MoTo 3.13个百分点。分析表明，该方法的组件和MLLM的选择对最终性能至关重要。UniLM-Nav已成功部署在Unitree B2四足机器人上，验证了其在真实世界移动操作任务中的适用性。
AI.conclusion: UniLM-Nav通过其统一框架和多模态大语言模型后端，有效解决了零样本开放词汇最后一英里导航的挑战，并在基准测试和真实世界应用中展现出优越性能和实用性。
AI.translation: 移动操作要求机器人导航到目标物体或容器，然后执行预期的操作。然而，到达目标附近并不能保证一个操作就绪的基础姿态，这个问题被称为“最后一英里导航”。以往的最后一英里导航方法要么依赖手动姿态标注，要么依赖特定任务训练，这限制了它们在具有精细空间约束的开放词汇环境中的可扩展性。我们提出了UniLM-Nav，一个用于零样本开放词汇最后一英里导航的统一框架。UniLM-Nav将最后一英里导航分解为视图选择、任务条件下的可供性基础化和几何感知的基础姿态推理，所有这些都通过一个共享的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）后端解决。具体来说，UniLM-Nav首先从最近收集的观察中选择一个最能捕捉目标物体或容器的参考视图。然后，它在选定的视图中将任务相关的可供性点基础化，并将结果提升到以机器人为中心的坐标系中。最后，根据基础化的可供性、任务上下文和机器人几何形状，它推断出机器人操作就绪的基础姿态。我们在OVMM基准测试中评估了UniLM-Nav，它比以前最先进的方法MoTo高出3.13个百分点。分析表明，我们方法的组件对最终性能至关重要，并且MLLM的选择也具有实质性影响。我们进一步将UniLM-Nav部署在Unitree B2四足机器人上，配备6自由度Unitree Z1机械手，验证了其在真实世界移动操作任务中的适用性。
AI.summary: 本论文提出了UniLM-Nav，一个用于零样本开放词汇最后一英里导航的统一框架。该框架通过一个共享的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）后端，将最后一英里导航分解为视图选择、任务条件下的可供性基础化和几何感知的基础姿态推理。UniLM-Nav在OVMM基准测试中表现优异，超越现有技术3.13个百分点，并成功部署于真实世界的移动操作机器人，验证了其有效性和实用性。
AI.keywords: 最后一英里导航, 零样本, 开放词汇, 多模态大语言模型, 移动操作
AI.comments: UniLM-Nav的创新之处在于其统一的框架和对多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的利用，实现了零样本开放词汇的最后一英里导航，显著提升了机器人在复杂环境下的操作能力。通过将任务分解为可管理的子问题，并利用MLLM的强大泛化能力，克服了传统方法对手动标注和特定任务训练的依赖，极大地提高了可扩展性。其在真实机器人上的成功部署进一步证明了其实用价值。

title: Hierarchical Acoustic-Semantic Modeling: Modality Separation and Semantic Coherence for Full-Duplex SLMs
summary: Developing seamless, high-performance, native intelligent full-duplex Spoken Language Models (SLMs) remains a critical challenge and long-standing goal for the speech and NLP community. Despite notable progress, recent endeavors are fundamentally constrained by severe modality interference, which causes substantial knowledge degradation and compromises semantic integrity -- ultimately making full-duplex SLMs feel unnatural and unintelligent. In this paper, through an exhaustive fine-grained analysis of model optimization dynamics, we uncover the root cause of such performance degradation, revealing that modality interference arises from inherent gradient conflicts between acoustic and semantic modeling when the two modalities are forced to share a deep parameter space. Guided by this key insight, we introduce Lychee-FD, a native end-to-end full-duplex framework designed to mitigate modality interference. Importantly, we propose a hierarchical parameter separation strategy that decouples conflicting modalities in deep layers while preserving cross-modality coherence via a dedicated semantic alignment channel. Extensive experiments on multiple full-duplex benchmarks demonstrate that our method significantly advances the state of the art, yielding substantial improvements in both speech intelligence (+7.4% on Spoken QA) and full-duplex interaction fluidity (+28.5% on FullDuplexBench 1.5) without compromising inference efficiency. To the best of our knowledge, this work is the first to achieve two key advances: 1) uncovering and elucidating the root cause of modality interference in full-duplex SLMs, and 2) designing an elegant hierarchical model together with a practical solution for seamless, high-performance, native intelligent full-duplex SLMs.

AI.title_translation: 分层声学-语义建模：用于全双工SLM的模态分离和语义连贯性
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为Lychee-FD的新型全双工语音语言模型（SLM）框架，通过分层参数分离策略解决了模态干扰问题，显著提高了语音问答和全双工交互的性能，同时保持了推理效率。
AI.motivation: 当前全双工语音语言模型（SLM）面临严重的模态干扰问题，导致知识退化和语义完整性受损，使得模型表现不自然、不智能。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为Lychee-FD的端到端全双工框架，采用分层参数分离策略，在深层解耦冲突模态，并通过专门的语义对齐通道保持跨模态连贯性。
AI.result: 在多个全双工基准测试中，Lychee-FD显著提高了语音智能（语音问答+7.4%）和全双工交互流畅度（FullDuplexBench 1.5+28.5%），同时没有影响推理效率。
AI.conclusion: Lychee-FD是首个揭示全双工SLM模态干扰根源并提出优雅分层模型及实用解决方案的工作，实现了无缝、高性能、原生智能的全双工SLM。
AI.translation: 开发无缝、高性能、原生的智能全双工语音语言模型（SLM）仍然是语音和自然语言处理社区的一个关键挑战和长期目标。尽管取得了显著进展，但最近的努力受到严重模态干扰的根本限制，这会导致严重的知识退化并损害语义完整性——最终使全双工SLM感觉不自然、不智能。在本研究中，通过对模型优化动态进行详尽的细粒度分析，我们揭示了这种性能下降的根本原因，表明当两种模态被迫共享深层参数空间时，模态干扰源于声学和语义建模之间固有的梯度冲突。基于这一关键见解，我们引入了Lychee-FD，一个原生的端到端全双工框架，旨在减轻模态干扰。重要的是，我们提出了一种分层参数分离策略，该策略在深层中分离冲突的模态，同时通过专用的语义对齐通道保持跨模态连贯性。在多个全双工基准测试上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法显著推动了最先进技术的发展，在语音智能（语音问答+7.4%）和全双工交互流畅度（FullDuplexBench 1.5+28.5%）方面均取得了实质性改进，而没有损害推理效率。据我们所知，这项工作是首次取得两项关键进展：1）揭示和阐明全双工SLM中模态干扰的根本原因，以及2）设计一个优雅的分层模型以及一个实用的解决方案，用于实现无缝、高性能、原生的智能全双工SLM。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了Lychee-FD，一个创新的全双工语音语言模型（SLM）框架，通过分层参数分离策略解决了模态干扰问题，实现了更自然、更智能的全双工交互。实验证明该方法在提高语音智能和交互流畅度方面效果显著，且保持了推理效率。
AI.keywords: 全双工SLM, 模态干扰, 分层参数分离, 语义对齐, Lychee-FD
AI.comments: 该研究深入分析了全双工SLM中的模态干扰问题，并提出了Lychee-FD框架，通过分层参数分离和语义对齐通道有效解决了该问题，取得了显著的性能提升。其贡献在于揭示了问题根源并提供了实际解决方案，为全双工SLM的研究和应用开辟了新方向。

title: On the feasibility of dependency parsing of non-human sequences without a gold standard. Is evaluation possible in other species?
summary: Dependency parsing consists of finding a tree representation for a sequence. Unsupervised dependency parsing aims to develop parsing methods without a gold standard during model training. In human languages, an unsupervised parser can be evaluated because some gold standard is usually available or can be created. For other species, a gold standard is unknown. Thus one may conclude that it is impossible to determine the accuracy of an unsupervised parser and, consequently, dependency parsing is unfeasible in other species. However, here we apply recent advances in network science to demonstrate that the proportion of correct edges retrieved by a parser must be high for the sequences of vocalizations or gestures that non-human primates produce due to the fast decay of the sequence length distribution. In contrast, human language sequences lack that property. Therefore, evaluation without a gold standard is feasible in non-human primates but a hard problem in humans.

AI.title_translation: 在没有黄金标准的情况下对非人类序列进行依存句法分析的可行性。在其他物种中是否可能进行评估？
AI.tldr: 在没有黄金标准的情况下，对非人类序列（如非人类灵长类动物的发声或手势）进行无监督依存句法分析的评估是可行的，因为其序列长度分布快速衰减，导致正确边的比例必须很高。这与人类语言不同，人类语言的评估仍然是一个难题。
AI.motivation: 在缺乏黄金标准的情况下，确定无监督依存句法分析器在非人类物种中的准确性是一个挑战，这使得人们可能会认为依存句法分析在这些物种中是不可行的。
AI.method: 本文应用网络科学的最新进展来分析序列长度分布，以评估在没有黄金标准的情况下进行无监督依存句法分析的可能性。
AI.result: 研究发现，由于序列长度分布的快速衰减，非人类灵长类动物的发声或手势序列中，解析器检索到的正确边的比例必须很高。这使得在没有黄金标准的情况下进行评估变得可行。与此相反，人类语言序列不具备这一特性。
AI.conclusion: 在没有黄金标准的情况下，对非人类灵长类动物进行评估是可行的，但在人类中仍然是一个难题。
AI.translation: 依存句法分析包括为序列找到树表示。无监督依存句法分析旨在在模型训练期间不使用黄金标准的情况下开发解析方法。在人类语言中，可以对无监督解析器进行评估，因为通常有黄金标准可用或可以创建。对于其他物种，黄金标准是未知的。因此，人们可能会得出结论，即不可能确定无监督解析器的准确性，从而依存句法分析在其他物种中是不可行的。然而，我们在此应用网络科学的最新进展来证明，由于序列长度分布的快速衰减，非人类灵长类动物产生的发声或手势序列中，解析器检索到的正确边的比例必须很高。相比之下，人类语言序列缺乏这一特性。因此，在非人类灵长类动物中，在没有黄金标准的情况下进行评估是可行的，但在人类中则是一个难题。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了在没有黄金标准的情况下对非人类序列进行无监督依存句法分析的评估可行性。研究指出，在人类语言中通常有黄金标准可用于评估，但在其他物种中则缺乏。通过应用网络科学的最新进展，研究发现，由于序列长度分布的快速衰减，非人类灵长类动物的发声或手势序列中，解析器检索到的正确边的比例必须很高，这使得在没有黄金标准的情况下进行评估成为可能。相反，人类语言不具备这一特性。因此，论文得出结论，在非人类灵长类动物中进行无黄金标准评估是可行的，但在人类中则是一个难题。
AI.keywords: 依存句法分析, 无监督学习, 非人类序列, 黄金标准, 网络科学
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新之处在于将网络科学的最新进展应用于解决非人类序列无监督依存句法分析的评估问题，为在缺乏黄金标准数据的情况下研究动物交流提供了新的视角和方法。它挑战了传统观念，即没有黄金标准就无法评估，并为理解非人类物种的复杂序列结构开辟了道路。

title: Rethinking Indic AI from a Lens of Cultural Heritage Preservation
summary: As Artificial Intelligence (AI) makes inroads into different parts of the Indian subcontinent, there is significant interest in studying how AI impacts the linguistic and cultural foundations of this civilization. AI is seen as a ''double-edged sword'' where on the one hand, it can enable access and inclusion for a large population, on the other, it can homogenize worldviews and exclude underrepresented languages and worldviews. In this paper, we try to characterize this problem by addressing the extensive characteristic nature of Indian linguistics and the way they closely connect to cultural practices and worldview. We then perform a longitudinal survey of how Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques have evolved in this space, tracing the historical development of Indic NLP, covering key milestones, methodological shifts, and resource creation efforts. In addition, the paper also examines the structural and sociolinguistic characteristics of Indian languages, such as rich morphology, complex scripts and grammar rules, diglossia, and large dialectal variation, and explains how these create unique challenges for building AI foundation models. We then discuss the growing role of Indic foundation models and analyze how these models address these long-standing resource and representation gaps. Finally, we propose a research direction called 'Culture Sensing', which re-imagines AI based on hermeneutic reasoning. Culture Sensing aims to address open problems such as ensuring equitable performance across low-resource languages and producing outputs that are culturally meaningful. By bringing together past work, current techniques, and emerging trends, this paper outlines research directions that can guide the next phase of Indic NLP and contribute to the development of more robust and inclusive Indic foundation models.

AI.title_translation: 重新思考印度人工智能在文化遗产保护视角下的应用
AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了人工智能（AI）在印度次大陆的应用，分析了其对语言和文化的影响。AI既能促进包容性，也可能带来同质化和排斥。论文详细介绍了印度语言的特点及其与文化实践的联系，并回顾了自然语言处理（NLP）在印度语言领域的发展历程。文章还讨论了印度语言在形态、书写系统、语法、双层语言现象和方言变异等方面带来的AI挑战。最后，提出了名为“文化感知”的研究方向，旨在通过诠释学推理，确保低资源语言的公平性能，并生成具有文化意义的AI输出，以促进更强大、更具包容性的印度基础模型发展。
AI.motivation: 随着人工智能在印度次大陆的普及，研究其对当地语言和文化的影响至关重要。AI具有双重性，既能促进信息获取和包容性，也可能导致文化同质化和对非主流语言的排斥。因此，有必要深入理解印度语言的特性及其与文化、世界观的紧密联系，并探索如何应对这些挑战。
AI.method: 该论文首先分析了印度语言的广泛特性及其与文化实践和世界观的联系。然后，通过纵向调查回顾了自然语言处理（NLP）技术在印度语言领域的发展历程，包括关键里程碑、方法论转变和资源创建。此外，论文还考察了印度语言的结构和社会语言学特征（如丰富的形态、复杂的书写系统和语法规则、双层语言现象和方言变异），并解释了这些特征如何给构建AI基础模型带来独特挑战。最后，提出了一个名为“文化感知”的研究方向。
AI.result: 该论文通过分析印度语言的特性、NLP技术的发展历程以及印度语言的结构和社会语言学特征，揭示了在印度语言领域构建AI基础模型所面临的独特挑战。论文还探讨了印度基础模型的作用，以及它们如何弥补资源和代表性方面的不足。最后，提出了“文化感知”的研究方向，旨在通过诠释学推理，确保低资源语言的公平性能，并生成具有文化意义的AI输出。
AI.conclusion: 该论文通过回顾历史、分析现状并提出“文化感知”这一新的研究方向，为下一阶段的印度NLP研究提供了指导，并有助于开发更强大、更具包容性的印度基础模型。其核心在于利用AI技术保护和弘扬印度丰富的文化遗产，同时应对其潜在的负面影响。
AI.translation: 随着人工智能（AI）进入印度次大陆的各个角落，研究AI如何影响这个文明的语言和文化基础引起了极大的兴趣。AI被视为一把“双刃剑”，一方面，它可以为广大民众提供信息获取和包容性；另一方面，它可能导致世界观的同质化，并排斥代表性不足的语言和世界观。在本论文中，我们试图通过解决印度语言学的广泛特征及其与文化实践和世界观的紧密联系来界定这个问题。然后，我们对自然语言处理（NLP）技术在该领域的发展进行了纵向调查，追溯了印度NLP的历史发展，涵盖了关键的里程碑、方法论的转变和资源创建的努力。此外，该论文还考察了印度语言的结构和社会语言学特征，如丰富的形态、复杂的书写系统和语法规则、双层语言现象以及大量的方言变异，并解释了这些特征如何为构建AI基础模型带来独特的挑战。然后，我们讨论了印度基础模型日益增长的作用，并分析了这些模型如何解决长期存在的资源和代表性差距。最后，我们提出了一个名为“文化感知”的研究方向，它基于诠释学推理重新构想了AI。“文化感知”旨在解决开放性问题，如确保低资源语言的公平性能，并生成具有文化意义的输出。通过汇集过去的工作、当前的技术和新兴的趋势，本论文概述了可以指导下一阶段印度NLP的研究方向，并为开发更强大、更具包容性的印度基础模型做出贡献。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了人工智能（AI）在印度次大陆的应用及其对语言和文化遗产保护的影响。论文分析了印度语言的复杂性，回顾了自然语言处理（NLP）在印度语言领域的发展，并指出了构建AI模型面临的挑战。文章提出了一种名为“文化感知”的新研究方向，旨在利用诠释学推理，确保AI在低资源语言和文化敏感性方面的公平性，以促进更具包容性和鲁棒性的印度基础模型的发展。
AI.keywords: 印度NLP, 文化遗产保护, 基础模型, 文化感知, 自然语言处理
AI.comments: 该论文对人工智能在印度文化遗产保护领域的应用进行了深入探讨，提出了“文化感知”这一创新性研究方向，具有重要的理论和实践意义。论文对印度语言复杂性的分析以及对NLP发展历程的回顾，为理解该领域面临的挑战提供了坚实的基础。然而，关于“文化感知”的具体实现方法和评估标准，以及其在实际应用中的潜在风险和局限性，仍需进一步的阐述和研究。

title: Graph Convolutional Attention: A Spectral Perspective on Graph Denoising and Diffusion
summary: Denoising graphs is a fundamental problem in graph learning and the core operation of graph diffusion models. Attention-based architectures like graph transformers have recently shown promise in denoising graphs. However, our principled understanding of attention-based graph denoising remains limited, making it unclear whether standard attention is the right mechanism for this task. Here we show that, under a denoising objective, linear attention is suboptimal and can only learn an average spectral denoising filter over the training distribution. This creates a fundamental limitation as graphs often vary spectrally across the distribution. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Spectral Attention, which directly utilizes the input graph spectrum and provably outperforms linear attention by a margin governed by the spectral diversity of the distribution. We then derive Graph Convolutional Attention (GCA), a practical and permutation-equivariant realization of this idea that implements spectral denoising through graph-filtered queries and keys. For stochastic block models, GCA provably matches the idealized Spectral Attention mechanism. We further show that the softmax operation, that follows the attention, provides additional denoising by approximately projecting noisy eigenvectors onto the clean eigenspace. Empirically, replacing linear attention with GCA consistently improves graph denoising and diffusion on synthetic and real datasets, with gains strongly correlated with spectral diversity. In DiGress, GCA matches standard graph-transformer performance without computing expensive structural features, and when combined with the recently proposed PEARL positional encodings, avoids explicit eigendecomposition computations resulting in faster inference without degrading quality. The code can be found here: github.com/shervinkhalafi/graph_conv_att

AI.title_translation: 图卷积注意力：图去噪和扩散的谱视角
AI.tldr: 现有线性注意力在图去噪中存在局限性，本文提出光谱注意力（Spectral Attention）和图卷积注意力（GCA），通过利用图谱信息，显著提升图去噪和扩散性能，并具有理论和实证支持。
AI.motivation: 现有的注意力机制（如线性注意力）在图去噪任务中存在原理性理解有限和性能次优的局限性。它只能学习训练分布上的平均谱去噪滤波器，无法有效处理图在谱上的多样性，这限制了其在图去噪和扩散模型中的应用。
AI.method: 1. 引入光谱注意力（Spectral Attention），直接利用输入图的频谱信息进行去噪，并从理论上证明其性能优于线性注意力。2. 推导图卷积注意力（Graph Convolutional Attention, GCA），作为光谱注意力的一种实用且置换等变的实现，通过图滤波的查询和键实现谱去噪。3. 分析了注意力后的softmax操作，证明其通过将噪声特征向量近似投影到干净特征空间，提供了额外的去噪效果。
AI.result: 1. 光谱注意力理论上优于线性注意力，其优势由分布的谱多样性决定。2. 对于随机块模型，GCA 在理论上与理想化的光谱注意力机制匹配。3. 经验上，用 GCA 替代线性注意力持续改进了合成和真实数据集上的图去噪和扩散性能，且性能增益与谱多样性强相关。4. 在 DiGress 模型中，GCA 在不计算昂贵结构特征的情况下，达到了标准图Transformer的性能，并且与 PEARL 位置编码结合时，避免了显式特征分解计算，从而在不降低质量的情况下实现了更快的推理。
AI.conclusion: 本文通过引入光谱注意力及其在实践中的实现——图卷积注意力（GCA），克服了现有线性注意力在图去噪任务中的局限性，显著提升了图去噪和扩散模型的性能，并提供了理论和实证支持。GCA 提供了一种更有效且计算效率更高的图去噪机制。
AI.translation: 图去噪是图学习中的一个基本问题，也是图扩散模型的核心操作。最近，图Transformer等基于注意力的架构在图去噪方面显示出潜力。然而，我们对基于注意力的图去噪的原理性理解仍然有限，这使得标准注意力是否是该任务的正确机制尚不清楚。本文表明，在去噪目标下，线性注意力是次优的，并且只能学习训练分布上的平均谱去噪滤波器。由于图在分布中通常在谱上有所不同，这造成了一个根本性的局限性。为了克服这一局限性，我们引入了光谱注意力（Spectral Attention），它直接利用输入图的频谱，并被证明其性能优于线性注意力，其优势由分布的谱多样性决定。然后，我们推导出图卷积注意力（GCA），它是这一思想的一种实用且置换等变的实现，通过图滤波的查询和键实现谱去噪。对于随机块模型，GCA 被证明与理想化的光谱注意力机制匹配。我们进一步表明，注意力之后的 softmax 操作通过将噪声特征向量近似投影到干净特征空间，提供了额外的去噪效果。经验上，用 GCA 替代线性注意力持续改进了合成和真实数据集上的图去噪和扩散性能，其增益与谱多样性密切相关。在 DiGress 中，GCA 在不计算昂贵结构特征的情况下，达到了标准图Transformer的性能，并且当与最近提出的 PEARL 位置编码结合时，避免了显式特征分解计算，从而在不降低质量的情况下实现了更快的推理。代码可以在这里找到：github.com/shervinkhalafi/graph_conv_att
AI.summary: 本文针对图去噪和图扩散模型中线性注意力机制的局限性，即其无法有效处理图谱多样性问题，提出了一种新的“光谱注意力”（Spectral Attention）机制。在此基础上，作者进一步开发了实用且置换等变的“图卷积注意力”（Graph Convolutional Attention, GCA），通过图滤波的查询和键实现谱去噪。研究表明，光谱注意力在理论上优于线性注意力，而GCA在随机块模型中能匹配理想的光谱注意力。实验结果显示，GCA在合成和真实数据集上显著提升了图去噪和扩散的性能，并且在特定模型中无需昂贵特征计算即可达到高水平性能，与位置编码结合后还能加速推理。
AI.keywords: 图去噪, 图扩散, 注意力机制, 光谱注意力, 图卷积注意力
AI.comments: 这篇论文在图去噪领域提出了一个新颖的视角，将注意力机制与图的谱特性相结合。其创新点在于理论上分析了线性注意力的局限性，并提出了基于谱信息的光谱注意力，进而设计出实用的图卷积注意力（GCA）。GCA不仅在理论上得到验证，在实践中也显示出显著的性能提升和计算效率优势，尤其是在避免昂贵特征计算和加速推理方面。这为未来的图神经网络设计，特别是在需要处理图结构噪声和多样性的任务中，提供了有价值的参考。

title: Unsupervised Domain Adaptation for Calcification Classification in Mammography Across Multi-Site Datasets
summary: Deep learning-based computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems have shown strong performance in breast cancer diagnosis, particularly for classification tasks in mammography. However, domain shifts across multi-site datasets remain a challenge, especially when models are applied to unseen domains. In this work, we proposed a calcification classification framework to improve malignant versus benign breast disease classification across multi-site mammography datasets. The framework consisted of two components: (1) an unsupervised domain adaptation module based on style transfer models (AdaIN and CycleGAN) to generate vendor-specific and technique-specific training samples without additional annotations, and (2) a supervised classification module using Swin Transformer V2 as the backbone. We evaluated the proposed method on three datasets: cross-validation on OPTIMAM (National Health Service, United Kingdom; n=2994), followed by external validation on EMBED (Emory University; n=125), and Duke Calcification Dataset v1 (n=788). These datasets cover multiple vendors and include both full-field digital mammography and synthetic 2D images derived from digital breast tomosynthesis. The proposed framework improved cross-site performance for both EMBED (AUC 0.68 to 0.72) and the Duke Calcification Dataset (AUC 0.68 to 0.73). These findings indicate that domain adaptation can reduce domain shifts and improve the generalization for calcification classification across multi-site datasets.

AI.title_translation: 跨多站点数据集的乳房X光钙化分类无监督域适应研究
AI.tldr: 通过无监督风格迁移减少域偏移，显著提升了乳房钙化分类模型在多来源数据集上的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 深度学习CAD系统在乳房X光检查中表现优异，但面对多站点数据集时的域偏移（domain shift）导致模型在未见领域表现下降，需要提升模型的泛化性能。
AI.method: 1. 无监督域适应模块：利用AdaIN和CycleGAN进行风格迁移，生成特定供应商和技术的样本；2. 监督分类模块：采用Swin Transformer V2作为骨干网络进行分类。
AI.result: 在EMBED数据集上AUC从0.68提升至0.72，在Duke钙化数据集上AUC从0.68提升至0.73，验证了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，通过无监督域适应技术减少域偏移，能显著提升乳房钙化分类模型在多站点数据集上的泛化能力。
AI.translation: 基于深度学习的计算机辅助诊断（CAD）系统在乳腺癌诊断中表现出强大的性能，特别是在乳房X光检查的分类任务中。然而，跨多站点数据集的域偏移仍然是一个挑战，特别是在模型应用于未见领域时。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个钙化分类框架，以改善多站点乳房X光数据集上恶性与良性乳腺疾病的分类。该框架由两个组件组成：（1）基于风格迁移模型（AdaIN和CycleGAN）的无监督域适应模块，用于在无需额外标注的情况下生成特定供应商和技术的训练样本；（2）使用Swin Transformer V2作为骨干的监督分类模块。我们在三个数据集上评估了所提出的方法：OPTIMAM的交叉验证（英国国家医疗服务体系；n=2994），随后是对EMBED（埃默里大学；n=125）和Duke钙化数据集v1（n=788）的外部验证。这些数据集涵盖了多个供应商，并包括全场数字乳房X光摄影和源自数字乳房断层合成的合成2D图像。所提出的框架改善了EMBED（AUC从0.68提升至0.72）和Duke钙化数据集（AUC从0.68提升至0.73）的跨站点性能。这些发现表明，域适应可以减少域偏移，并提高多站点数据集上钙化分类的泛化能力。
AI.summary: 针对乳房X光钙化分类中跨站点数据集的域偏移挑战，本文提出了一种结合无监督风格迁移（AdaIN/CycleGAN）与Swin Transformer V2分类器的框架，无需额外标注即可提升模型在异构数据集上的泛化性能。
AI.keywords: 无监督域适应, 乳房钙化分类, 风格迁移, Swin Transformer V2, 跨站点泛化
AI.comments: 该论文通过结合风格迁移与Swin Transformer V2，有效解决了跨医疗机构数据集的域偏移问题。创新点在于利用无监督风格迁移生成多样化训练样本，无需额外标注，具有很高的临床应用价值和推广潜力。

title: Quantum combinatorial games
summary: A combinatorial game is a deterministic game with no hidden information played between two opponents such as tic-tac-toe, checkers or chess. In this paper we extend combinatorial games to the quantum setting, by first revisiting and reformulating existing theory of classical combinatorial games. We investigate in which case a quantum opponent has an advantage over a classical one. Surprisingly, our instantiation of Zermelo's classical theorem in the quantum setting shows that the effects of quantum mechanics do not convey an advantage against a classical player that plays a perfect classical strategy. In a more realistic scenario, when the classical player makes mistakes, we show how the quantum opponent can amplify the mistake to increase their chance of winning. Our theory has application beyond the mere playing of board games and can be used as a tool in finite deterministic adversarial models with perfect information.

AI.title_translation: 量子组合博弈
AI.tldr: 本文将经典组合博弈扩展到量子环境。研究发现，量子力学在对抗完美经典策略时没有优势，但在经典玩家犯错时，量子对手可以放大这些错误以增加胜率。该理论可应用于有限确定性对抗模型。
AI.motivation: 将经典组合博弈扩展到量子环境，并研究量子对手相对于经典对手是否具有优势。
AI.method: 重新审视并重新 M 式化经典组合博弈的现有理论。在量子环境中实例化策梅洛的经典定理。分析经典玩家犯错的场景。
AI.result: 令人惊讶的是，量子力学的影响并不能对抗采用完美经典策略的经典玩家提供优势（对策梅洛定理的量子实例化）。然而，在更现实的场景中，当经典玩家犯错时，量子对手可以放大这些错误以增加获胜的机会。
AI.conclusion: 虽然量子力学在对抗完美经典策略时没有固有优势，但它可以被利用来放大经典玩家所犯的错误。该理论可应用于具有完美信息的有限确定性对抗模型。
AI.translation: 组合博弈是一种确定性博弈，没有隐藏信息，由两个对手进行，例如井字棋、跳棋或国际象棋。在本文中，我们通过首先重新审视和重新 M 式化经典组合博弈的现有理论，将组合博弈扩展到量子环境。我们研究了在何种情况下量子对手比经典对手具有优势。令人惊讶的是，我们在量子环境中对策梅洛经典定理的实例化表明，量子力学的影响并不能对抗采用完美经典策略的经典玩家提供优势。在更现实的场景中，当经典玩家犯错时，我们展示了量子对手如何放大这些错误以增加获胜的机会。我们的理论应用超出了单纯的棋盘游戏，可以作为具有完美信息的有限确定性对抗模型中的工具。
AI.summary: 本文将经典的确定性、完美信息组合博弈扩展到量子领域。通过重新 M 式化经典理论，研究了量子对手的优势。研究发现，尽管量子力学在对抗完美经典策略时没有优势（通过策梅洛定理的量子实例化），但在经典玩家犯错的场景中，量子对手可以放大这些错误以提高胜率。该理论适用于一般的有限确定性对抗模型。
AI.keywords: 量子博弈, 组合博弈, 策梅洛定理, 对抗模型, 量子优势
AI.comments: 本文在将经典组合博弈理论扩展到量子环境方面具有创新性。发现量子力学在对抗完美经典玩家时没有优势是反直觉且重要的。然而，在利用经典玩家错误方面的实际应用为量子优势提供了一个现实场景。这可能为传统游戏之外的对抗性环境中的量子算法开辟新途径。

title: MonoIR-RS: Infrared Remote Sensing Vision-Language Learning with CLIP and VLM Adaptation
summary: Infrared remote-sensing imagery captures intensity structure, object-background contrast, and illumination-invariant cues often invisible in RGB imagery. Yet, most remote-sensing vision-language resources and models focus on visible-band semantics, leaving infrared vision-language understanding underexplored. We introduce MonoIR-RS, a large-scale infrared remote-sensing vision-language dataset and benchmark that couples IR-aware data construction with CLIP-style contrastive adaptation and VLM instruction tuning. Built from the same source pool and split as FusionRS, MonoIR-RS retains the infrared image as the model-facing modality, yielding 600,000 synthesized infrared images and 59,032 retained IR-aware caption records. The model experiments use this retained language-supervision subset, whose captions rewrite supervision around grayscale structure and infrared-style contrast instead of RGB appearance. We show that the synthesized infrared imagery is markedly closer to real thermal imagery than a grayscale conversion on the AVIID benchmark. We fine-tune five CLIP backbones and six VLM backbones, and calibrate them against zero-shot behavior: IR-aware adaptation lifts CLIP mean recall by up to 12.8 points and drives VLM captioning IR-cue coverage to 100% while reducing residual RGB-color leakage to near zero. By isolating the infrared modality from RGB-IR dual-modal learning, MonoIR-RS offers a controlled, reproducible testbed for aligning infrared remote-sensing evidence with language.

AI.title_translation: 红外遥感：使用CLIP和VLM适应的红外遥感视觉-语言学习
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了MonoIR-RS，一个大规模红外遥感图像和文本数据集，并开发了一种适应方法，以提高模型对红外图像的理解能力，解决了现有模型主要关注可见光的问题。
AI.motivation: 大多数遥感视觉-语言资源和模型都集中在可见光波段，导致红外视觉-语言理解领域的研究不足。
AI.method: 构建了一个大规模的红外遥感视觉-语言数据集MonoIR-RS，该数据集包含了600,000张合成的红外图像和59,032条与红外图像相关的标题。研究中采用了CLIP风格的对比适应和VLM指令微调的方法，并对五种CLIP骨干网络和六种VLM骨干网络进行了微调和校准。
AI.result: 在AVIID基准测试中，合成的红外图像比灰度转换的图像更接近真实的红外热成像图。经过IR感知适应后，CLIP的平均召回率提高了12.8个百分点，VLM的字幕生成在红外线索覆盖率上达到了100%，同时将残留的RGB颜色泄露降至接近于零。
AI.conclusion: MonoIR-RS数据集和提出的IR感知适应方法能够有效地提升模型对红外遥感图像的理解能力，并为红外遥感领域的视觉-语言研究提供了一个受控且可复现的测试平台。
AI.translation: 红外遥感图像捕捉了可见光图像中通常不可见的强度结构、物体-背景对比度和光照不变线索。然而，大多数遥感视觉-语言资源和模型都集中在可见波段，使得红外视觉-语言理解领域的研究不足。我们引入了MonoIR-RS，一个大规模的红外遥感视觉-语言数据集和基准，它将红外感知数据构建与CLIP风格的对比适应和VLM指令微调相结合。MonoIR-RS从与FusionRS相同的源池和拆分构建，保留了红外图像作为模型所面对的模态，产生了600,000张合成的红外图像和59,032条保留的、具有红外感知的字幕记录。模型实验使用了这个保留的语言监督子集，其字幕围绕灰度结构和红外风格对比度改写了监督，而不是RGB外观。我们证明了在AVIID基准测试中，合成的红外图像比灰度转换的图像更接近真实的红外热成像图。我们对五种CLIP骨干网络和六种VLM骨干网络进行了微调，并针对零样本行为对它们进行了校准：IR感知适应将CLIP的平均召回率提高了12.8个百分点，并将VLM字幕生成的IR线索覆盖率提高到100%，同时将残留的RGB颜色泄露减少到接近于零。通过将红外模态与RGB-IR双模态学习分离开来，MonoIR-RS为将红外遥感证据与语言对齐提供了一个受控的、可复现的测试平台。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了MonoIR-RS，一个大规模的红外遥感图像和文本数据集，旨在解决当前遥感视觉-语言研究中对红外图像理解不足的问题。通过结合CLIP风格的对比适应和VLM指令微调，研究人员对模型进行了优化，显著提高了模型在红外图像理解任务上的表现，包括提高召回率和字幕生成质量，同时减少了对RGB信息的依赖。MonoIR-RS为未来红外遥感视觉-语言对齐的研究提供了一个重要的平台。
AI.keywords: 红外遥感, 视觉-语言学习, CLIP, VLM, 数据集
AI.comments: 该研究在红外遥感视觉-语言领域做出了重要贡献，通过构建大规模数据集和提出有效的适应方法，解决了现有研究的不足。其方法具有创新性，并且实验结果令人信服，为该领域的研究提供了坚实的基础。然而，合成数据的真实性以及模型在复杂真实场景下的泛化能力仍有待进一步验证。

title: From RGB Generation to Dense Field Readout: Pixel-Space Dense Prediction with Text-to-Image Models
summary: Large-scale text-to-image models are attractive backbones for dense prediction because RGB generation pretraining learns rich semantic, structural, and geometric priors. Existing generative and editing approaches reuse these priors by casting dense prediction as target generation: annotations such as depth, normals, alpha mattes, masks, and heatmaps are encoded into an RGB-trained VAE latent space and decoded back as image-like targets. We argue this inherits more of the generative output interface than dense prediction requires: unlike RGB synthesis, dense prediction asks for pixel-correct, task-native fields on the same image plane, not new RGB content to be rendered. Our key observation is that a pretrained DiT already organizes RGB inputs through a patch-to-token-to-patch lattice on the image plane, so each token indexes a fixed output patch whose channels can carry task-native quantities instead of RGB appearance. We instantiate this as ReChannel: we keep the VAE encoder for the DiT's input distribution but drop the target-side decoder, adapt the frozen DiT with task LoRA, and map each token to its p x p x K_t pixel-space patch through a shared token-local linear head--about 33K parameters, no spatial mixing. Using FLUX-Klein, we evaluate on six dense prediction tasks and over a dozen benchmarks. This minimal interface sets new state-of-the-art on trimap-free matting, KITTI depth, and referring segmentation, and stays competitive on normals, saliency, and pose. In a matched 4B setting it is more accurate and 2.48x faster than an edit-plus-latent-decode counterpart--dense perception can benefit from generative pretraining without inheriting its output interface.

AI.title_translation: 从RGB生成到密集场读出：使用文本到图像模型的像素空间密集预测
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为ReChannel的新方法，它利用文本到图像模型（如DiT）的预训练知识进行像素空间密集预测任务。与现有方法将密集预测视为目标生成不同，ReChannel直接利用DiT内部的patch-to-token结构，将每个token映射到对应的像素块，并使用一个小型线性头来预测任务相关的量，而不是生成RGB图像。这种方法在多个密集预测任务上取得了最先进的性能，并且比其他方法更快。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本到图像模型（如DiT）因其丰富的语义、结构和几何先验知识，成为密集预测的理想基础。然而，现有方法通常将密集预测视为目标生成任务，将各种注释编码到RGB训练的VAE潜在空间并解码回图像状目标，这继承了生成任务的输出接口，而密集预测只需要像素级精确、任务原生的场，而不是需要渲染的新RGB内容。
AI.method: 提出ReChannel方法，保持VAE编码器用于DiT的输入分布，但去除目标端的解码器。通过适配冻结的DiT模型（使用LoRA）并添加一个共享的、约33K参数的token-local线性头，将每个token映射到其p x p x K_t的像素空间块，实现无空间混合的密集预测。
AI.result: 在FLUX-Klein数据集上，ReChannel在六个密集预测任务和十几个基准测试中进行了评估。在三路无抠图、KITTI深度估计和指代分割任务上取得了新的最先进性能，并在法线、显著性图和姿态估计任务上保持了竞争力。与具有编辑加潜在解码的对应方法相比，在相同的4B参数设置下，ReChannel的准确率更高，速度快2.48倍。
AI.conclusion: 密集感知可以从生成式预训练中受益，而无需继承其输出接口。ReChannel通过一种最小化的接口，实现了高效且准确的密集预测。
AI.translation: 大型文本到图像模型是密集预测的有吸引力的骨干，因为RGB生成预训练学习了丰富的语义、结构和几何先验。现有的生成和编辑方法通过将密集预测视为目标生成来重用这些先验：诸如深度、法线、alpha抠图、掩码和热图之类的注释被编码到RGB训练的VAE潜在空间中，并作为图像状目标解码回。我们认为这继承了比密集预测所需更多的生成输出接口：与RGB合成不同，密集预测要求在同一图像平面上进行像素正确的、任务原生的字段，而不是需要渲染的新RGB内容。我们的关键观察是，预训练的DiT已经通过图像平面上的patch-to-token-to-patch格子组织了RGB输入，因此每个token都索引了一个固定的输出块，其通道可以携带任务原生的量而不是RGB外观。我们将此实例化为ReChannel：我们保留了用于DiT输入分布的VAE编码器，但丢弃了目标端的解码器，使用任务LoRA适配了冻结的DiT，并通过一个共享的token-local线性头将每个token映射到其p x p x K_t像素空间块——大约33K参数，无空间混合。使用FLUX-Klein，我们在六个密集预测任务和十几个基准上进行了评估。这个最小化的接口在三路无抠图、KITTI深度估计和指代分割任务上设定了新的最先进水平，并在法线、显著性图和姿态估计任务上保持竞争力。在一个匹配的4B设置中，它比编辑加潜在解码的对应方法更准确，速度快2.48倍——密集感知可以从生成式预训练中受益，而无需继承其输出接口。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为ReChannel的新方法，用于像素空间密集预测任务。该方法利用了大型文本到图像模型（如DiT）预训练中学习到的丰富先验知识。与以往将密集预测视为目标生成任务并继承其输出接口的方法不同，ReChannel直接利用DiT模型内部的patch-to-token结构，将每个token映射到图像上的特定像素块，并使用一个参数量极小的线性头来预测任务所需的密集场（如深度、法线等）。这种方法在多个密集预测任务上取得了最先进的性能，并且在效率上也有显著提升。
AI.keywords: 密集预测, 文本到图像模型, DiT, ReChannel, 像素空间
AI.comments: ReChannel方法巧妙地利用了文本到图像模型（如DiT）的内部结构，实现了高效且准确的密集预测。其核心创新在于将模型内部的token映射到像素空间块，并直接预测任务相关的量，避免了生成式模型输出接口的限制。这种方法不仅在多个任务上取得了SOTA性能，而且参数量少、速度快，显示了其巨大的应用潜力。未来的工作可以探索将这种思想应用于更广泛的生成模型和密集预测任务。

title: ProxyPose: 6-DoF Pose Tracking via Video-to-Video Translation
summary: Tracking the six-degree-of-freedom (6-DoF) pose of objects and surfaces from monocular video is a long-standing problem in computer vision. To tackle this problem, existing methods require inputs beyond the video itself-such as 3D models, depth maps, object masks, or task-specific learned features-and they struggle with textureless, transparent, reflective, or deformable surfaces. Here, we introduce ProxyPose, which recasts 6-DoF pose tracking as video-to-video translation. Given only a video and a single marked pixel in the first frame, a fine-tuned video diffusion model translates the input into a proxy video-a synthetic video depicting a colored polyhedron undergoing the same local rigid-body motion as the surface region at the marked pixel. Because the proxy's geometry and appearance are known by construction, recovering its full 6-DoF trajectory reduces to classical pose estimation with off-the-shelf solvers. This formulation leverages large-scale video pre-training to absorb the hardest aspects of pose tracking-handling challenging materials, occlusions, and deformations-into the translation step, while operating at the pixel level with no assumptions about object identity, boundaries, or global rigidity. ProxyPose achieves state-of-the-art 6-DoF pose tracking accuracy without the additional inputs required by competing methods and after fine-tuning the video model only on synthetic data. We further demonstrate that ProxyPose extends to face tracking, camera pose estimation, and challenging in-the-wild scenes that are beyond the reach of existing approaches. Project page: https://ruihangzhang97.github.io/proxypose/.

AI.title_translation: 代理姿态：通过视频到视频翻译进行 6-DoF 姿态跟踪
AI.tldr: ProxyPose 将 6-DoF 姿态跟踪视为视频到视频的翻译问题，利用视频扩散模型生成代理视频，然后使用现成的求解器来估计姿态，从而在无需额外输入的情况下实现最先进的精度，并能处理具有挑战性的表面和场景。
AI.motivation: 单目视频的六自由度（6-DoF）姿态跟踪是一个长期存在的问题，现有方法需要额外的输入（如 3D 模型、深度图等），并且在处理纹理缺失、透明、反光或可变形表面时存在困难。
AI.method: ProxyPose 将 6-DoF 姿态跟踪重新定义为视频到视频的翻译问题。它使用经过微调的视频扩散模型将输入视频翻译成代理视频，该视频描绘了一个具有相同局部刚体运动的彩色多面体。然后，利用现成的求解器来恢复代理视频的完整 6-DoF 轨迹，从而推断出目标表面的姿态。
AI.result: ProxyPose 在无需额外输入的情况下实现了最先进的 6-DoF 姿态跟踪精度，并且仅在合成数据上对视频模型进行了微调。该方法还能成功应用于面部跟踪、相机姿态估计以及极具挑战性的真实场景。
AI.conclusion: ProxyPose 通过将 6-DoF 姿态跟踪转化为视频到视频的翻译问题，克服了现有方法的局限性，并在各种具有挑战性的场景下实现了卓越的性能。
AI.translation: 从单目视频中跟踪物体和表面的六自由度（6-DoF）姿态是计算机视觉中一个长期存在的问题。为了解决这个问题，现有方法需要视频本身以外的输入——例如 3D 模型、深度图、对象掩码或特定于任务的学习特征——并且它们在处理无纹理、透明、反光或可变形表面时遇到困难。在此，我们介绍了 ProxyPose，它将 6-DoF 姿态跟踪重新定义为视频到视频的翻译。给定仅一个视频和第一帧中的一个标记像素，一个经过微调的视频扩散模型将输入翻译成一个代理视频——一个描绘彩色多面体的合成视频，该多面体具有与标记像素处的表面区域相同的局部刚体运动。因为代理的几何形状和外观是根据构建已知，恢复其完整的 6-DoF 轨迹就归结为使用现成的求解器进行经典的姿态估计。这种方法利用大规模视频预训练吸收姿态跟踪最困难的方面——处理具有挑战性的材料、遮挡和变形——到翻译步骤中，同时在像素级别运行，而无需对对象标识、边界或全局刚性进行任何假设。ProxyPose 在实现最先进的 6-DoF 姿态跟踪精度的同时，避免了竞争方法所需的额外输入，并且仅在合成数据上对视频模型进行了微调。此外，我们证明了 ProxyPose 可以扩展到面部跟踪、相机姿态估计以及现有方法无法企及的、极具挑战性的真实场景。项目主页：https://ruihangzhang97.github.io/proxypose/。
AI.summary: ProxyPose 提出了一种新颖的 6-DoF 姿态跟踪方法，它将问题转化为视频到视频的翻译任务。通过利用视频扩散模型生成一个代理视频，该视频描绘了一个具有已知几何形状的物体，并模拟了目标表面的运动。随后，利用标准的姿态估计技术来解析代理视频，从而精确地推断出原始目标的 6-DoF 姿态。该方法无需 3D 模型或深度图等额外信息，能够有效处理纹理缺失、透明、反光或可变形表面，并在各种真实场景中取得了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 6-DoF 姿态跟踪, 视频到视频翻译, 代理姿态, 扩散模型, 姿态估计
AI.comments: ProxyPose 的方法具有高度创新性，它巧妙地将视频到视频的翻译与传统的姿态估计相结合，解决了长期存在的 6-DoF 姿态跟踪难题。该方法在无需额外输入的情况下实现了卓越的性能，并能处理各种具有挑战性的表面和场景，这使其在机器人、增强现实和计算机视觉等领域具有广泛的应用前景。然而，该方法对视频扩散模型的依赖可能意味着较高的计算成本和对训练数据的需求。

title: RynnWorld-Teleop: An Action-Conditioned World Model for Digital Teleoperation
summary: Scaling robot learning requires massive, diverse trajectory data, yet collection is currently bottlenecked by physical teleoperation, where every demonstration binds operator time to specific hardware and workspaces. We introduce digital teleoperation, a paradigm that decouples data collection from physical constraints by replacing the real robot with a generative world model. In this framework, an operator's hand-pose stream drives a robot-centric generative world model to synthesize high-fidelity egocentric videos from a single reference image. The recorded pose stream serves as an embodiment-agnostic action label transferable to any target robot via standard retargeting, yielding complete state-action trajectories for imitation learning independent of physical hardware. We instantiate this paradigm in RynnWorld-Teleop, a system that integrates depth-aware skeletal conditioning, progressive human-to-robot training on a video Diffusion Transformer, and streaming autoregressive distillation. This pipeline compresses the generative process into a single-pass inference, enabling 40+ FPS, real-time interactive generation on a single H100 GPU. Policies trained exclusively on RynnWorld-Teleop-generated data achieve effective zero-shot Sim2Real transfer across dexterous and diverse bimanual tasks. Moreover, augmenting real-world datasets with our digitally teleoperated data consistently improves success rates, demonstrating that RynnWorld-Teleop serves as a high-fidelity, scalable data engine for the next generation of robotic agents.

AI.title_translation: RynnWorld-Teleop：一种用于数字遥操作的动作条件世界模型
AI.tldr: 通过生成式世界模型模拟机器人交互，无需物理硬件即可大规模采集高质量训练数据，显著提升机器人策略学习效率。
AI.motivation: 物理遥操作限制了机器人训练数据的规模与多样性，作者旨在通过生成式世界模型摆脱物理约束，实现数据采集的解耦。
AI.method: 提出 RynnWorld-Teleop 系统，利用深度感知骨架条件、针对视频扩散 Transformer 的渐进式人机训练，以及流式自回归蒸馏技术，实现了单次推理的高速生成。
AI.result: 系统实现了 40+ FPS 的实时生成，在仅使用合成数据训练的情况下实现了零样本 Sim2Real 迁移，并能有效增强真实世界数据集的性能。
AI.conclusion: RynnWorld-Teleop 证明了数字遥操作作为一种高效、可扩展的数据引擎，能够显著提升机器人策略的学习效果，并实现零样本 Sim2Real 迁移。
AI.translation: 扩展机器人学习需要海量、多样化的轨迹数据，但目前的采集受限于物理遥操作，即每次演示都将操作员的时间绑定在特定的硬件和工作空间上。我们引入了数字遥操作，这是一种通过用生成式世界模型替代真实机器人来将数据采集与物理约束解耦的范式。在该框架中，操作员的手势流驱动一个以机器人为中心生成式世界模型，从单一参考图像合成高保真的自我中心视频。记录的姿态流作为与具身无关的动作标签，可通过标准重定向传输到任何目标机器人，从而产生独立于物理硬件的完整状态-动作轨迹用于模仿学习。我们将此范式实现在 RynnWorld-Teleop 中，该系统集成了深度感知骨架条件、视频扩散 Transformer 上的渐进式人机训练以及流式自回归蒸馏。该流水线将生成过程压缩为单次推理，在单个 H100 GPU 上实现了 40+ FPS 的实时交互生成。仅在 RynnWorld-Teleop 生成的数据上训练的策略在灵巧和多样化的双臂任务中实现了有效的零样本 Sim2Real 迁移。此外，用我们数字遥操作的数据增强真实世界数据集持续提高了成功率，证明了 RynnWorld-Teleop 可作为下一代机器人代理的高保真、可扩展数据引擎。
AI.summary: RynnWorld-Teleop 引入了“数字遥操作”框架，通过生成式世界模型将操作员的手势动作转化为机器人动作，从而在无需物理机器人的情况下生成大规模、多样化的训练轨迹，有效推动了机器人学习的规模化。
AI.keywords: 数字遥操作, 世界模型, 机器人学习, 生成式模型, 具身智能
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的“数字遥操作”范式，通过生成式世界模型解耦了机器人数据采集与物理硬件的限制。其核心贡献在于将操作员手势转化为与具身无关的动作标签，并实现了实时高保真视频生成，为解决机器人学习中数据匮乏的瓶颈提供了一种极具潜力的可扩展方案。

title: RynnWorld-4D: 4D Embodied World Models for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation in the open world requires not only recognizing what a scene looks like, but also anticipating how its 3D structure moves under interaction. We argue that synchronized RGB, depth, and optical flow, namely RGB-DF, provide a physically grounded representation that captures the underlying 4D dynamics of a scene. Compared to 2D pixel videos, this multi-modal synergy aligns visual appearance with geometric structure and temporal motion, creating a representation space significantly closer to the low-level end-effector actions demanded by robotic systems, thereby narrowing the gap between world prediction and policy learning. Building on this insight, we introduce RynnWorld-4D, a generative model that co-produces future RGB frames, depth maps, and optical flow from a single RGB-D image and a language instruction within one unified diffusion process. This 4D world model features a tri-branch architecture that integrates cross-modal attention with frame-wise 3D RoPE, ensuring that appearance, geometry, and motion evolve consistently. To supply training data at scale, we curate Rynn4DDataset 1.0, a massive dataset of over 254.4 million frames across egocentric human and robotic manipulation videos with high-quality pseudo-labels for depth and optical flow. We further propose RynnWorld-4D-Policy, an inverse dynamics head that consumes the internal 4D representations of RynnWorld-4D in a single forward pass, bypassing expensive multi-step denoising, to output robot actions in a closed-loop manner. Experiments show that RynnWorld-4D produces temporally and spatially coherent 4D predictions, and that RynnWorld-4D-Policy achieves state-of-the-art performance on real-world dexterous bimanual manipulation tasks, particularly excelling in tasks demanding spatial precision and temporal coordination.

title: Vision as Unified Multimodal Generation
summary: We formulate computer vision as unified multimodal generation, where heterogeneous visual tasks are expressed in the native text and image generation spaces of a unified multimodal model, without task-specific architectures. Under this formulation, SenseNova-Vision uses natural-language instructions and optional visual prompts to specify tasks, target regions or views, and decoding conventions, and generates responses as text for symbolic outputs, images for dense spatial predictions, or mixed text-and-image outputs for compositional tasks. To support large-scale training, we convert diverse computer vision annotations into instruction-response examples compatible with these generation spaces, resulting in the SenseNova-Vision Corpus, a computer-vision instruction-response corpus spanning text, image, and mixed targets. Starting from an off-the-shelf pretrained unified multimodal model, SenseNova-Vision is trained primarily on this corpus, with auxiliary multimodal data used as a capability-preserving mixture, and requires no task-specific prediction heads or architectural modifications. The resulting model covers a broad range of vision tasks, including detection, OCR, keypoint estimation, segmentation, depth estimation, surface normal prediction, point maps, and camera pose estimation, while supporting language-defined variants that combine category, color, region, and other visual cues. Experiments show that a single unified model can match leading task-specialized systems across structured visual understanding, dense geometric prediction, segmentation, and multi-view visual geometry. These results suggest unified multimodal generation as a scalable route for integrating computer vision capabilities into general-purpose foundation models. The model and corpus are publicly available.

title: Embodied Human-Robot Interaction via Acoustics: A MARL Approach with AcoustoBots for Spatial Data Physicalization
comments: This paper has been accepted for publication in the Proceedings of the 2026 International Conference on Robotic System and Artificial Intelligence (RSAI 2026), 10-12 July, 2026, Tokyo, Japan
summary: Traditional data physicalization is often static and disconnected from real environments, limiting its ability to convey embodied spatial dynamics and engage users. To address this limitation, we present AcoustoBots, a mobile acoustophoretic data-physicalization platform in which TurtleBot3 robots carry upward-facing 8 x 8 ultrasonic phased arrays. Each array levitates a particle whose height (1-10 cm) encodes a local urban scalar value, such as population density, noise, or traffic. A MARL (Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning) policy based on the Multi-Agent Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (MADDPG) algorithm, with centralized training and decentralized execution, selects collision-aware navigation actions, while a high-rate Gerchberg-Saxton-Phased Array of Transducers (GS-PAT) acoustic controller maintains trap stability and updates array phases to achieve the commanded height during motion. This creates a closed perception-display-action loop. We evaluate single-robot city-to-city traversal and dual-robot cooperative coverage on a 4 m x 3 m scaled UK map using PhaseSpace-based localization for repeatable multi-robot trials. Results show stable in-motion levitation and consistent, location-dependent height rendering, with task success rates of 90% and 80% for the single and dual-robot regimes, respectively, over 10 trials per regime, and low collision counts. These findings support acoustophoretic levitation as a simple, glanceable, robot-mediated communication cue for embodied human-robot interaction in spatial analytics.

title: Lift3D-VLA: Lifting VLA Models to 3D Geometry and Dynamics-Aware Manipulation
summary: Recently, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong generalization across diverse tasks. However, effective robotic manipulation in physical environments fundamentally requires geometric understanding and spatial reasoning. While some VLA approaches attempt to incorporate 3D information, they are constrained by limited data availability and geometric information loss in current 3D encoding pipelines, and fail to jointly capture 3D geometry and temporally structured actions in dynamic environments. To address these limitations, we introduce Lift3D-VLA, a unified VLA framework that equips models with explicit 3D point cloud reasoning and enables temporally coherent action generation. First, building upon our previous work Lift3D, an enhanced 2D model-lifting strategy is proposed to geometrically align 3D points with pretrained 2D positional embeddings. This design enables direct point-cloud encoding within the VLA vision encoder while minimizing spatial information loss. Based on explicit 3D inputs, we propose Geometry-Centric Masked Autoencoding (GC-MAE), a dual-objective self-supervised framework that reconstructs the current point cloud while predicting its future geometric evolution. This formulation allows the 2D vision encoder to internalize both 3D structure and physical dynamics. To fully exploit 3D representations, we further design layer-wise temporal action modeling, which leverages multiple layers of the LLM to collaboratively predict action chunks, enabling temporally consistent predictions. Across 22 simulated tasks and 8 real-world manipulation tasks, Lift3D-VLA achieves 10.8% and 11.1% higher mean success rates on MetaWorld and RLBench than the best-performing prior VLA methods, and outperforms the strongest real-world baseline by 4 percentage points, while exhibiting stronger generalization to out-of-distribution perturbations.

title: ELSA3D: Elastic Semantic Anchoring for Unified 3D Understanding and Generation
summary: Unified 3D foundation models aspire to generate 3D assets and reason about them in language within a single backbone, but their text-3D interaction remains largely implicit. Existing methods concatenate text and 3D tokens into a flat sequence and rely on self-attention, collapsing coarse structural cues and fine geometric details into one undifferentiated representation. We introduce ELSA3D, a unified 3D model that addresses this with elastic semantic anchoring, structuring language and geometric reasoning jointly along matched abstraction scales. ELSA3D represents geometry with a scale-aware octree tokenizer and introduces Anchor Tokens, sparse cross-modal units that select semantic cues, route them to the most relevant 3D scale, retrieve scale-specific geometric evidence, and write the fused signal back into the unified representation, keeping interaction sparse yet precise. A lightweight per-block router makes both computation and reasoning elastic, choosing which text tokens instantiate anchors at which geometric scale so that cross-modal capacity concentrates where alignment is most needed. ELSA3D achieves state-of-the-art performance across image-to-3D generation, text-to-3D generation, and 3D captioning, outperforming the strongest unified baseline while roughly halving FLOPs and inference latency relative to the non-elastic version of the same model.

title: Broken Ergodicity and the Violation of the Fluctuation-Dissipation Theorem Lead to Generalization Beyond Overfitting in Machine Learning
summary: The remarkable ability of modern neural networks to generalize improves with increasing network capacity, even when the number of model parameters or effective degrees of freedom exceeds the number of training data points. This phenomenon is all the more surprising given that generalization error diverges when the number of model parameters approaches a critical value from below. Here we use dynamical mean field theory to show that this so-called "double descent" behavior is the outcome of a phase transition in the stochastic field theory describing the training process. We calculate the critical exponents and scaling function of the double descent phase transition, and show that it is marked by a breakdown of the fluctuation-dissipation theorem associated with broken ergodicity. The corresponding response function has the same functional form as the simple London model of the superconducting transition, with the rigidity of the wave function corresponding to the neural network's ability to generalize accurately.

title: On the Group Randomness of 0-1 Real Sequences from Binary Linear Codes
summary: In this paper, we study the group randomness of 0-1 real sequences derived from a binary linear code by investigating the spectral behaviour of a suitable normalization of the Gram matrix of a $p \times n$ random matrix whose rows are uniformly drawn from those 0-1 real sequences, where $y=p/n \in (0,1)$ is fixed. We show that as $n \to \infty$, its empirical spectral distribution converges to the Marchenko-Pastur law at a rate at least of the order $n^{-1/4}$ with high probability, and the fluctuation of its largest eigenvalue is asymptotically Gaussian with mean $p+1+y$ and variance $4y$, provided that the dual distance of the code is at least 5.

title: Retrieval over Reasoning: A Cost-Controlled Benchmark of Language Models for Energy-Retrofit Recommendation
summary: Recommending the correct set of energy conservation measures (ECMs) for a building is a structured, multi-label prediction problem in which a task-specific supervised model has weak training signal and a general language model has no grounding in the local building stock. We study this problem on 10,422 real New York City Local Law 87 (LL87) energy-audit records, taking as ground truth the set of ECM categories that certified auditors actually recommended. We make four contributions. First, we establish that energy-use-intensity (EUI) prediction - the upstream task - is effectively solved by tree ensembles: across fifteen trained models, a stacking ensemble reaches a coefficient of determination R^2 = 0.757, and every one of six neural architectures is outperformed by gradient-boosted trees. Second, we show that the framing of the recommendation task dominates model choice: recasting ECM recommendation as 19-way multi-label classification rather than single-label categorization lifts a gradient-boosted-tree baseline from a previously reported 25.9% accuracy to a micro-F1 of 0.571. Third, we benchmark eight large language models (LLMs) from four providers in a 2x2 design that independently toggles retrieval grounding and explicit reasoning, scoring each arm on per-label F1, U.S.-dollar cost per building, and latency; retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves micro-F1 by +0.11 to +0.20 on every model, while explicit reasoning yields no measurable accuracy change (-0.018 to +0.010) at up to 8.4x the cost. Fourth, we show LLMs systematically over-recommend - high recall, low precision - and that retrieval closes the gap chiefly by improving precision. A 70-billion-parameter open-weight model with a fifteen-line nearest-neighbor retrieval step reaches 0.511 micro-F1 at $0.00032 per building, comparable to a frontier model at roughly 10.1x lower cost.

title: SHARC: SHAP-Based Interpretability in Machine Learning Risk Models for Regulatory Capital under ICAAP and CCAR
comments: Builds on: Paper 1: arXiv:2605.17275, Paper 2: arXiv:2606.07575
summary:
The adoption of non-parametric machine learning models for regulatory capital estimation introduces a fundamental governance challenge: the inability to explain model outputs in a manner auditable by supervisory bodies. This 'black box' problem remains a major barrier to the adoption of Gaussian Process Regression (GPR) and related ML architectures in ICAAP and CCAR workflows despite their predictive advantages over traditional parametric approaches.
  This paper addresses this barrier through SHARC (SHAP for Regulatory Capital), an explainability framework for the Hybrid GPR-HS architecture and its stress-testing extension. SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP), derived from cooperative game theory and satisfying the properties of Local Accuracy, Missingness, Consistency, and Efficiency, are applied to Stressed Value-at-Risk (SVaR) outputs under three macro scenarios: West Asia War, Climate Risk, and AI Bubble/Regulatory Burden.
  SHARC decomposes SVaR into baseline, mean-driven, and volatility-driven components, enabling transparent linkage between scenario design and capital outcomes. Two findings emerge. First, SHARC consistently links non-linear SVaR outputs to underlying scenario inputs, confirming framework fidelity and providing auditable traceability of capital drivers. Second, under stress conditions, the mean return component (directional loss magnitude) dominates the variance component (volatility baseline) in determining capital levels, with implications for capital limit-setting, position management, and hedging strategy. The results establish SHARC as a regulator-aligned explainability layer that makes the Hybrid GPR-HS framework fully auditable and consistent with FRTB, ICAAP Pillar 2, and CCAR transparency requirements.

title: Black Hole Black Boxes: Numerical Black Hole Metrics via AInstein Neural Networks
summary: The AInstein architecture introduced an unsupervised neural method for solving the Riemannian Einstein equations on arbitrary manifolds. This Physics Informed Neural Network approach (PINN) is extended here to Lorentzian signature, validated by recovering the maximally extended Schwarzschild geometry, and tested as novel search method for arbitrary black hole solutions. The topology is built into the architecture by treating $S^{2}$ globally through its standard embedding, such that the network learns an ambient metric on the manifold $\mathbb{R}^{2} \times \mathbb{R}^{3}$, where Penrose coordinates are chosen for $\mathbb{R}^2$ and the metric on $S^{2}$ is obtained by pullback. The architecture is first trained with the objective of recovering the Schwarzschild metric via losses encoding the vacuum Einstein equation, a quadratic Weyl scalar constraint, and the $SO(3)$ symmetry of the resultant metric; directly motivated by the Birkhoff--Jebsen theorem. Following this, the objective is generalised to use the Petrov speciality index, a horizon curvature anchor, and a trapped-surface constraint, to allow search for algebraically general Petrov type I solutions, finding potentially novel general-type Lorentzian Einstein metrics with a genuinely trapped interior.

title: Lean-Quantum: Toward AI-Assisted Formalization of Quantum Information
comments: 34 pages, the Lean library is available at https://github.com/Hayata-Yamasaki-Group/lean-quantum
summary: Quantum information theory is built on entropic quantities; among them, the sandwiched Rényi relative entropy is a fundamental divergence with various applications, and its data processing inequality (DPI) under quantum channels is a cornerstone result. In this work, we present a Lean 4 library for quantum information, designed as a reusable formal infrastructure for theoretical analysis. As a central demonstration of the library, we formalize the DPI for the sandwiched Rényi relative entropy for positive semidefinite operators on finite-dimensional quantum systems. The library provides a basis-independent operator-theoretic framework for finite-dimensional quantum mechanics compatible with the standard mathematical library Mathlib, including reusable interfaces for finite-dimensional systems, states, channels, tensor products, partial traces, Choi operators, Kraus representations, and Stinespring representations. It also builds infrastructure for noncommutative trace inequalities, including operator monotonicity and convexity via the real continuous functional calculus, block-operator positivity, Hilbert-Schmidt operator spaces, Jensen's operator inequality, generalized perspectives, operator power means, and Lieb-Ando trace inequalities. On top of this framework, we formalize entropy-specific ingredients for the DPI: variational formulas for the sandwiched quasi-entropy via Young and reverse-Young inequalities, tensor-product compatibility of real powers, and Haar measures on unitary groups. Together, these components yield a Lean formalization of the DPI, give strong subadditivity as a corollary, and provide the last missing component needed to complete the Lean formalization of the generalized quantum Stein's lemma. More broadly, the development provides machine-checkable foundations for future formalized and AI-assisted research in quantum information theory.

title: Towards Lattice Surgery Compilation for the Color Code Using Pipe Diagrams
summary: Pipe diagrams have emerged as a powerful framework for flexible lattice surgery compilation and spacetime optimization for the surface code. In contrast, analogous compilation techniques for color code architectures remain largely unexplored, despite the color code's favorable properties, including reduced qubit overhead and transversal single-qubit Clifford gates. In this work, we develop a pipe diagram representation for the triangular color code on the 6.6.6 lattice and establish its correspondence to ZX-diagrammatic descriptions of computation. We present distance-independent constructions of color code pipe diagrams together with explicit realizations of correlation surfaces, stabilizers, and syndrome extraction circuits. This framework enables both macroscopic optimization of logical computations in spacetime and microscopic compilation to executable syndrome extraction circuits. We demonstrate the potential for compact spacetime embeddings with the color code's geometry. These results provide a foundation for automated lattice surgery compilation and diagrammatic optimization in color code architectures.

title: Higher-Order Certified Robustness for Regression
comments: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Randomized smoothing has emerged as a scalable technique for certifying the adversarial robustness of classifiers. However, its application to regression remains under-explored and faces unique challenges. Existing regression certificates rely on probabilistic acceptance regions and fail to exploit the local geometry of the function. In this work, we present a novel framework for certified robust regression that addresses these limitations. We derive a prediction-centered certificate that guarantees the stability of the smoothed model's prediction and ensures practical computability at test time. We investigate several alternatives for constructing these certificates by explicitly incorporating means, variances, and gradients. In particular, we demonstrate on the MNIST rotation task that utilizing gradient information yields significantly tighter robustness certificates compared to the current state-of-the-art, alpha-smoothing.

title: On The Linear Convergence of Bregman Proximal Gradient Methods with Applications to Kullback--Leibler regression
summary: Bregman Proximal Gradient methods (BPGM) exploit the underlying geometry of the objective function through a carefully chosen mirror map. In this work, we introduce a novel notion of strong convexity, termed Restricted Relative Strong Convexity, and establish linear convergence rates for BPGM under this condition. We then exploit the proposed theoretical framework to provide an in-depth analysis of the convergence of BPGM for (regularized) Kullback--Leibler regression problems, covering scenarios with both unique and non-unique minimizers, as well as regularized and unregularized formulations. Specifically, we demonstrate that using the popular Burg's entropy as a distance-generating function may only yield linear convergence for certain KL regression problems. In contrast, we show that employing a smoothed version of the Burg's entropy induces the suitable geometry required to guarantee linear convergence. We conclude with numerical experiments that nicely align with our theoretical findings.
