AI.title_translation: 通过整合因果结构改进TabPFN的合成数据生成
AI.tldr: 本文通过在TabPFN的推理过程中引入因果图结构（DAG/PDAG），解决了模型因生成顺序与实际因果关系不符导致的虚假相关问题，从而提升了合成数据的质量和因果保真度。
AI.motivation: TabPFN作为一种自回归模型，其生成顺序往往与数据的实际因果结构不符，导致生成的数据存在虚假相关，进而影响数据质量及对因果效应的保持能力。
AI.method: 提出了两种方法：一是基于有向无环图（DAG）的条件生成，即按因果父节点顺序生成变量；二是基于部分有向无环图（PDAG）的策略，用于处理因果结构知识不完整的情况。这些方法在无需调整模型参数的情况下，于推理阶段直接介入生成过程。
AI.result: 实验表明，DAG感知条件生成在大多数情况下优于原始TabPFN；在部分因果知识情况下，利用Oracle-PDAG可获得中等增益，且该方法的有效性高度依赖于因果结构发现的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明，通过在推理阶段将因果结构（DAG或部分DAG）整合进TabPFN的生成过程，可以显著提高合成数据的结构保真度和因果效应保持能力。
AI.translation: 合成表格数据生成解决了各个领域中数据稀缺和隐私限制的问题。表格先验数据拟合网络（TabPFN）是一种用于表格数据的最新基础模型，已被证明能够生成高质量的合成表格数据。然而，TabPFN是自回归的：特征是根据输入数据中出现的顺序，通过调节前序特征来顺序生成的。我们证明，当特征顺序与因果结构冲突时，模型会产生虚假相关，从而损害其生成合成数据和保持因果效应的能力。我们通过两种互补的方法将因果结构整合到TabPFN的生成过程中来解决这一局限性：有向无环图（DAG）感知条件生成，它根据每个变量的因果父节点进行采样；以及针对部分因果知识场景的基于部分有向无环图（PDAG）的策略。我们在受控基准测试和六个CSuite数据集上评估了这些方法，评估了结构保真度、分布质量和平均处理效应（ATE）的保持情况。在大多数设置中，DAG感知条件生成相对于原始TabPFN提高了合成数据的质量和稳定性。在部分因果知识下，仅定向指向碰撞器（collider）边缘的Oracle部分有向无环图（Oracle-PDAG）显示出适度的增益，而从数据中发现的完全部分有向无环图（CPDAG）的益处取决于因果结构的恢复程度。这些结果表明，可靠的因果结构（即使是部分的）可以在推理时注入到TabPFN中，无需参数更新，从而提高合成数据质量。
AI.summary: 针对TabPFN在处理表格数据时因自回归顺序与因果结构冲突而产生的缺陷，本文提出将因果结构（DAG/PDAG）整合到生成过程中，通过在推理阶段引导变量生成顺序，显著提升了合成数据的质量及因果效应的保留水平。
AI.keywords: TabPFN, 合成数据生成, 因果结构, 有向无环图 (DAG), 平均处理效应 (ATE)
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将因果结构引入到基于Transformer的表格数据生成模型（TabPFN）中，解决了模型因自回归生成顺序与实际因果关系冲突而产生的虚假相关问题。这是一个非常实用的改进，无需重新训练模型，仅在推理阶段注入先验知识即可提升生成质量。

title: Layered Performance Analysis of TLS 1.3 Handshakes: Classical, Hybrid, and Pure Post-Quantum Key Exchange
comments: Accepted in SPIQE 2026 (Workshop on Secure Protocol Implementations in the Quantum Era), associated to Euro S&P 2026. v2 incorporates peer-review feedback. Clarified per-layer methodology and terminology, added discussion of client/server computational asymmetry of ML-KEM, refined effect-size framing of TLS handshake results, expanded future work, and added funding acknowledgment
summary: In this paper, we present a laboratory study focused on the impact of post-quantum cryptography (PQC) algorithms on multiple layers of stateful HTTP over TLS transactions: the TCP handshake, the intermediate TCP-TLS layer, the TLS handshake, the intermediate TLS layer, and the HTTP application layer. To this end, we propose a laboratory architecture that emulates a real-world setup in which a load test of up to 100 transactions per second is sent to a load balancer, which in turn forwards them to a backend server that returns the responses. Each set of tests is executed using the TLS 1.3 key exchange groups as follows: traditional (or non-PQC), hybrid PQC and pure PQC. Each set of tests also varied the backend response size. Across more than thirty experiments, we performed data reduction and statistical analysis for each layer, to determine the specific impact of each algorithm (PQC and traditional) at every stage of the HTTP-over-TLS transaction.

title: Leech Lattice Vector Quantization for Efficient LLM Compression
authors: Tycho F. A. van der Ouderaa
summary: Scalar quantization of large language models (LLMs) is fundamentally limited by information-theoretic bounds. While vector quantization (VQ) overcomes these limits by encoding blocks of parameters jointly, practical implementations must avoid the need for expensive lookup mechanisms or other explicit codebook storage. Lattice approaches address this through highly structured and dense packing. This paper explores the Leech lattice, which, with its optimal sphere packing and kissing configurations at 24 dimensions, is the highest dimensional lattice known with such optimal properties. To make the Leech lattice usable for LLM quantization, we extend an existing search algorithm based on the extended Golay code construction, to i) support indexing, enabling conversion to and from bitstrings without materializing the codebook, ii) allow angular search over union of Leech lattice shells, iii) propose fully-parallelisable dequantization kernel. Lastly, we provide a geometric reinterpretation of combining shape--gain quantization with GPTQ-style Hessian corrections: the standard scale-correction step of shape--gain acts as a retraction onto a product of spheres, yielding a Spherical GPTQ primarily acting on directions. We find that low-angular-distortion LLVQ reduces sensitivity to Hadamard/rotation preprocessing, and enables a strong Hadamard-free PTQ in practice. LLVQ delivers state-of-the-art LLM quantization performance, outperforming recent methods such as Quip\#, QTIP, and PVQ. The results highlight the effectiveness of high-dimensional lattices for scalable, theoretically grounded model compression.

title: LingDT-VL-OCR: Structure-Aware Document-Level Parsing with Fine-Grained Visual Reference
summary: In this paper, we propose LingDT-VL-OCR, a document parsing system tailored to financial-domain documents, transforming ultra-long financial PDFs into semantically consistent, highly accurate, structured outputs with auditing-grade provenance. To address finance-specific challenges such as complex layouts, cross-page structural discontinuities, and cell-level referencing capability, LingDT-VL-OCR combines (1) a Cross-page Contents Consolidation algorithm to restore continuity across pages and a Document-level Heading Hierarchy Reconstruction (DHR) module to build a globally consistent Table of Contents (TOC) tree for structure-aware retrieval, and (2) a difficulty-adaptive curriculum learning training strategy for table parsing, together with a CellBBoxRegressor module that uses structural anchor tokens to localize table cells from decoder hidden states without external detectors. Experiments demonstrate that our model shows high performance on the Overall metric of OmniDocBench. To enable realistic evaluation in the financial vertical, we further introduce FinDocBench, a benchmark that includes six financial document categories with expert-verified annotations and evaluation metrics including Table of Contents edit-distance-based similarity (TocEDS), cross-page concatenated TEDS, and Table Cell Intersection over Union (C-IoU). We evaluate a wide range of state-of-the-art models on FinDocBench to assess their capabilities and remaining limitations on financial documents. Overall, LingDT-VL-OCR and FinDocBench provide a practical foundation for reliable downstream financial document applications.

title: O3N: Omnidirectional Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Prediction
comments: The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/MengfeiD/O3N
summary: Understanding and reconstructing the 3D world through omnidirectional perception is becoming increasingly important for autonomous agents and embodied systems. However, existing 3D occupancy prediction methods are constrained by limited perspective inputs and a predefined training distribution, making them difficult to apply to embodied agents that require comprehensive and safe perception of scenes in open-world exploration. To address this, we present O3N, the first framework for open-vocabulary occupancy prediction from a single omnidirectional RGB image. O3N embeds omnidirectional voxels in a polar-spiral topology via the Polar-spiral Mamba (PsM) module, enabling continuous spatial representation and long-range context modeling across 360°. The Occupancy Cost Aggregation (OCA) module introduces a principled mechanism for unifying geometric and semantic supervision within the voxel space, ensuring consistency between the reconstructed geometry and the underlying semantic structure. Moreover, Natural Modality Alignment (NMA) establishes a gradient-free alignment pathway that harmonizes visual features, voxel embeddings, and text semantics, forming a consistent ``pixel-voxel-text'' representation triad. Extensive experiments on multiple models demonstrate that our method not only achieves state-of-the-art performance on QuadOcc and Human360Occ benchmarks but also exhibits remarkable cross-scene generalization and semantic scalability, highlighting the potential of O3N for scalable open-world 3D scene understanding. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/MengfeiD/O3N.

title: What Counts as Real? Speech Restoration and Voice Quality Conversion Pose New Challenges to Deepfake Detection
comments: 7 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE SLT 2026
summary: Audio anti-spoofing systems are typically trained to assign one authenticity label to an entire speech utterance. This formulation becomes under-specified for transformations where the underlying speaker identity and linguistic content remain unchanged. We study this problem using benign, authenticity-preserving speech transformations, including voice quality conversion and speech restoration, applied to both bona fide and spoofed speech. Instead of treating all processed audio as spoofed, we factorise labels into source authenticity and processed status. Across SSL representations and DF-Arena fine-tuning experiments, we find that utterance processing status can transfer more reliably than source attribution: detectors can often identify that speech has been processed, while still confusing processed bona fide and processed spoofed speech. These results suggest that audio deepfake defences must move beyond the binary spoofed/authentic paradigm. Robust detection requires granular reporting on source authenticity, processing status, and precise processing localisation.

title: From Passive Observer to Active Critic: Reinforcement Learning Elicits Process Reasoning for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Accurate process supervision remains a critical challenge for long-horizon robotic manipulation. A primary bottleneck is that current video MLLMs, trained primarily under a Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) paradigm, function as passive "Observers" that recognize ongoing events rather than evaluating the current state relative to the final task goal. In this paper, we introduce PRIMO R1 (Process Reasoning Induced Monitoring), a 7B framework that transforms video MLLMs into active "Critics". We leverage outcome-based Reinforcement Learning to incentivize explicit Chain-of-Thought generation for progress estimation. Furthermore, our architecture constructs a structured temporal input by explicitly anchoring the video sequence between initial and current state images. Supported by the proposed PRIMO Dataset and Benchmark, extensive experiments across diverse in-domain environments and out-of-domain real-world humanoid scenarios demonstrate that PRIMO R1 achieves state-of-the-art performance. Quantitatively, our 7B model achieves a 50% reduction in the mean absolute error of specialized reasoning baselines, demonstrating significant relative accuracy improvements over 72B-scale general MLLMs. Furthermore, PRIMO R1 exhibits strong zero-shot generalization on difficult failure detection tasks. We establish state-of-the-art performance on RoboFail benchmark with 67.0% accuracy, surpassing closed-source models like OpenAI o1 by 6.0%.

title: NAMD: Virtual Follow-up Computed Tomography Synthesis via Nodule-Aligned Multimodal Diffusion Models for Early Lung Cancer Diagnosis
summary: Lung cancer remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, with survival outcomes critically dependent on early and accurate detection. When low-dose computed tomography (LDCT) findings are indeterminate, clinicians typically defer diagnosis pending follow-up CT imaging obtained up to 12 months later, inevitably delaying treatment for patients with malignant nodules. To address this clinical gap, we propose Nodule-Aligned Multimodal (Latent) Diffusion (NAMD), a novel generative framework that synthesizes one-year follow-up nodule CT images conditioned on the baseline CT scan, quantitative nodule biomarkers, and patient-level Electronic Health Records (EHR), enabling timely prediction of nodule malignant progression without requiring actual follow-up scans. NAMD introduces two key contributions: (i) a nodule-aligned latent space regularized so that embedding distances reflect clinically meaningful biomarker changes, and (ii) an LLM-driven multimodal conditioning mechanism encoding heterogeneous EHR data into the diffusion backbone. Evaluated on the National Lung Screening Trial (NLST), our method's synthetic follow-up images achieve an AUROC of 0.805 and an AUPRC of 0.346 for lung nodule malignancy prediction, outperforming both the baseline LDCT performance without virtual follow-up generation, and existing state-of-the-art conditional generation methods, while maintaining competitive image quality. These findings suggest that NAMD enables earlier and more accurate lung cancer diagnosis by capturing clinically meaningful features of nodule progression.

title: Towards Interpretable Framework for Neural Audio Codecs via Sparse Autoencoders: A Case Study on Accent Information
summary: Neural Audio Codecs (NACs) are widely adopted in modern speech systems, yet how they encode linguistic and paralinguistic information remains unclear. Improving the interpretability of NAC representations is critical for understanding and deploying them in sensitive applications. Hence, we employ Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to decompose dense NAC representations into sparse, interpretable activations. In this work, we focus on a challenging paralinguistic attribute-accent-and propose a framework to quantify NAC interpretability. We evaluate four NAC models under 16 SAE configurations using a relative performance index. Our results show that DAC and SpeechTokenizer achieve the highest interpretability. We further reveal that acoustic-oriented NACs encode accent information primarily in activation magnitudes of sparse representations, whereas phonetic-oriented NACs rely more on activation positions, and that low-bitrate EnCodec variants show higher interpretability.

title: Towards Interpretable Foundation Models for Retinal Fundus Images
comments: 11 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, submitted to MICCAI 2026
summary: Foundation models are used to extract transferable representations from large amounts of unlabeled data, typically via self-supervised learning (SSL). However, many of these models rely on architectures that offer limited interpretability, a critical issue in high-stakes domains such as medical imaging. We propose \model, a foundation model that is interpretable-by-design via a BagNet backbone whose small receptive fields generate class evidence maps that are faithful to the model's decision-making process. Additionally, \model{} incorporates a $2D$ projection layer during pretraining that enables direct visualization of the representation space, providing a dataset-level view of the learned structure including meaningful clinical clusters as well as potential spurious correlations. We trained \model{} on over 800,000 color fundus photographs from various sources to learn generalizable representations for different downstream tasks. Our model achieves performance comparable to RETFound, which has $16\times$ more parameters, while providing interpretable predictions on out-of-distribution data. These results suggest that large-scale SSL pretraining paired with inherent interpretability can lead to robust representations for retinal imaging. Code and pretrained models are available at \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/dual-ifm-3D5A/README.md}{www.anonymous.4open.science/dual-IFM}.

title: DreamPartGen: Semantically Grounded Part-Level 3D Generation via Collaborative Latent Denoising
summary: Understanding and generating 3D objects as compositions of meaningful parts is fundamental to human perception and reasoning. However, most text-to-3D methods overlook the semantic and functional structure of parts. While recent part-aware approaches introduce decomposition, they remain largely geometry-focused, lacking semantic grounding and failing to model how parts align with textual descriptions or their inter-part relations. We propose DreamPartGen, a framework for semantically grounded, part-aware text-to-3D generation. DreamPartGen introduces Duplex Part Latents (DPLs) that jointly model each part's geometry and appearance, and Relational Semantic Latents (RSLs) that capture inter-part dependencies derived from language. A synchronized co-denoising process enforces mutual geometric and semantic consistency, enabling coherent, interpretable, and text-aligned 3D synthesis. Across multiple benchmarks, DreamPartGen delivers state-of-the-art performance in geometric fidelity and text-shape alignment.

title: IndoorR2X: Indoor Robot-to-Everything Coordination with LLM-Driven Planning
summary: Although robot-to-robot (R2R) communication improves indoor scene understanding beyond what a single robot can achieve, R2R alone cannot overcome partial observability without substantial exploration overhead or scaling team size. In contrast, many indoor environments already include low-cost Internet of Things (IoT) sensors (e.g., cameras) that provide persistent, building-wide context beyond onboard perception. We therefore introduce IndoorR2X, a benchmark and simulation framework for Large Language Model (LLM)-driven multi-robot task planning with Robot-to-Everything (R2X) perception and communication in indoor environments. IndoorR2X integrates observations from mobile robots and static IoT devices to construct a global semantic state that supports scalable scene understanding, reduces redundant exploration, and enables high-level coordination through LLM-based planning. IndoorR2X provides configurable simulation environments, sensor layouts, robot teams, and task suites to systematically evaluate semantic-level coordination strategies. Extensive experiments across diverse settings demonstrate that IoT-augmented world modeling improves multi-robot efficiency and reliability, and we highlight key insights and failure modes for advancing LLM-based collaboration between robot teams and indoor IoT sensors. title: Communication Lower Bounds and Algorithms for Sketching with Random Dense Matrices
summary: Sketching is widely used in randomized linear algebra for low-rank matrix approximation, column subset selection, and many other problems, and it has gained significant traction in machine learning applications. However, sketching large matrices often necessitates distributed memory algorithms, where communication overhead becomes a critical bottleneck on modern supercomputing clusters. Despite its growing relevance, distributed-memory parallel strategies for sketching remain largely unexplored. In this work, we establish communication lower bounds for sketching using dense matrices that determine how much data movement is required to perform it in parallel. One important observation of our lower bounds is that no communication is required for a small number of processors. We show that our lower bounds are tight by presenting communication optimal algorithms. Furthermore, we extend our approach to determine communication lower bounds for computations of Nyström approximation where sketching is applied twice. We also introduce novel parallel algorithms whose communication costs are close to the lower bounds. Finally, we implement our algorithms on modern state-of-the-art supercomputing infrastructures which have both CPU- and GPU-equipped systems and demonstrate their parallel scalability.

AI.title_translation: 基于随机稠密矩阵草图算法的通信下界与算法
AI.tldr: 本文建立了分布式稠密矩阵草图算法及Nyström逼近的通信下界，并提出了通信最优的并行算法，在现代超算集群上实现了高效的并行扩展。
AI.motivation: 在大规模矩阵计算中，草图算法（sketching）常需依赖分布式内存算法，而通信开销是现代超算集群中的主要性能瓶颈。然而，目前针对分布式内存的并行草图策略在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。
AI.method:
1. 理论推导：建立了使用稠密矩阵进行草图化（sketching）的通信下界，并将其扩展至双重草图化的Nyström逼近。
2. 算法设计：设计了通信最优的并行草图算法，以及通信成本接近下界的新型Nyström逼近并行算法。
3. 实验实现：在配备CPU和GPU的现代先进超算基础设施上实现了这些算法，以测试其并行扩展性。
AI.result: 证明了所提出的通信下界是紧的（tight），并展示了新算法的通信成本非常接近下界。在现代CPU和GPU超算系统上的实验结果表明，所提算法具有优异的并行可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功为基于稠密矩阵的草图算法以及Nyström逼近建立了通信下界，并提出了通信最优或接近下界的并行算法。在现代超算基础设施上的实验表明，这些算法具有良好的并行可扩展性，有效缓解了分布式计算中的通信瓶颈。
AI.translation: 草图法（Sketching）广泛应用于随机线性代数中的低秩矩阵逼近、列子集选择等诸多问题，并在机器学习应用中获得了极大的关注。然而，对大规模矩阵进行草图化通常需要分布式内存算法，其中通信开销成为现代超级计算机集群上的关键瓶颈。尽管其相关性日益增加，但用于草图化的分布式内存并行策略在很大程度上仍未得到探索。在这项工作中，我们建立了使用稠密矩阵进行草图化的通信下界，这些下界决定了并行执行该操作需要多少数据移动。我们的下界的一个重要发现是，对于较少数量的处理器，不需要进行通信。我们通过提出通信最优算法，证明了我们的下界是紧的。此外，我们将我们的方法扩展到确定Nyström逼近计算的通信下界，其中草图化被应用了两次。我们还引入了通信成本接近下界的新型并行算法。最后，我们在配备CPU和GPU系统的现代先进超级计算基础设施上实现了我们的算法，并展示了它们的并行可扩展性。

AI.keywords: 草图算法, 通信下界, 分布式内存, 随机线性代数, Nyström逼近
AI.comments: 本文填补了分布式草图（sketching）算法在通信复杂性理论上的空白。其创新之处不仅在于推导出了紧凑的通信下界，还在于设计了与之匹配的通信最优并行算法，并将研究扩展到了更复杂的Nyström逼近。在现代CPU-GPU异构超算集群上的实验部署，进一步证明了该研究具有极高的实用价值和可扩展性。

title: SpatialFly: Implicit 3D Prior-Guided Visual Reparameterization for Continuous UAV Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: UAVs play an important role in applications such as autonomous exploration, disaster response, and infrastructure inspection. However, UAV VLN in complex 3D environments remains challenging. A key difficulty is the structural representation mismatch between 2D visual perception and the 3D trajectory decision space, which limits spatial reasoning. To this end, we propose SpatialFly, a geometry-guided spatial representation framework for UAV VLN. Operating on RGB observations without explicit 3D reconstruction, SpatialFly introduces a geometry-guided 2D adaptive representation mechanism. Specifically, the geometric prior injection module injects global structural cues into 2D semantic tokens to provide scene-level geometric guidance. The geometry-aware reparameterization module then uses geometry-conditioned cross-modal attention and gated residual fusion to adaptively reparameterize the visual tokens. Experimental results show that SpatialFly consistently outperforms state-of-the-art UAV VLN baselines across both seen and unseen environments, reducing NE by 4.03m and improving SR by 1.27% over the strongest baseline on the unseen Full split. Additional trajectory-level analysis shows that SpatialFly produces trajectories with better path alignment and smoother, more stable motion.

title: HumanOmni-Speaker: Identifying Who said What and When
summary: While Omni-modal Large Language Models have made strides in joint sensory processing, they fundamentally struggle with a cornerstone of human interaction: deciphering complex, multi-person conversational dynamics to accurately answer ``Who said what and when.'' Current models suffer from an ``illusion of competence'' -- they exploit visual biases in conventional benchmarks to bypass genuine cross-modal alignment, while relying on sparse, low-frame-rate visual sampling that destroys crucial high-frequency dynamics like lip movements. To shatter this illusion, we introduce Visual-Registered Speaker Diarization and Recognition (VR-SDR) and the HumanOmni-Speaker Benchmark. By strictly eliminating visual shortcuts, this rigorous paradigm demands true end-to-end spatio-temporal identity binding using only natural language queries. To overcome the underlying architectural perception gap, we propose HumanOmni-Speaker, powered by a Visual Delta Encoder. By sampling raw video at 25 fps and explicitly compressing inter-frame motion residuals into just 6 tokens per frame, it captures fine-grained visemes and speaker trajectories without triggering a catastrophic token explosion. Ultimately, HumanOmni-Speaker demonstrates strong multimodal synergy, natively enabling end-to-end lip-reading and high-precision spatial localization without intrusive cropping, and achieving superior performance across a wide spectrum of speaker-centric tasks.

AI.title_translation: HumanOmni-Speaker：识别谁在何时说了什么
AI.tldr: 为了解决多模态大模型在多人对话中的识别能力不足，本文提出了HumanOmni-Speaker，通过高效的运动残差编码实现了精准的说话人识别与时空定位。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大模型在处理多人对话时存在“能力错觉”，过度依赖视觉偏差而非真正的跨模态对齐，且低帧率采样导致无法捕捉唇部等高频动态信息。
AI.method: 提出了Visual-Registered Speaker Diarization and Recognition (VR-SDR)范式，并设计了Visual Delta Encoder架构，通过25 fps采样率和将帧间运动残差压缩为每帧6个token的方式，实现细粒度时空身份绑定。
AI.result: 在无需侵入式裁剪的情况下，实现了端到端唇语识别和高精度空间定位，并在多个说话人中心任务中表现出优异性能。
AI.conclusion: HumanOmni-Speaker通过引入视觉对齐和高效的运动编码，成功克服了现有模型在多人对话场景下的局限，实现了高精度的说话人识别与定位。
AI.translation: 尽管全模态大模型在联合感官处理方面取得了进展，但它们在人类互动的基石方面存在根本性困难：即解读复杂的多人对话动态，以准确回答“谁在何时说了什么”。当前模型深受“能力错觉”之苦——它们利用传统基准测试中的视觉偏差来绕过真正的跨模态对齐，同时依赖稀疏、低帧率的视觉采样，破坏了诸如唇部运动等关键的高频动态。为了打破这种错觉，我们引入了视觉注册说话人日志与识别（VR-SDR）和HumanOmni-Speaker基准。通过严格消除视觉捷径，这一严谨的范式要求仅使用自然语言查询进行真正的端到端时空身份绑定。为了克服潜在的架构感知差距，我们提出了由视觉增量编码器（Visual Delta Encoder）驱动的HumanOmni-Speaker。通过以25 fps的速率采样原始视频，并将帧间运动残差显式压缩为每帧仅6个token，它能在不触发灾难性token爆炸的情况下捕获细粒度的视觉音素和说话人轨迹。最终，HumanOmni-Speaker展示了强大的多模态协同效应，原生支持端到端唇语识别和无需侵入式裁剪的高精度空间定位，并在广泛的说话人中心任务中实现了卓越的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了HumanOmni-Speaker模型及其配套基准，旨在解决多模态大模型在复杂多人对话中难以准确识别“谁在何时说了什么”的问题。通过引入VR-SDR范式和Visual Delta Encoder架构，模型在高帧率下高效编码视觉动态，实现了精准的说话人身份绑定与任务处理。
AI.keywords: 多模态大模型, 说话人日志与识别, 视觉对齐, 唇语识别, 人机交互
AI.comments: 该论文针对当前多模态大模型在处理复杂多人对话时存在的“能力错觉”问题，提出了创新的Visual Delta Encoder架构，通过高帧率采样和高效的运动残差压缩，有效解决了细粒度唇语识别和说话人定位的难题。该研究对提升多模态模型在真实社交场景下的理解能力具有重要意义。

title: Regulating AI Agents
summary: AI agents -- systems that can independently take actions to pursue complex goals with only limited human oversight -- have entered the mainstream. These systems are now being widely used to produce software, conduct business activities, and automate everyday personal tasks. While AI agents implicate many areas of law, ranging from agency law and contracts to tort liability and labor law, they present particularly pressing questions for the most globally consequential AI regulation: the European Union's AI Act. Promulgated prior to the development and widespread use of AI agents, the EU AI Act faces significant obstacles in confronting the governance challenges arising from this transformative technology, such as performance failures in autonomous task execution, the risk of misuse of agents by malicious actors, and unequal access to the economic opportunities afforded by AI agents. We systematically analyze the EU AI Act's response to these challenges, focusing on both the substantive provisions of the regulation and, crucially, the institutional frameworks that aim to support its implementation. Our analysis of the Act's allocation of monitoring and enforcement responsibilities, reliance on industry self-regulation, and level of government resourcing illustrates how a regulatory framework designed for conventional AI systems can be ill-suited to AI agents. Taken together, our findings suggest that policymakers in the EU and beyond will need to change course, and soon, if they are to effectively govern the next generation of AI technology.

AI.title_translation: 监管人工智能智能体
AI.tldr: 欧盟《人工智能法案》是为传统AI设计的，无法有效监管日益普及的AI智能体，亟需改革。
AI.motivation: AI智能体已广泛应用于软件开发、商业活动等领域，但现有的法律和监管框架（尤其是欧盟《人工智能法案》）是在智能体普及前制定的，难以应对其自主执行任务带来的性能故障、恶意使用风险及经济不平等问题。
AI.method: 通过系统性分析欧盟《人工智能法案》的实质性条款、机构执行框架、监测职责分配以及对行业自律的依赖，对比其与AI智能体治理需求之间的差距。
AI.result: 研究发现，欧盟《人工智能法案》在应对AI智能体带来的独特挑战时存在显著缺陷，特别是其监管资源配置、执法责任分配及过度依赖行业自律的模式，并不适用于高度自主的AI智能体。
AI.conclusion: 现有的监管框架（如欧盟《人工智能法案》）是为传统AI系统设计的，难以有效覆盖AI智能体的自主性、复杂性与潜在风险，政策制定者必须尽快调整监管路径以适应下一代AI技术。
AI.translation: AI智能体——即那些仅需有限的人类监督即可独立采取行动以追求复杂目标的系统——已经进入主流。这些系统目前被广泛用于生产软件、开展商业活动以及自动化日常个人任务。虽然AI智能体涉及法律的许多领域，从代理法和合同法到侵权责任和劳动法，但它们为全球最具影响力的AI监管——欧盟《人工智能法案》——提出了特别紧迫的问题。欧盟《人工智能法案》在AI智能体开发和广泛使用之前颁布，在面对这种变革性技术带来的治理挑战（如自主任务执行中的性能故障、恶意行为者滥用智能体的风险，以及对AI智能体提供的经济机会的不平等获取）时，面临着重大障碍。我们系统地分析了欧盟《人工智能法案》对这些挑战的应对，重点关注该法规的实质性条款，以及至关重要的是，旨在支持其执行的制度框架。我们对该法案中监测和执法责任的分配、对行业自律的依赖以及政府资源配置水平的分析表明，为传统AI系统设计的监管框架如何可能不适用于AI智能体。总之，我们的研究结果表明，欧盟及其他地区的政策制定者如果想要有效治理下一代AI技术，就需要尽快改变方针。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了AI智能体对现有法律及欧盟《人工智能法案》带来的治理挑战。研究指出，该法案在设计之初未充分考量智能体的自主性，导致其在应对任务失败、恶意滥用及经济公平性方面存在监管缺口。文章呼吁政策制定者必须改革监管框架，以适应AI智能体带来的新挑战。
AI.keywords: AI智能体, 欧盟人工智能法案, AI监管, 自动化决策, 法律框架
AI.comments: 本文创新性地指出了传统AI监管框架（以欧盟《人工智能法案》为例）在应对高度自主的AI智能体时的局限性。其重要性在于强调了从“静态监管”向“适应性、动态监管”转型的紧迫性，特别是针对智能体在执行任务、滥用风险和经济公平方面的挑战。局限性在于主要聚焦于法律框架分析，未深入探讨具体的技术性监管手段。

title: DecepGPT: Schema-Driven Deception Detection with Multicultural Datasets and Robust Multimodal Learning
summary: Multimodal deception detection aims to identify deceptive behavior by analyzing audiovisual cues for forensics and security. In these high-stakes settings, investigators need verifiable evidence connecting audiovisual cues to final decisions, along with reliable generalization across domains and cultural contexts. However, existing benchmarks provide only binary labels without intermediate reasoning cues. Datasets are also small with limited scenario coverage, leading to shortcut learning. We address these issues through three contributions. First, we construct reasoning datasets by augmenting existing benchmarks with structured cue-level descriptions and reasoning chains, enabling models to output auditable reports. Second, we release T4-Deception, a multicultural dataset based on the unified ``To Tell the Truth'' television format implemented across four countries. With 1695 samples, it is the largest non-laboratory deception detection dataset. Third, we propose two modules for robust learning under small-data conditions. Stabilized Individuality-Commonality Synergy (SICS) refines multimodal representations by combining learnable global priors with sample-adaptive residuals and applying polarity-aware recalibration. Distilled Modality Consistency (DMC) aligns modality-specific predictions with the fused multimodal predictions via knowledge distillation to prevent unimodal shortcut learning. Experiments on three established benchmarks and our novel dataset demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both in-domain and cross-domain scenarios, while exhibiting superior transferability across diverse cultural contexts. The datasets and code are available at this link.

title: UniICL: Systematizing Unified Multimodal In-context Learning through a Capability-Oriented Taxonomy
summary: In-context learning (ICL) enables fast task adaptation from demonstrations without per-task parameter updates but remains highly sensitive to example selection and formatting. In unified multimodal models spanning understanding and generation, this sensitivity is exacerbated by cross-modal interference and varying cognitive demands. Consequently, in-context learning efficacy is often non-monotonic and highly task-dependent. To diagnose these behaviors, we introduce a six-level Capability-Oriented Taxonomy that categorizes the functional role of demonstrations from basic perception to high-order discernment. Guided by this cognitive framework, we construct UniICL-760K, a large-scale corpus featuring curated 8-shot in-context learning episodes across 15 subtasks, alongside UniICL-Bench for rigorous, controlled evaluation. We show that this data-driven assembly is the primary source of our gains. As a complementary, lightweight stabilizer, we additionally propose the Context-Adaptive Prototype Modulator, a plug-and-play module that further improves few-shot stability. Evaluations on UniICL-Bench show that our approach yields highly competitive unified results, outperforming larger-parameter multimodal large language model baselines on most understanding in-context learning tasks. Data and code are available at https://github.com/xuyicheng-zju/UniICL.

title: Efficient ML-DSA Public Key Management Method with Identity for PKI and Its Application
summary: With the rapid evolution of the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT), the boundaries and scale of the Internet are continuously expanding. Consequently, the limitations of traditional certificate-based Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) have become increasingly evident, particularly in scenarios requiring large-scale certificate storage, verification, and frequent transmission. These challenges are expected to be further amplified by the widespread adoption of post-quantum cryptography. In this paper, we propose a novel identity-based public key management framework for PKI based on post-quantum cryptography, termed \textit{IPK-pq}. This approach implements an identity key generation protocol leveraging NIST ML-DSA and random matrix theory. Building on the concept of the Composite Public Key (CPK), \textit{IPK-pq} addresses the linear collusion problem inherent in CPK through an enhanced identity mapping mechanism. Furthermore, it simplifies the verification of the declared public key's authenticity, effectively reducing the complexity associated with certificate-based key management. We also provide a formal security proof for \textit{IPK-pq}, covering both individual private key components and the composite private key. To validate our approach, formally, we directly implement and evaluate \textit{IPK-pq} within a typical PKI application scenario: Resource PKI (RPKI). Comparative experimental results demonstrate that an RPKI system based on \textit{IPK-pq} yields significant improvements in efficiency and scalability. These results validate the feasibility and rationality of \textit{IPK-pq}, positioning it as a strong candidate for next-generation RPKI systems capable of securely managing large-scale routing information.

title: Enabling topography-resolving structural dynamic contact simulation
summary: Damping of structures and systems is often dominated by frictional dissipation in connections, the prediction of which remains a longstanding scientific challenge. Previous studies have shown that the actual topography of contact interfaces may have a strong effect, especially in the partial slip/liftoff regime. We recently proposed a multi-scale method, which couples finite element and boundary element modeling. The primary benefit of this approach is to analyze the effect of actual contact topography on the dynamics of jointed structures. While this multi-scale modeling method was initially developed for quasi-static analysis, we demonstrate herein how it can be used for time step integration and Harmonic Balance analysis. We cross-verify those fully dynamic analysis methods against each other and quasi-static results, for the S4 Beam benchmark. We compare the multi-scale method against state-of-the-art full-FE analysis, in terms of numerical damping and computational performance. Some discrepancy is found to be of physical origin. Depending on the load history, it is shown that the system settles to a slightly different equilibrium. Transient multi-scale simulations enable the prediction of this interesting phenomenon, for the first time, for a structure with bolted joints.

title: Multimodal Analytics of Cybersecurity Crisis Preparation Exercises: What Predicts Success?
comments: Accepted as full paper to the 27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education (AIED 2026), see https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-032-29760-0_47
summary: Instructional alignment, the match between intended cognition and enacted activity, is central to effective instruction but hard to operationalize at scale. We examine alignment in cybersecurity simulations using multimodal traces from 23 teams (76 students) across five exercise sessions. Study 1 codes objectives and team emails with Bloom's taxonomy and models the completion of key exercise tasks with generalized linear mixed models. Alignment, defined as the discrepancy between required and enacted Bloom levels, predicts success, whereas the Bloom category alone does not predict success once discrepancy is considered. Study 2 compares predictive feature families using grouped cross-validation and l1-regularized logistic regression. Text embeddings and log features outperform Bloom-only models (AUC~0.74 and 0.71 vs. 0.55), and their combination performs best (Test AUC~0.80), with Bloom frequencies adding little. Overall, the work offers a measure of alignment for simulations and shows that multimodal traces best forecast performance, while alignment provides interpretable diagnostic insight.

title: Self-Routing: Parameter-Free Expert Routing from Hidden States
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers increase model capacity by activating only a small subset of experts per token, and typically rely on a learned router to map hidden states to expert assignments. In this work, we ask whether a dedicated learned router is strictly necessary for MoE routing. We propose Self-Routing, a parameter-free routing mechanism that uses a designated subspace of the token hidden state directly as expert logits, eliminating the router projection entirely while leaving the rest of the MoE layer unchanged. We evaluate Self-Routing on language modeling across different expert counts and model scales, and on ImageNet-1K classification by comparing it against a standard learned router, random-routing baselines, and dense non-MoE baselines. Our results show that Self-Routing remains competitive with the learned-router baseline while removing all dedicated routing parameters, and yields more balanced expert utilization, with about 17 % higher average normalized routing entropy and no explicit load-balancing loss. On ImageNet-1K with DeiT-S/16, Self-Routing also slightly improves over the corresponding learned-router MoE. These findings suggest that effective MoE routing can emerge from the hidden representation itself without requiring a separate learned router module.

title: Finding Low Star Discrepancy 3D Kronecker Point Sets Using Algorithm Configuration Techniques
summary: The L infinity star discrepancy is a measure for how uniformly a point set is distributed in a given space. Point sets of low star discrepancy are used as designs of experiments, as initial designs for Bayesian optimization algorithms, for quasi-Monte Carlo integration methods, and many other applications. Recent work has shown that classical constructions such as Sobol', Halton, or Hammersley sequences can be outperformed by large margins when considering point sets of fixed sizes rather than their convergence behavior. These results, highly relevant to the aforementioned applications, raise the question of how much existing constructions can be improved through size-specific optimization. In this work, we study this question for the so-called Kronecker construction. Focusing on the 3-dimensional setting, we show that optimizing the two configurable parameters of its construction yields point sets outperforming the state-of-the-art value for sets of at least 500 points. Using the algorithm configuration technique irace, we then derive parameters that yield new state-of-the-art discrepancy values for whole ranges of set sizes.

title: Policy Improvement Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning has become a central post-training paradigm for improving LLM and agent capabilities. Yet existing RL post-training methods share a common blind spot: they construct local learning signals from sampled trajectories, rewards, or feedback-conditioned targets, then update the policy without explicitly verifying whether the resulting policy outperforms its predecessor. Optimizing these local signals does not necessarily produce a better policy, while finite sampling, generation stochasticity and feedback noise can further widen this gap. We argue that the missing ingredient is policy improvement feedback: the ability to measure progress across policy iterations. We introduce Policy Improvement Reinforcement Learning (PIRL), which formulates inter-iteration performance gain as an explicit objective structurally aligned with final task performance. Building on PIRL, we propose Policy Improvement Policy Optimization (PIPO), a plug-in closed-loop framework that verifies the previous update against a sliding-window historical performance anchor. PIPO uses this improvement feedback to modulate the local learning signal of the base policy optimization algorithm, reinforcing updates associated with measured progress and suppressing those associated with performance drops. We provide theoretical evidence that PIPO locally aligns policy updates with the PIRL improvement objective. Experiments on mathematical reasoning, code, tool-use, and self-distillation settings show that PIPO yields consistent gains across PPO, group-relative, and self-distillation policy optimization families.

title: PolyJarvis: An LLM-Orchestrated Agent for Automated All-Atom Molecular Dynamics of Amorphous Homopolymers
summary:
All-atom molecular dynamics (MD) simulations can predict polymer properties from molecular structure, yet their execution requires specialized expertise in force field selection, system construction, equilibration, and property extraction. We present PolyJarvis, an agent that couples a large language model (LLM) with established simulation toolkits, including Enhanced Monte Carlo (EMC) for system construction and LAMMPS for molecular dynamics, through Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, enabling end-to-end polymer property prediction from natural language input. Given a polymer name or SMILES string, PolyJarvis orchestrates molecular model construction, equilibration, and thermal/mechanical property calculation. Validation is conducted on nine amorphous homopolymers spanning seven chemistries: polyethylene (PE), polystyrene (PS), poly(methyl methacrylate) (PMMA), poly(ethylene glycol) (PEG), poly(ether ether ketone) (PEEK), poly(vinyl chloride) (PVC), poly(lactic acid) (PLA), polysulfone (PSU), and cis-polybutadiene (cis-PBD).
  On the replicate mean over four runs, 18 of the 25 property comparisons with experimental references meet the acceptance criteria (glass transition within 50K, density within 5%, bulk modulus within 30%): glass transition 7 of 9, density 5 of 9, and bulk modulus 6 of 7. The failures fall into two groups: polymer consistent force field (PCFF) systems that run under-dense, and the rigid backbones PLA and PEEK, which overestimate the glass transition on cooling. Each was traced to a protocol or an analysis step of the workflow. As a proof of concept, this work shows that an LLM-driven agent can carry out end-to-end polymer MD workflows, with predictive accuracy that varies across properties and polymers.

AI.title_translation: PolyJarvis：用于非晶态均聚物全原子分子动力学的 LLM 编排智能代理
AI.tldr: PolyJarvis 是一个基于大语言模型的自动化工具，能将自然语言输入直接转换为复杂的分子动力学模拟工作流，从而预测聚合物的热力学和力学性质。
AI.motivation: 全原子分子动力学模拟虽能预测聚合物性质，但执行过程复杂（需专业知识进行力场选择、系统构建、平衡等），亟需一种自动化方法来简化流程。
AI.method: 提出 PolyJarvis 智能代理，通过 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 将大语言模型与 Enhanced Monte Carlo (EMC) 及 LAMMPS 工具包集成，实现从名称或 SMILES 字符串到属性计算的自动化工作流。
AI.result: 在九种无定形均聚物的 25 项属性对比中，18 项满足接受标准；详细分析了失败案例（如密度不足或玻璃化转变温度过高），并将其归因于特定的协议或分析步骤。
AI.conclusion: PolyJarvis 证明了基于 LLM 的智能代理能够成功执行端到端的聚合物分子动力学模拟工作流，虽然在某些复杂聚合物和特定属性上存在误差，但为材料科学的自动化模拟提供了可行的框架。
AI.translation: 全原子分子动力学 (MD) 模拟可以根据分子结构预测聚合物的性质，但其执行需要力场选择、系统构建、平衡和性质提取方面的专业知识。我们提出了 PolyJarvis，这是一个通过模型上下文协议 (MCP) 服务器将大型语言模型 (LLM) 与既定的模拟工具包（包括用于系统构建的增强蒙特卡洛 (EMC) 和用于分子动力学的 LAMMPS）耦合的智能代理，实现了从自然语言输入到聚合物性质的端到端预测。给定聚合物名称或 SMILES 字符串，PolyJarvis 会编排分子模型构建、平衡以及热/力学性质计算。我们在涵盖七种化学性质的九种非晶态均聚物上进行了验证：聚乙烯 (PE)、聚苯乙烯 (PS)、聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯 (PMMA)、聚乙二醇 (PEG)、聚醚醚酮 (PEEK)、聚氯乙烯 (PVC)、聚乳酸 (PLA)、聚砜 (PSU) 和顺式聚丁二烯 (cis-PBD)。在四次运行的重复均值上，25 项属性对比中有 18 项达到了验收标准（玻璃化转变在 50K 以内，密度在 5% 以内，体积模量在 30% 以内）：玻璃化转变 9 项中有 7 项，密度 9 项中有 5 项，体积模量 7 项中有 6 项。失败案例分为两组：在低密度下运行的聚合物一致力场 (PCFF) 系统，以及冷却时高估了玻璃化转变温度的刚性骨架 PLA 和 PEEK。每种情况都追溯到了工作流程的协议或分析步骤。作为概念验证，这项工作表明基于 LLM 的智能代理可以执行端到端的聚合物 MD 工作流程，且预测准确性在不同属性和聚合物之间存在差异。
AI.summary: PolyJarvis 是一个集成了大语言模型与分子动力学工具包（EMC、LAMMPS）的自动化智能代理，旨在通过自然语言输入实现聚合物的全原子分子动力学模拟、系统构建及热/力学性质预测，并验证了其在多种聚合物上的预测能力。
AI.keywords: PolyJarvis, 分子动力学, 大语言模型, 聚合物性质预测, 自动化模拟
AI.comments: PolyJarvis 创新性地将大语言模型（LLM）与专业的分子动力学工具包（EMC, LAMMPS）通过 MCP 协议结合，实现了自动化分子模拟工作流。该研究不仅降低了复杂计算化学模拟的门槛，还展示了 AI 代理在科学研究自动化中的巨大潜力。局限性在于对特定聚合物（如刚性骨架材料）的预测精度仍有待优化，且模拟失败原因与协议设置高度相关。

title: When Sinks Help or Hurt: Unified Framework for Attention Sink in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Attention sinks are defined as tokens that attract disproportionate attention. While these have been studied in single modality transformers, their cross-modal impact in Large Vision-Language Models (LVLM) remains largely unexplored: are they redundant artifacts or essential global priors? This paper first categorizes visual sinks into two distinct categories: ViT-emerged sinks (V-sinks), which propagate from the vision encoder, and LLM-emerged sinks (L-sinks), which arise within deep LLM layers. Based on the new definition, our analysis reveals a fundamental performance trade-off: while sinks effectively encode global scene-level priors, their dominance can suppress the fine-grained visual evidence required for local perception. Furthermore, we identify specific functional layers where modulating these sinks most significantly impacts downstream performance. To leverage these insights, we propose Layer-wise Sink Gating (LSG), a lightweight, plug-and-play module that dynamically scales the attention contributions of V-sink and the rest visual tokens. LSG is trained via standard next-token prediction, requiring no task-specific supervision while keeping the LVLM backbone frozen. In most layers, LSG yields improvements on representative multimodal benchmarks, effectively balancing global reasoning and precise local evidence.

title: D-splitting methods: 2N -storage embedded explicit pseudo-geometric Runge-Kutta methods using splitting methods
summary: Low-storage explicit Runge-Kutta schemes are particularly popular for the numerical integration of time-dependent partial differential equations based on the method-of-lines due to their efficiency and their reduced memory requirements. We show that D-splitting methods, splitting methods on the extended phase space, can be used as high performance 2N-storage embedded explicit RK methods without a third storage register. They are pseudo-geometric methods preserving some of the qualitative properties of the exact solution up to a higher order than the order of the method. Some of their properties are analysed, to build new tailored methods, and are tested on numerical examples.

title: Bounded Autonomy: Controlling LLM Characters in Live Multiplayer Games
comments: 9 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables; manuscript unchanged from v1
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are bringing richer dialogue and social behavior into games, but they also expose a control problem that existing game interfaces do not directly address: how should LLM characters participate in live multiplayer interaction while remaining executable in the shared game world, socially coherent with other active characters, and steerable by players when needed? We frame this problem as bounded autonomy, a control architecture for live multiplayer games that organizes LLM character control around three interfaces: agent-agent interaction, agent-world action execution, and player-agent steering. We instantiate bounded autonomy with probabilistic reply-chain decay, an embedding-based action grounding pipeline with fallback, and whisper, a lightweight soft-steering technique that lets players influence a character's next move without fully overriding autonomy. We deploy this architecture in a live multiplayer social game and study its behavior through analyses of interaction stability, grounding quality, whisper intervention success, and formative interviews. Our results show how bounded autonomy makes LLM character interaction workable in practice, frames controllability as a distinct runtime control problem for LLM characters in live multiplayer games, and provides a concrete exemplar for future games built around this interaction paradigm.

AI.title_translation: 有限自主性：在实时多人游戏中控制LLM角色
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种“有限自主性”框架，通过三类接口平衡LLM游戏角色的自主行为与玩家的干预需求，解决了实时多人游戏中AI角色难以控制的痛点。
AI.motivation: 现有的游戏接口无法直接解决LLM角色在实时多人互动中面临的控制问题，即如何在保持角色自主性、社会连贯性和世界交互性的同时，允许玩家根据需要进行干预。
AI.method: 提出“有限自主性”控制架构，包含三个接口：智能体-智能体交互（概率回复链衰减）、智能体-世界行动执行（基于嵌入的行动落地流水线及回退机制）、以及玩家-智能体引导（Whisper轻量级软引导技术）。
AI.result: 通过在多人社交游戏中的实地部署与评估，证明了该架构能有效提升LLM角色交互的稳定性、落地质量和可控性，验证了有限自主性在实际游戏环境中的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 有限自主性架构通过多维接口设计，成功实现了LLM角色在多人游戏中的稳定性、连贯性与可控性，为未来的交互式游戏开发提供了有效范例。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）正在为游戏带来更丰富的对话和社会行为，但也暴露了一个现有游戏接口尚未直接解决的控制问题：LLM角色应如何在实时多人交互中参与，同时在共享游戏世界中可执行、与其他活跃角色保持社会连贯性，并在需要时受玩家引导？我们将此问题定义为“有限自主性”，这是一种针对实时多人游戏的控制架构，围绕三个接口组织LLM角色控制：智能体-智能体交互、智能体-世界行动执行，以及玩家-智能体引导。我们通过概率回复链衰减、基于嵌入的行动落地流水线（带回退机制）以及“低语”（whisper，一种让玩家在不完全覆盖自主性的情况下影响角色下一步行动的轻量级软引导技术）来实现有限自主性。我们将此架构部署在一个实时多人社交游戏中，并通过对交互稳定性、落地质量、引导干预成功率的分析以及形成性访谈来研究其行为。我们的结果展示了有限自主性如何使LLM角色交互在实践中可行，将可控性定义为LLM角色在实时多人游戏中的一个独特运行时控制问题，并为未来围绕这种交互范式构建的游戏提供了具体的范例。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“有限自主性”的控制架构，旨在解决LLM角色在实时多人游戏中的交互难题。该架构通过三个核心接口协调智能体间的交互、世界行动执行以及玩家的软引导，并在实际游戏中验证了其在保持角色自主性的同时实现有效控制的可行性。
AI.keywords: 有限自主性, 大型语言模型, 多人游戏, 角色控制, 交互设计
AI.comments: 这篇论文创新性地提出了“有限自主性”（Bounded Autonomy）架构，解决了LLM角色在多人实时游戏中的控制难题。其价值在于不仅关注了角色的自主性，还通过“低语”（whisper）等技术平衡了玩家的介入需求，为AI NPC设计提供了实用的工程范式。局限性在于未详细探讨大规模玩家同时介入时的计算开销和一致性冲突问题。

title: Fine-Tuning Integrity for Modern Neural Networks: Structured Drift Proofs via Norm, Rank, and Sparsity Certificates
summary:
Fine-tuning is the dominant paradigm for adapting large machine learning models, yet current deployment pipelines provide no way to verify how a released model was updated. In particular, a model provider or auditor cannot check whether a fine-tuned model adheres to a claimed update procedure without access to its parameters.
  We introduce \emph{fine-tuning integrity} (FTI), a cryptographic objective for verifying that a deployed model differs from a trusted base model only within a declared class of admissible updates. We construct \emph{succinct model difference proofs} (SMDPs), zero-knowledge protocols that certify structured parameter drift without revealing model weights. Our framework supports three fundamental update classes: norm-bounded, low-rank, and sparse drift, covering common fine-tuning methods such as regularized training, LoRA, and prefix tuning. In all cases, proof size and verification cost depend on the structure of the update rather than the number of parameters.
  We prove soundness, zero-knowledge, and succinctness for each construction, and establish a matching $Ω(n)$ lower bound showing that structural assumptions are necessary for succinct verification. A prototype evaluation on synthetic benchmarks and GPT-2 fine-tuning demonstrates that proofs remain compact and verification is efficient at realistic scales.

AI.title_translation: 现代神经网络的微调完整性：基于范数、秩和稀疏性证书的结构化漂移证明
AI.tldr: 提出了一种零知识证明框架，允许在不暴露模型参数的情况下，验证大模型微调是否符合特定的结构化更新要求。
AI.motivation: 当前大模型微调缺乏有效的验证机制，导致模型提供者或审计人员无法在不获取模型参数的情况下，确认模型更新是否符合预期的程序或约束。
AI.method: 引入“微调完整性”（FTI）概念，构建“简洁模型差异证明”（SMDPs）零知识协议，通过利用范数约束、低秩和稀疏性等结构化假设，在不揭示模型权重的情况下验证模型更新。
AI.result: 证明了所提方案的稳健性、零知识性和简洁性；建立了简洁验证所需的结构假设下界；在GPT-2微调任务上的实验表明，该方法在保持紧凑证明大小的同时，实现了高效的验证。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了微调完整性（FTI）框架和简洁模型差异证明（SMDP），成功实现了在不暴露模型参数的前提下，以高效且可验证的方式证明模型更新遵循特定的结构约束，为大模型的可信部署提供了理论和实践基础。
AI.translation: 微调是适配大型机器学习模型的主流范式，然而当前的部署流水线无法验证已发布模型是如何更新的。特别是，模型提供者或审计人员在无法访问参数的情况下，无法检查微调后的模型是否遵循了所声明的更新程序。我们引入了“微调完整性”（FTI），这是一种用于验证已部署模型与受信任的基础模型之间的差异是否仅限于声明的允许更新类别的密码学目标。我们构建了“简洁模型差异证明”（SMDPs），即一种在不揭示模型权重的情况下证明结构化参数漂移的零知识协议。我们的框架支持三种基本更新类别：范数有界、低秩和稀疏漂移，涵盖了正则化训练、LoRA 和前缀微调等常见微调方法。在所有情况下，证明大小和验证成本取决于更新的结构，而不是参数的数量。我们证明了每种结构的稳健性、零知识性和简洁性，并建立了匹配的 Ω(n) 下界，表明结构假设对于简洁验证是必要的。在合成基准测试和 GPT-2 微调上的原型评估表明，证明保持紧凑，且验证在现实规模下是高效的。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“微调完整性”（FTI）框架，旨在通过零知识证明验证大模型微调过程的合规性。研究团队开发了“简洁模型差异证明”（SMDPs），利用范数、低秩和稀疏性等结构化更新特性，实现了在保护模型参数隐私的同时，高效验证微调行为是否符合预设规则。
AI.keywords: 微调完整性, 零知识证明, 模型审计, 结构化参数漂移, 简洁证明
AI.comments: 该研究通过密码学手段解决了模型微调过程中的透明度和可信度问题，将零知识证明引入模型审计领域，具有重要的安全和合规意义。其创新之处在于通过利用模型更新的结构化特性（如低秩、稀疏性），实现了高效的验证，突破了传统模型验证的计算瓶颈。

title: Channel-wise Retrieval for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting
summary: Multivariate time series forecasting often struggles to capture long-range dependencies due to fixed lookback windows. Retrieval-augmented forecasting addresses this by retrieving historical segments from memory, but existing approaches rely on a channel-agnostic strategy that applies the same references to all variables. This neglects inter-variable heterogeneity, where different channels exhibit distinct periodicities and spectral profiles. We propose CRAFT (Channel-wise retrieval-augmented forecasting), a novel framework that performs retrieval independently for each channel. To ensure efficiency, CRAFT adopts a two-stage pipeline: a sparse relation graph constructed in the time domain prunes irrelevant candidates, and spectral similarity in the frequency domain ranks references, emphasizing dominant periodic components while suppressing noise. Experiments on seven public benchmarks demonstrate that CRAFT outperforms state-of-the-art forecasting baselines, achieving superior accuracy with practical inference efficiency.

title: Benchmarking Requirement-to-Architecture Generation with Hybrid Evaluation
summary: Software architecture serves as the blueprint of a software system, capturing high-level structural decisions that shape downstream implementation and system quality. Despite this central role, generating architecture designs from requirement documents remains underexplored, with limited task-specific benchmarks for generation or rigorous evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce R2ABench, a benchmark for requirements-to-architecture (R2A) reasoning. R2ABench contains 68 projects with human-validated references collected from both educational-style settings and GitHub repositories. Each project is packaged as a unified instance that provides a structured software requirements specification (SRS), a reference architecture view in PlantUML, and the corresponding source requirement artifacts. To evaluate generated architecture views, we design a layered hybrid evaluation framework spanning syntax validation, structural graph diagnostics, and semantic and evidence-based architecture scoring. Using this framework, we conduct a comprehensive empirical study of state-of-the-art LLMs and agents on R2ABench. We find that current systems can often generate syntactically valid and readable architecture views, but still struggle with relation-level architecture modeling across both subsets: component identification is substantially stronger than edge recovery, and edge hallucination is the dominant structural failure mode. Semantically, structural fidelity does not guarantee requirement coverage or traceability, which emerge as the primary quality gaps. The associated data files are available at https://figshare.com/s/01f0a5fb6243a6a60f23.

title: EgoVerse: An Egocentric Human Dataset for Robot Learning from Around the World
summary: Robot learning increasingly depends on large and diverse data, yet robot data collection remains expensive and difficult to scale. Egocentric human data offer a promising alternative by capturing rich manipulation behavior across everyday environments. However, existing human datasets are often limited in scope, difficult to extend, and fragmented across institutions. We introduce EgoVerse, a collaborative platform for human data-driven robot learning that unifies data collection, processing, and access under a shared framework, enabling contributions from individual researchers, academic labs, and industry partners. The current release includes 1,362 hours (80k episodes) of human demonstrations spanning 1,965 tasks, 240 scenes, and 2,087 unique demonstrators, with standardized formats, manipulation-relevant annotations, and tooling for downstream learning. Beyond the dataset, we conduct a large-scale study of human-to-robot transfer with experiments replicated across multiple labs, tasks, and robot embodiments under shared protocols. We find that policy performance generally improves with increased human data, but that effective scaling depends on alignment between human data and robot learning objectives. Together, the dataset, platform, and study establish a foundation for reproducible progress in human data-driven robot learning. Videos and additional information can be found at https://egoverse.ai/

AI.title_translation: EgoVerse：一个用于全球机器人学习的第一人称人类数据集
AI.tldr: EgoVerse 是一个全球协作平台，提供大规模标准化的人类第一人称演示数据，旨在解决机器人学习的数据瓶颈，并研究如何高效地将人类行为迁移至机器人。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习对大规模多样化数据需求日益增长，但传统机器人数据采集成本高且难以扩展，而现有的人类数据集存在范围受限、难以扩展和碎片化的问题。
AI.method: 构建了一个统一的协作平台来整合全球的人类演示数据（包括采集、处理和访问），并开展了跨实验室、跨任务和跨机器人的大规模人类到机器人迁移学习研究。
AI.result: 发布了包含1362小时、8万个片段、1965项任务的大规模数据集；实验表明增加人类数据通常能提升机器人策略性能，但效果取决于人类数据与机器人学习目标之间的对齐程度。
AI.conclusion: EgoVerse 为机器人学习提供了一个大规模、标准化的人类演示数据集和协作平台，证明了人类数据在提升机器人策略性能方面的有效性，并强调了数据与学习目标对齐的重要性。
AI.translation: 机器人学习越来越依赖于大规模且多样化的数据，然而机器人数据的收集仍然昂贵且难以扩展。第一人称（Egocentric）人类数据通过捕捉日常环境中丰富的操作行为，提供了一种有希望的替代方案。然而，现有的人类数据集通常在范围上受到限制、难以扩展，且在不同机构间呈现碎片化。我们介绍了 EgoVerse，这是一个用于人类数据驱动机器人学习的协作平台，它在统一的框架下整合了数据收集、处理和访问，使个人研究人员、学术实验室和行业合作伙伴能够做出贡献。当前版本包括 1362 小时（8 万个片段）的人类演示，涵盖 1965 项任务、240 个场景和 2087 名独特的演示者，并提供了标准化格式、与操作相关的标注以及用于下游学习的工具。除了数据集之外，我们还进行了大规模的人类到机器人迁移研究，并在共享协议下跨多个实验室、任务和机器人形态复制了实验。我们发现，策略性能通常随着人类数据的增加而提高，但有效的扩展取决于人类数据与机器人学习目标之间的对齐。总之，该数据集、平台和研究为人类数据驱动的机器人学习的可重复进展奠定了基础。视频和更多信息可在 https://egoverse.ai/ 找到。
AI.summary: EgoVerse 是一个旨在通过统一协作平台整合全球人类第一人称演示数据的项目，旨在解决机器人学习中数据获取困难的问题。该项目发布了包含1362小时的大规模标准化数据集，并验证了利用人类数据进行机器人迁移学习的有效性及关键影响因素。
AI.keywords: EgoVerse, 机器人学习, 第一人称视角, 数据集, 行为克隆
AI.comments: EgoVerse 解决了机器人学习中数据匮乏和碎片化的问题，通过构建统一的协作平台，不仅提供了大规模、高质量的人类演示数据集，还通过跨实验室的标准化实验验证了人类数据对机器人学习的价值，为机器人行为学习提供了宝贵的基准。

title: HST-HGN: Heterogeneous Spatial-Temporal Hypergraph Networks with Bidirectional State Space Models for Global Fatigue Assessment
summary: It remains challenging to assess driver fatigue from untrimmed videos under constrained computational budgets, due to the difficulty of modeling long-range temporal dependencies in subtle facial expressions. Some existing approaches rely on computationally heavy architectures, whereas others employ traditional lightweight pairwise graph networks, despite their limited capacity to model high-order synergies and global temporal context. Therefore, we propose HST-HGN, a novel Heterogeneous Spatial-Temporal Hypergraph Network driven by Bidirectional State Space Models. Spatially, we introduce a hierarchical hypergraph network to fuse pose-disentangled geometric topologies with multi-modal texture patches dynamically. This formulation encapsulates high-order synergistic facial deformations, effectively overcoming the limitations of conventional methods. In temporal terms, a Bi-Mamba module with linear complexity is applied to perform bidirectional sequence modeling. This explicit temporal-evolution filtering enables the network to distinguish highly ambiguous transient actions, such as yawning versus speaking, while encompassing their complete physiological lifecycles. Extensive evaluations across diverse fatigue benchmarks demonstrate that HST-HGN achieves state-of-the-art performance. In particular, our method strikes a balance between discriminative power and computational efficiency, making it well-suited for real-time in-cabin edge deployment.

title: BLPR: Robust License Plate Recognition under Viewpoint and Illumination Variations via Confidence-Driven VLM Fallback
summary: Robust license plate recognition in unconstrained environments remains a significant challenge, particularly in underrepresented regions with limited data availability and unique visual characteristics, such as Bolivia. Recognition accuracy in real-world conditions is often degraded by illumination changes and viewpoint distortion. To address these challenges, we introduce BLPR, a deep learning-based License Plate Detection and Recognition (LPDR) framework designed for Bolivian license plates. BLPR adaptively applies geometric rectification, illumination correction, and VLM-assisted fallback based on image-condition and confidence cues. The proposed system uses a YOLO-based detector pretrained on synthetic data generated in Blender to simulate extreme perspectives and lighting conditions, and is fine-tuned on street-level data collected in La Paz, Bolivia. Detected plates are processed by a YOLO-based character recognizer, while a lightweight vision-language model (Gemma3 4B) is selectively triggered in ambiguous cases as a confidence-driven fallback mechanism. We also introduce the first publicly available Bolivian LPDR dataset for academic research, supporting evaluation under diverse viewpoint and illumination conditions. The system achieves a character-level recognition accuracy of 89.6% on real-world data, demonstrating its effectiveness for deployment in challenging urban environments.

AI.title_translation: BLPR：通过置信度驱动的VLM后备机制实现视角和光照变化下的鲁棒车牌识别
AI.tldr: 提出了BLPR框架，通过结合YOLO检测与轻量级视觉语言模型（VLM）作为辅助，显著提升了玻利维亚车牌在复杂环境下的识别准确率。
AI.motivation: 在非受限环境下（特别是像玻利维亚这样数据匮乏且具有独特视觉特征的地区），现有的车牌识别系统在光照变化和视角畸变下表现不佳，缺乏鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出BLPR框架，使用基于YOLO的检测器（在Blender生成的合成数据上预训练并用La Paz实地数据微调）进行车牌检测与字符识别；引入轻量级视觉语言模型（Gemma3 4B）作为置信度驱动的后备机制，针对模糊情况进行辅助识别；采用自适应几何校正和照明校正技术。
AI.result: 在真实场景数据集上达到了89.6%的字符级识别准确率，证明了该系统在应对极端视角和光照变化时的有效性。
AI.conclusion: BLPR框架通过结合几何校正、照明增强和VLM fallback机制，成功提升了玻利维亚车牌在复杂视角和光照条件下的识别性能，验证了该方案在实际城市部署中的可行性。
AI.translation: 在非受限环境下实现鲁棒的车牌识别仍然是一个重大挑战，特别是在数据可用性有限且具有独特视觉特征的代表性不足地区，如玻利维亚。现实世界条件下的识别准确率往往因光照变化和视角畸变而降低。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了BLPR，这是一个专为玻利维亚车牌设计的深度学习车牌检测与识别（LPDR）框架。BLPR根据图像条件和置信度线索，自适应地应用几何校正、照明校正和VLM辅助后备机制。该系统使用在Blender生成的合成数据上预训练的YOLO检测器来模拟极端视角和光照条件，并在玻利维亚拉巴斯收集的街道级数据上进行了微调。检测到的车牌由基于YOLO的字符识别器处理，而在模糊情况下，轻量级视觉语言模型（Gemma3 4B）会被选择性地触发作为置信度驱动的后备机制。我们还引入了第一个公开可用的玻利维亚LPDR数据集，用于支持在不同视角和光照条件下的评估。该系统在真实世界数据上的字符级识别准确率达到了89.6%，证明了其在具有挑战性的城市环境中部署的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了BLPR，一个专为玻利维亚车牌设计的鲁棒性检测与识别框架。该系统结合了YOLO检测器、自适应图像预处理技术以及基于Gemma3 4B的置信度驱动VLM后备机制，有效解决了复杂光照和视角下的识别难题，并发布了首个公开的玻利维亚车牌数据集。
AI.keywords: 车牌识别, 玻利维亚, 视觉语言模型, 置信度驱动, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将传统的深度学习目标检测与轻量级多模态大模型（VLM）结合，作为一种置信度驱动的后备机制，有效解决了复杂环境下的识别瓶颈。通过合成数据与真实场景微调相结合的方法，为数据匮乏地区的特定应用提供了很好的范式。

title: Polyglot Teachers: Evaluating Language Models for Multilingual Synthetic Data Generation
comments: Added human evaluation experiment results. Code is in https://github.com/ljvmiranda921/polyglot-teachers
summary: Synthesizing supervised finetuning (SFT) data from language models (LMs) to teach smaller models multilingual tasks has become increasingly common. However, teacher model selection is often ad hoc, typically defaulting to the largest available option, even though such models may have significant capability gaps in non-English languages. This practice can result in poor-quality synthetic data and suboptimal student downstream performance. In this work, we systematically characterize what makes an effective multilingual teacher. We measure intrinsic measures of data quality with extrinsic student model performance in a metric we call Polyglot Score; evaluating 10 LMs across 6 typologically diverse languages, generating over 1.4M SFT examples and training 240 student models. Among the models tested, Gemma 3 27B and Aya Expanse 32B emerge as consistently effective teachers across different student base model families. Further analyses reveal that model scale alone does not significantly predict teacher effectiveness; instead, data qualities such as prompt diversity, length, and response fluency capture over 93.3% of variance in intrinsic data quality and predict student performance. Finally, we provide practical recommendations, including matching the model families of teacher-student pairs and translating from or responding to existing prompts, which can yield improvements for less-resourced languages. We hope that our work advances data-centric research in multilingual synthetic data and LM development.

AI.title_translation: 多语言教师：评估用于多语言合成数据生成的语言模型
AI.tldr: 研究发现模型规模并非多语言合成数据生成的关键，数据质量指标（如多样性、流畅度）更能预测学生模型的表现，并确定了Gemma 3 27B和Aya Expanse 32B为高效的多语言教师模型。
AI.motivation: 目前使用语言模型生成多语言合成数据时，往往盲目选择最大模型作为教师，忽略了模型在非英语语言上的能力差异，导致合成数据质量低下及学生模型性能受限。
AI.method: 通过评估10个语言模型在6种不同类型语言中生成超过140万个微调样本，训练240个学生模型；提出Polyglot Score指标，将数据内在质量与外在学生模型表现挂钩，并分析模型规模与数据特征对效果的影响。
AI.result: Gemma 3 27B和Aya Expanse 32B在多语言场景下表现最有效；数据多样性、长度和流畅度能解释93.3%的数据质量差异；模型规模与教师有效性无显著相关性。
AI.conclusion: 模型规模并非决定教师模型效果的核心因素；通过优化提示词多样性、回复流畅度等数据特征，并匹配教师与学生模型家族，可以显著提升多语言合成数据的质量及下游性能。
AI.translation: 利用语言模型（LM）合成有监督微调（SFT）数据来教授小型模型多语言任务已变得越来越普遍。然而，教师模型的选择往往是临时的，通常默认选择最大的可用选项，尽管这些模型在非英语语言中可能存在显著的能力差距。这种做法可能导致合成数据质量低下和学生模型下游性能不佳。在这项工作中，我们系统地表征了什么构成了一个有效的多语言教师。我们通过一个称为Polyglot Score的指标，将数据的内在质量度量与外部学生模型的性能进行了衡量；评估了10个LM在6种类型各异的语言中的表现，生成了超过140万个SFT示例，并训练了240个学生模型。在测试的模型中，Gemma 3 27B和Aya Expanse 32B在不同的学生基础模型系列中表现出始终如一的有效性。进一步分析表明，仅模型规模并不能显著预测教师的有效性；相反，提示词多样性、长度和响应流畅度等数据质量指标捕获了超过93.3%的数据内在质量差异，并能预测学生性能。最后，我们提供了实用的建议，包括匹配教师-学生对的模型系列，以及从现有提示中翻译或响应，这可以为资源匮乏的语言带来改进。我们希望我们的工作能推动多语言合成数据和LM开发中以数据为中心的研究。
AI.summary: 本文系统评估了用于多语言合成数据生成的教师模型。研究发现模型规模并非决定教师有效性的关键，反而提示词多样性、响应长度和流畅度等数据指标更能预测学生模型的下游表现。研究通过Polyglot Score评估了多种模型，并为优化多语言合成数据提供了具体的策略建议。
AI.keywords: 多语言合成数据, 教师模型评估, 有监督微调, 模型鲁棒性, 数据质量指标
AI.comments: 该研究通过实证方法挑战了“模型越大越好”的传统认知，揭示了数据质量指标（如多样性、长度、流畅度）对多语言合成数据有效性的决定性作用。其提出的Polyglot Score为后续研究提供了量化评估教师模型的基准，具有重要的实践指导价值。

title: CLAY: Conditional Visual Similarity Modulation in Vision-Language Embedding Space
summary: Human perception of visual similarity is inherently adaptive and subjective, depending on the users' interests and focus. However, most image retrieval systems fail to reflect this flexibility, relying on a fixed, monolithic metric that cannot incorporate multiple conditions simultaneously. To address this, we propose CLAY, an adaptive similarity computation method that reframes the embedding space of pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as a text-conditional similarity space without additional training. This design separates the textual conditioning process and visual feature extraction, allowing highly efficient and multi-conditioned retrieval with fixed visual embeddings. We also construct a synthetic evaluation dataset CLAY-EVAL, for comprehensive assessment under diverse conditioned retrieval settings. Experiments on standard datasets and our proposed dataset show that CLAY achieves high retrieval accuracy and notable computational efficiency compared to previous works.

title: Generative Refinement Networks for Visual Synthesis
summary: While diffusion models dominate the field of visual generation, they are computationally inefficient, applying a uniform computational effort regardless of different complexity. In contrast, autoregressive (AR) models are inherently complexity-aware, as evidenced by their variable likelihoods, but are often hindered by lossy discrete tokenization and error accumulation. In this work, we introduce Generative Refinement Networks (GRN), a next-generation visual synthesis paradigm that addresses these issues. At its core, GRN addresses the discrete tokenization bottleneck through a theoretically near-lossless Hierarchical Binary Quantization (HBQ), achieving a reconstruction quality comparable to continuous counterparts. Built upon HBQ's latent space, GRN fundamentally upgrades AR generation with a global refinement mechanism that progressively perfects and corrects artworks -- like a human artist painting. Besides, GRN integrates an entropy-guided sampling strategy, enabling complexity-aware, adaptive-step generation without compromising visual quality. On the ImageNet benchmark, GRN establishes new records in image reconstruction (0.56 rFID) and class-conditional image generation (1.81 gFID). We also scale GRN to more challenging text-to-image and text-to-video generation, delivering superior performance on an equivalent scale. We release all models and code to foster further research on GRN.

title: Revisiting and Expanding the IPv6 Periphery: Global-Scale Measurement and Security Analysis
comments: 13 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Information Forensics and Security
summary: As IPv6 deployment accelerates, understanding the evolving security posture of network peripheries becomes increasingly important. A DSN 2021 study first explored IPv6 network peripheries, but its scope was limited to three regions and is now outdated. In this paper, we revisit and expand that work through a global-scale measurement and security analysis of IPv6 network peripheries. To support efficient large-scale scanning, we propose a novel Response-Guided Prefix Selection (RGPS) strategy to identify high-value IPv6 prefixes for probing. Our measurement covers 73 countries/regions and identifies over 281.9M active IPv6 network peripheries, including a 364.8% increase over the 2021 baseline in India, China, and America. We further analyze exposed services and find that 2.5% of devices expose at least one measured service, with recurring software vulnerabilities indicated by version-to-CVE mappings. As a case study of emerging exposed services, we design a Hierarchical LLM Exposure Verification (HLEV) framework to identify unauthorized-access risks in LLM deployment tools. Finally, we revisit routing loop vulnerabilities and identify 4.5M loop-prone devices, showing that flawed routing behaviors remain widespread. These findings indicate that although IPv6 adoption has surged, key security challenges persist across network peripheries.

AI.title_translation: 重访并扩展IPv6边缘：全球规模测量与安全分析
AI.tldr: 本文对全球IPv6网络边缘进行了大规模测量，发现活跃边缘数量激增，但服务暴露、软件漏洞及路由环路等安全问题依然严重，并提出了针对LLM工具的风险验证框架。
AI.motivation: 现有关于IPv6边缘安全的研究（如DSN 2021）范围有限且已过时，随着IPv6部署的加速，迫切需要对全球范围内的IPv6网络边缘进行更新的测量与安全性分析。
AI.method: 1. 提出响应引导前缀选择策略（RGPS）以实现高效大规模扫描；2. 对73个国家/地区的IPv6边缘进行全球规模测量；3. 利用版本到CVE映射分析服务暴露；4. 设计分层大模型暴露验证框架（HLEV）以识别LLM部署工具的风险；5. 重测路由环路漏洞。
AI.result: 1. 识别出超过2.819亿个活跃IPv6边缘；2. 在印度、中国和美国，边缘数量相比2021年基线增长了364.8%；3. 发现2.5%的设备暴露了至少一个测量服务，且存在重复的软件漏洞；4. 通过HLEV框架识别出LLM部署工具中存在未经授权的访问风险；5. 识别出450万个易受路由环路攻击的设备。
AI.conclusion: 尽管IPv6在全球范围内的部署显著加速，但网络边缘仍普遍存在服务暴露、软件漏洞及路由配置错误等安全挑战，亟需加强监控与防御。
AI.translation: 随着IPv6部署的加速，了解网络边缘不断演变的安全态势变得愈发重要。DSN 2021的一项研究首次探索了IPv6网络边缘，但其范围仅限于三个地区且现已过时。在本文中，我们通过对IPv6网络边缘进行全球规模的测量和安全分析，重访并扩展了该工作。为了支持高效的大规模扫描，我们提出了一种新颖的响应引导前缀选择（RGPS）策略，以识别用于探测的高价值IPv6前缀。我们的测量覆盖了73个国家/地区，识别出超过2.819亿个活跃的IPv6网络边缘，其中印度、中国和美国的边缘数量较2021年基线增长了364.8%。我们进一步分析了暴露的服务，发现2.5%的设备至少暴露了一个被测服务，并且通过版本到CVE的映射显示出重复出现的软件漏洞。作为新兴暴露服务的案例研究，我们设计了一个分层大模型暴露验证（HLEV）框架，以识别大模型部署工具中的未经授权访问风险。最后，我们重访了路由环路漏洞，识别出450万个易受环路影响的设备，表明存在缺陷的路由行为仍然普遍存在。这些发现表明，尽管IPv6的采用激增，但网络边缘的关键安全挑战依然存在。
AI.summary: 本文对IPv6网络边缘进行了全面的全球规模测量与安全分析。通过引入RGPS策略，研究覆盖了73个国家/地区，识别出2.819亿个活跃边缘，并揭示了服务暴露、CVE软件漏洞、LLM部署工具安全风险以及持续存在的路由环路问题，强调了IPv6快速普及背景下安全挑战的严峻性。
AI.keywords: IPv6, 网络边缘, 安全分析, 服务暴露, 路由漏洞
AI.comments: 该研究弥补了2021年相关研究的局限性，通过全球规模的测量揭示了IPv6边缘网络在快速扩张的同时伴随着持续的安全风险。其提出的RGPS和HLEV策略展示了在海量IPv6地址空间中进行高效探测和特定服务分析的创新思路，对理解IPv6基础设施安全具有重要参考价值。

title: Nearly Optimal Bounds for Computing Decision Tree Splits in Data Streams
summary:
We establish nearly optimal upper and lower bounds for approximating decision tree splits in data streams. For regression with labels in the range $\{0,1,\ldots,M\}$, we give a one-pass algorithm using $\tilde{O}(M^2/ε)$ space that outputs a split within additive $ε$ error of the optimal split, improving upon the two-pass algorithm of Pham et al. (ISIT 2025). Furthermore, we provide a matching one-pass lower bound showing that $Ω(M^2/ε)$ space is indeed necessary.
  For classification, we also obtain a one-pass algorithm using $\tilde{O}(1/ε)$ space for approximating the optimal Gini split, improving upon the previous $\tilde{O}(1/ε^2)$-space algorithm. We complement these results with matching space lower bounds: $Ω(1/ε)$ for Gini impurity and $Ω(1/ε)$ for misclassification (which matches the upper bound obtained by sampling).
  Our algorithms exploit the Lipschitz property of the loss functions and use reservoir sampling along with Count--Min sketches with range queries. Our lower bounds follow from careful reductions from the INDEX problem.

AI.title_translation: 数据流中计算决策树分裂的近最优界
AI.tldr: 本文为数据流中的决策树分裂问题建立了近最优的空间复杂度界，通过结合水库采样和Count-Min sketches，在回归和分类任务中均达到了理论最优空间效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的数据流决策树分裂算法在空间复杂度上仍有优化空间，需要建立更严谨的理论边界以确定算法的性能极限。
AI.method: 利用损失函数的Lipschitz性质，结合水库采样（reservoir sampling）与带范围查询的Count-Min sketches技术；下界证明采用从INDEX问题的归约方法。
AI.result: 回归问题中，实现了一次扫描且空间复杂度为 $\tilde{O}(M^2/ε)$ 的算法，并证明了其下界为 $\Omega(M^2/ε)$；分类问题中，针对Gini分裂实现了空间复杂度为 $\tilde{O}(1/ε)$ 的算法，并证明了其下界为 $\Omega(1/ε)$。
AI.conclusion: 研究确立了数据流中决策树分裂近似计算的近最优空间复杂度，为回归和分类任务提供了高效的单遍扫描算法，并证明了其最优性。
AI.translation: 我们建立了近似数据流中决策树分裂的近最优上下界。对于标签范围在 $\{0,1,\ldots,M\}$ 的回归问题，我们提供了一种一次扫描算法，使用 $\tilde{O}(M^2/ε)$ 空间，输出与最优分裂误差在 $ε$ 以内的结果，改进了 Pham 等人（ISIT 2025）的两遍扫描算法。此外，我们提供了匹配的一次扫描下界，证明了 $\Omega(M^2/ε)$ 空间确实是必要的。对于分类问题，我们针对近似最优 Gini 分裂也获得了一种使用 $\tilde{O}(1/ε)$ 空间的一次扫描算法，改进了之前 $\tilde{O}(1/ε^2)$ 空间的算法。我们用匹配的空间下界补充了这些结果：Gini 不纯度为 $\Omega(1/ε)$，误分类率为 $\Omega(1/ε)$（这与通过采样获得的上限相匹配）。我们的算法利用了损失函数的 Lipschitz 性质，并结合了水库采样和带有范围查询的 Count-Min sketches。我们的下界推导自对 INDEX 问题的仔细归约。
AI.summary: 本文针对数据流环境下的决策树分裂问题，提出了近最优的上下界。通过利用损失函数的Lipschitz性质和特定的采样与草图技术，在回归和分类任务中分别实现了空间复杂度为 $\tilde{O}(M^2/ε)$ 和 $\tilde{O}(1/ε)$ 的一次扫描算法，并证明了这些结果在渐进意义上达到了最优。
AI.keywords: 决策树分裂, 数据流算法, 空间复杂度, 损失函数, 近似计算
AI.comments: 该论文在处理数据流中的决策树分裂问题上取得了显著进展，通过利用损失函数的Lipschitz性质，成功地将空间复杂度优化至理论最优界。其创新之处在于将Count-Min sketches与水库采样相结合，并给出了匹配的下界证明，极大地提升了该领域算法的理论完备性。

title: Passive Variable Impedance For Shared Control
comments: submitted for publication at the IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Shared Control methods often use impedance control to track target poses in a robotic manipulator. The guidance behavior of such controllers is shaped by the used stiffness gains, which can be varying over time to achieve an adaptive guiding. When multiple target poses are tracked at the same time with varying importance, the corresponding output wrenches have to be arbitrated with weightings changing over time. In this work, we study the stabilization of both variable stiffness in impedance control as well as the arbitration of different controllers through a scaled addition of their output wrenches, reformulating both into a holistic framework. We identify passivity violations in the closed loop system and provide methods to passivate the system. The resulting approach can be used to stabilize standard impedance controllers, allowing for the development of novel and flexible shared control methods. We do not constrain the design of stiffness matrices or arbitration factors; both can be matrix-valued including off-diagonal elements and change arbitrarily over time. The proposed methods are furthermore validated in simulation as well as in real robot experiments on different systems, proving their effectiveness and showcasing different behaviors which can be utilized depending on the requirements of the shared control approach.
comment: submitted for publication at the IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)

AI.title_translation: 共享控制中的被动变阻抗
AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种确保共享控制系统在变刚度和动态仲裁下保持被动稳定性的统一框架，允许参数随时间任意调整。
AI.motivation: 在共享控制中，变刚度策略及动态加权仲裁机制容易导致闭环系统的被动性违规，从而引发不稳定现象，需要一种能够保障任意变化参数下系统稳定性的统一框架。
AI.method: 将变刚度阻抗控制和多控制器输出加权仲裁重构为一个整体框架，识别并分析闭环系统中的被动性违规问题，并提出相应的被动化处理方法以确保系统稳定性。
AI.result: 提出了一种能够稳定标准阻抗控制的被动化方法，支持矩阵形式的刚度及仲裁因子随时间任意变化，并通过仿真和真实机器人实验验证了该方法的有效性与灵活性。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入被动性约束，该研究成功构建了一个能够稳定变刚度及动态仲裁的共享控制框架，并通过实验验证了其在复杂机器人系统中的有效性。
AI.translation: 共享控制方法通常使用阻抗控制来跟踪机器人操纵器的目标位姿。这种控制器的引导行为由所使用的刚度增益决定，刚度增益可以随时间变化以实现自适应引导。当同时跟踪多个目标位姿且重要性各异时，相应的输出扳手必须通过随时间变化的权重进行仲裁。在这项工作中，我们将变刚度阻抗控制以及通过输出扳手的缩放加法进行的控制器仲裁的稳定性研究重构为一个整体框架。我们识别了闭环系统中的被动性违规，并提供了使系统被动化的方法。由此产生的方法可用于稳定标准阻抗控制器，从而允许开发新颖且灵活的共享控制方法。我们不对刚度矩阵或仲裁因子的设计施加约束；两者都可以是矩阵值，包括非对角元素，并可以随时间任意变化。所提出的方法在仿真以及不同系统的真实机器人实验中得到了验证，证明了其有效性，并展示了可根据共享控制方法需求利用的不同行为。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种处理共享控制中变刚度和控制器动态仲裁的统一框架。通过识别并修复系统中的被动性违规，该方法允许在不限制刚度矩阵和仲裁因子设计的前提下，确保闭环系统的稳定性，并通过实验证明了其在不同机器人系统中的应用价值。
AI.keywords: 共享控制, 阻抗控制, 被动性, 变刚度, 控制器仲裁
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一种通用的被动性框架，能够处理共享控制中变刚度和控制器仲裁带来的不稳定性。其重要性在于为柔性共享控制提供了一种无需限制刚度矩阵或仲裁因子设计的稳定保障方案。局限性在于主要聚焦于被动性约束，未深入讨论特定任务性能与被动性之间的权衡。

title: Context-Aware Displacement Estimation from Mobile Phone Data: A Methodological Framework
comments: 24 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. Case study: Super Typhoon Nando, Philippines (2025)
summary: Timely population displacement estimates are critical for humanitarian response during disasters, but traditional surveys and field assessments are slow. Mobile phone data enables near real-time tracking, yet existing approaches apply uniform displacement definitions regardless of individual mobility patterns, misclassifying regular commuters as displaced. We present a methodological framework addressing this through three innovations: (1) mobility profile classification distinguishing local residents from commuter types, (2) context-aware between-municipality displacement detection accounting for expected location by user type and day of week, and (3) operational uncertainty bounds derived from baseline coefficient of variation with a disaster adjustment factor, intended for humanitarian decision support rather than formal statistical inference. The framework produces three complementary metrics scaled to population with uncertainty bounds: displacement rates, origin-destination flows, and return dynamics. An Aparri case study following Super Typhoon Nando (2025, Philippines) applies the framework to vendor-provided daily locations from Globe Telecom. Context-aware detection reduced estimated between-municipality displacement by 1.6-2.7 percentage points on weekdays versus naive methods, attributable to the commuter exception but not independently validated. The method captures between-municipality displacement only. Within-municipality evacuation falls outside scope. The single-case demonstration establishes proof of concept. External validity requires application across multiple events and locations. The framework provides humanitarian actors with operational displacement information while preserving individual privacy through aggregation.

title: Resilience Revisited: A Multidimensional Framework Derived from Realistic Attack Scenarios
summary: The increasing penetration of inverter-based resources exposes power systems to coordinated cyber-physical attacks capable of triggering cascading failures and systemic instability. However, existing resilience indicators assess each dimension independently, preventing the quantification of how interdimensional coupling amplifies resilience loss during high-impact, low-probability events. This paper presents a Multidimensional Resilience Index (MDRI) that quantifies degradation across the physical, operational, cyber-digital, climatic, and regulatory dimensions, explicitly distinguishing the independent contribution of each dimension from the additional loss caused by their interactions. The proposed framework is validated on the IEEE 39-bus system implemented in MATLAB/Simulink through two attack scenarios reconstructed from the December 2025 cyberattack on the Polish power grid: a baseline scenario with a single compromised power plant and a coordinated multivector attack. The latter causes system collapse and increases resilience loss nearly eightfold relative to the baseline solely through interdimensional coupling. Including climatic and regulatory stressors produces a further 84% increase, yielding an overall resilience loss nearly fifteen times greater. These findings demonstrate that multidimensional coupling is a dominant driver of resilience degradation and that resilience assessment must explicitly account for interdependencies among dimensions to reveal vulnerabilities overlooked by conventional approaches.
