title: Accelerating Returns and the Qualitative Engine for Science
summary: Ray Kurzweil described a thesis of accelerating returns, which is the most influential narratives in discussions of technological progress. Its central claim is that advances in multiple technological fields, especially compute, artificial intelligence, brain science, and biotechnology, interact in such a way that progress becomes self-amplifying and approximately exponential. This paper gives a simple mathematical interpretation of that claim and then argues that, even if such acceleration is real, it does not by itself resolve the central problem of scientific discovery. The reason is that accelerating returns apply most naturally to executional and infrastructural capability, whereas genuine discovery often depends on a different capacity: qualitative reasoning about when a current framework is structurally inadequate and what conceptual move is needed next. Recent ARC-AGI-3 results sharpen this distinction: humans solve the benchmark at ceiling, whereas frontier AI systems remain below 1%, indicating that the gap between current AI and human flexible reasoning is still very large. At the same time, Demis Hassabis has emphasized that humans must retain their sense of meaning and what they choose to focus their lives on, a reminder that the future of AI is not only a technical forecast but also a question of what forms of human understanding are worth preserving and transmitting. This paper positions the Qualitative Engine for Science (QES) [3] as a response to that missing capacity. In this view, the Kurzweil theory helps explain why quantitative capability may accelerate, while QES addresses the central problem in scientific discovery that acceleration alone does not solve. Its value does not depend on when AGI arrives, but on the fact that the processes of scientific discovery themselves constitute a form of human wisdom worth preserving, organizing, and making accessible.

title: The Inattentional Gap: Task-Conditioned Language and Vision Models Omit the Safety-Critical Signals They Can Otherwise Report
comments: 21 pages, 8 figures. v2: author list expanded; statistical robustness additions (bootstrap CIs, Holm-Bonferroni, judge-sensitivity analysis). Reproducibility deposit: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20826824
summary: AI safety is evaluated by how reliably a model detects the hazards it is told to find, yet accidents often arise from the hazard no one specified. We show that conditioning a language or vision model on a narrow task suppresses its reporting of co-present, safety-critical signals it can otherwise report, a machine analogue of human inattentional blindness, produced by a different mechanism. Across radiology and driving text scenarios and chest-radiograph vision tasks, the ordinary focused instructions under which such systems are deployed suppressed reporting by up to 0.92 in report rate relative to the same models when unconstrained, and an explicit exclusive instruction abolished reporting entirely in radiology. Suppression appeared in every model tested, did not diminish with scale, persisted in a reasoning model, and varied more by model family than by size. We name this dissociation the Inattentional Gap and argue that it decouples measured benchmark safety from real-world safety: a system can score near-perfectly on the hazards an evaluation specifies while remaining blind to those that cause harm. Probing the mechanism, we localize the proximal trigger to output scope and find System-1-style task capture without reliable intrinsic oversight in the sampled systems. Oversight could, however, be supplied externally: routing each narrow report to an independent open-ended critic restored every omitted finding, demonstrating that the gap is both measurable and mitigable. We propose reporting-complete evaluation, scoring what a system fails to report alongside what it is asked to find, as a requirement for safety-critical deployment.

AI.title_translation: 注意力缺口：任务约束下的语言与视觉模型会忽略其本可报告的安全关键信号
AI.tldr: AI模型在专注于特定任务时，会产生类似人类的“非注意盲视”，从而忽略未被明确要求的安全隐患；研究建议引入独立评估器以弥补这一安全漏洞。
AI.motivation: 现有的AI安全评估往往仅关注模型是否能检测到预设的已知危险，而忽略了模型在执行特定任务时，可能会由于注意力聚焦而产生“非注意盲视”，从而漏掉未被明确指定的致命安全信号。
AI.method: 研究人员通过放射学报告和自动驾驶文本场景，对比了模型在“受限任务指令”与“无约束状态”下的表现。通过引入独立的开放式评估器（critic）来检测被忽略的安全信号，并分析了模型输出范围对注意力抑制的影响。
AI.result: 实验表明，任务约束导致模型安全信号报告率下降高达0.92，甚至在放射学任务中完全被抑制。这种“注意力缺口”在所有测试模型中均存在，且不随模型规模增加而消失。然而，引入独立评估器可以有效恢复被遗漏的报告。
AI.conclusion: AI模型在特定任务约束下会抑制对非任务相关但至关重要的安全信号的报告。研究建议在部署安全关键系统时，必须采用“报告完整性评估”方法，以弥补当前评估体系的盲区。
AI.translation: AI安全性评估通常依赖于模型检测其被告知要查找的危险的可靠程度，然而事故往往源于无人指定的危险。我们展示了对语言或视觉模型进行狭窄的任务约束会抑制其对同现的、本可报告的安全关键信号的报告，这是一种由不同机制产生的机器类人类非注意盲视。在放射学和驾驶文本场景以及胸部X光视觉任务中，在部署这些系统时通常采用的聚焦指令使报告率相对于无约束模型下降了高达0.92，且在放射学任务中，明确的排他性指令完全废除了报告。这种抑制出现在所有测试的模型中，不随规模扩大而减弱，在推理模型中也持续存在，且模型家族间的差异大于规模差异。我们将这种解离命名为“注意力缺口”，并认为它使测量的基准安全与现实世界安全脱节：系统可以在评估指定的危险上取得近乎完美的成绩，同时对导致伤害的危险保持盲目。在探索机制时，我们将近端触发器定位到输出范围，并发现采样系统中存在System-1风格的任务捕获，而缺乏可靠的内在监管。然而，监管可以由外部提供：将每个狭窄的报告路由到一个独立的开放式批评者，恢复了每一个被遗漏的发现，证明了这一缺口既是可测量的也是可缓解的。我们建议采用报告完整性评估，即在评估系统被要求查找的内容的同时，记录系统未能报告的内容，作为安全关键部署的要求。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“注意力缺口”（Inattentional Gap）概念，指出AI模型在执行特定任务时，会主动抑制对任务之外但至关重要的安全信号的报告。研究发现，这种现象在各种模型中普遍存在，导致模型在基准测试中表现良好，但在现实世界中却可能忽略致命隐患。作者建议采用“报告完整性评估”作为安全部署的必要流程。
AI.keywords: AI安全, 注意力缺口, 任务约束, 模型评估, 盲点检测
AI.comments: 该研究揭示了AI模型在执行特定任务时存在的“注意力缺口”现象，这一发现对AI安全评估方法论具有重要启示。论文指出了当前基准测试与现实世界安全之间的脱节，并提出了一种切实可行的缓解机制，即引入独立的开放式评估器。其局限在于目前主要在医疗和驾驶场景验证，其在更复杂、动态环境下的普适性尚待进一步研究。

title: Reproducibility Study of "AlphaEdit: Null-Space Constrained Knowledge Editing for Language Models"
summary: Fang et al. (2025) introduced a null-space constrained projection, named AlphaEdit, for locate-then-edit knowledge editing methods, theoretically guaranteeing that edits do not disrupt previously preserved knowledge, and reports substantial gains over existing editing methods on LLaMA3, GPT2-XL, and GPT-J. In this work, we present a reproducibility study of AlphaEdit, reproducing its reported results under the original experimental setup and extending the evaluation along three axes: new model architectures, additional downstream benchmarks, and substantially longer sequential editing horizons. We successfully reproduce AlphaEdit's reported metrics across the original models, though we identify a discrepancy in the reported fluency and consistency metric. Extending AlphaEdit to newer model families, we find that its advantage does not generalize uniformly, which we trace to architectural assumptions in the locate-then-edit paradigm that are violated by these newer models. We further stress-test AlphaEdit's central sequential-editing claim by extending the number of edits well beyond those evaluated in the original paper, and find that performance, which is stable at the originally reported scale, degrades as edits reach a much higher count, indicating that the null-space projection's protection against catastrophic forgetting is bounded rather than unconditional. Finally, we extend evaluation of edited models on three extra benchmarks, namely, BoolQ, HellaSwag, and XSTest, and we find that large-scale sequential editing degrades both general downstream task competence and safety-relevant refusal behavior. Our results confirm that AlphaEdit performs as reported within its original scope, while showing that its core theoretical guarantees are sensitive to model architecture and editing scale in ways that have practical implications for its deployment.

AI.title_translation: “AlphaEdit：语言模型的零空间约束知识编辑”的可复现性研究
AI.tldr: 本研究对AlphaEdit方法进行了复现与压力测试，证实其在原始范围内有效，但在新型模型架构和超大规模序列编辑中表现出性能退化及泛化局限性。
AI.motivation: 评估AlphaEdit在原始论文中提出的“零空间约束”知识编辑方法的有效性，验证其在不同模型、更长编辑序列以及更多下游任务中的表现，并探究其理论保证的适用边界。
AI.method: 研究人员在原始实验设置下复现了AlphaEdit，并将其扩展至新的模型架构、更多的下游基准测试（BoolQ, HellaSwag, XSTest）以及更长的序列编辑场景，以评估其性能、泛化能力及鲁棒性。
AI.result: 成功复现了原始指标，但发现流畅度和一致性指标存在差异；发现AlphaEdit的优势在新型模型上不具有通用性；在超长序列编辑下，性能出现下降，且大规模编辑会损害下游任务能力和安全性。
AI.conclusion: AlphaEdit在原始实验范围内表现良好，但在新型模型架构、超长序列编辑以及更广泛的下游任务中，其性能会出现退化，表明其防止灾难性遗忘的理论保证具有局限性。
AI.translation: Fang等人（2025）引入了一种名为AlphaEdit的零空间约束投影方法，用于“定位后编辑”（locate-then-edit）的知识编辑方法。该方法在理论上保证了编辑操作不会破坏先前保存的知识，并在LLaMA3、GPT2-XL和GPT-J上报告了优于现有编辑方法的显著增益。在本研究中，我们对AlphaEdit进行了复现性研究，在原始实验设置下复现了其报告的结果，并从三个维度扩展了评估：新的模型架构、额外的下游基准测试以及更长的序列编辑范围。我们成功复现了AlphaEdit在原始模型上的报告指标，但在流畅度和一致性指标上发现了一些差异。将AlphaEdit扩展到新的模型家族后，我们发现其优势并非普遍适用，这归因于新型模型违反了“定位后编辑”范式中的架构假设。我们进一步通过将编辑次数增加到远超原始论文的水平来压力测试AlphaEdit的序列编辑核心主张，结果发现，虽然在原始规模下性能稳定，但随着编辑次数显著增加，性能出现下降，这表明零空间投影对防止灾难性遗忘的保护作用是有限的，而非无条件的。最后，我们在三个额外的基准测试（即BoolQ、HellaSwag和XSTest）上扩展了对编辑后模型的评估，发现大规模序列编辑会降低通用下游任务能力和安全性相关的拒绝行为。我们的结果证实，AlphaEdit在其原始范围内表现如所报告的那样，同时也表明其核心理论保证对模型架构和编辑规模很敏感，这对其实际部署具有实际意义。
AI.summary: 本文对AlphaEdit知识编辑方法进行了全面的复现与扩展评估。研究确认了该方法在原始设定下的有效性，但通过压力测试发现，其性能受模型架构影响较大，且在超大规模序列编辑中难以完全避免灾难性遗忘，同时在大规模编辑后会降低模型的通用能力与安全性。
AI.keywords: 知识编辑, AlphaEdit, 可复现性研究, 灾难性遗忘, 模型架构
AI.comments: 该研究对AlphaEdit方法进行了严格的复现与边界测试，揭示了其理论保证在面对不同模型架构和超大规模序列编辑时的局限性。这项研究强调了在评估知识编辑方法时，不仅要关注原始指标，还要深入探究其在不同场景下的泛化能力与稳定性，对于知识编辑技术的实际应用具有重要的参考价值。

title: Application of LLMs to Threat Assessment of Foreign Peacekeeping Missions
summary: We present a novel approach for applying Large Language Models (LLMs) to threat assessment in the context of foreign peacekeeping missions. Building on the PINPOINT project and its use case, the EU Monitoring Mission in Georgia, we combine an interdisciplinary risk-model with OSINT-based media collection and LLM-supported threat extraction. The proposed workflow maps media contents to mission-relevant threats, extracts structured information and applies several additional LLM-based processing steps to improve relevance and grounding. An evaluation of threats extracted from media documents shows high agreement between automatically generated results and human judgment for core aspects such as threat and mission relevance. These results indicate that LLMs provide a promising approach to support analysts in the context of peacekeeping missions.

title: CARVE: Content-Aware Recurrent with Value Efficiency for Chunk-Parallel Linear Attention
comments: 33 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables, 5 algorithms (incl. appendices with full proofs and Triton kernel pseudocode). Single-author preprint
summary:
Recurrent delta-rule models keep a fixed-size state matrix S (d_v x d_k) that compresses all past context. The state of the art (GDN-2) gates this update with element-wise matrix erase/write masks. This is powerful but has two defects. First, both gates are computed from the incoming token alone, making the model memory-blind: it decides what to erase without seeing what it has stored. Second, value-axis coupling in the erase gate blocks the WY-form triangular chunk solver that drives efficient training -- the intra-chunk system splits into d_v independent solves, collapsing throughput to serial-recurrence cost.
  We introduce CARVE (Content-Aware Recurrent with Value Efficiency), which fixes both and, via a single-launch "megakernel" scheduling of the same WY-form math, trains faster than the matrix-gated baseline it replaces. The key idea is architectural: restricting all gating to the key axis makes the intra-chunk coupling independent of the value index, restoring one unmodified WY-form solve. Within this constraint, CARVE conditions both gates on a content signal read once per chunk from the chunk-boundary state and folded algebraically into each gate's low-rank projection (by associativity, U(Sq)=(US)q), giving memory-aware gating at negligible extra traffic. At init the content projections are zero, so CARVE is bit-identical to the baseline; we prove the one-chunk staleness perturbs gates by only O(1/sqrt(L)), matching a measured 0.18% deviation flat up to L=128.
  At 1.3B parameters / 100B FineWeb-Edu tokens on H100 (three seeds), CARVE improves every axis: WikiText perplexity 15.72 vs 15.90 (hybrid 15.41 vs 15.62), +0.63 pp average common-sense accuracy, and state-of-the-art RULER and real-world recall -- while training +1.4% faster at matched depth and +19.3% at iso-quality depth, at +13% peak memory. Backed by six formal guarantees.

title: HumanoidUMI: Bridging Robot-Free Demonstrations and Humanoid Whole-Body Manipulation
comments: This work was intended as a replacement of arXiv:2605.03452 and any subsequent updates will appear there
summary: High-quality demonstration data are essential for humanoid robot skill learning, especially for whole-body behaviors that require coordinated perception, locomotion, and manipulation. Existing data-collection methods largely rely on robot teleoperation, which is constrained by hardware accessibility, operator expertise, and limited efficiency. Inspired by the Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI), we propose HumanoidUMI, a portable and robot-free framework for humanoid whole-body data collection. HumanoidUMI uses lightweight VR devices and UMI-inspired grippers to collect sparse human keypoint trajectories, wrist-view observations, and gripper actions. These demonstrations train a high-level policy to predict future keypoints, which are retargeted to robot-native whole-body references and executed by a whole-body controller. Experiments in five real-world scenarios demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework and validate the collected demonstrations for transferable humanoid whole-body skill learning.

title: DanceOPD: On-Policy Generative Field Distillation
comments: Technical Report; 40 pages, 13 figures, 9 tables; Project Page at https://danceopd.github.io/ GitHub Repo at https://github.com/worldbench/DanceOPD
summary: Modern image generation demands a single model that unifies diverse capabilities, including text-to-image (T2I), local editing, and global editing. However, these capabilities are rarely naturally aligned and often conflict. For instance, editing tends to degrade T2I performance, while global and local editing interfere with each other. Consequently, effectively composing these capabilities has become a central challenge for image generation model training. To tackle this, we introduce DanceOPD, an on-policy generative field distillation framework for flow-matching models that routes each sample to one capability field, queries one low-noise student-induced state, and trains with a simple velocity MSE objective. With each capability source defined as a velocity field over the shared flow state space, the student learns from fields queried on its own rollout states to compose expert capabilities. This formulation also absorbs operator-defined fields such as classifier-free guidance. Comprehensive experiments on T2I, editing, realism-field absorption, and CFG absorption show that our approach improves multi-capability composition, strengthening target capabilities while preserving anchor generation quality. We believe this work establishes a practical route for generative field distillation in flow-matching models.

AI.title_translation: DanceOPD：在轨生成场蒸馏
AI.tldr: DanceOPD 提出了一种在流匹配模型中蒸馏多种图像生成能力的方法，通过在轨学习将 T2I 和各类编辑功能统一，实现了多能力的高效集成与优化。
AI.motivation: 现代图像生成模型难以统一文本生成图像（T2I）、局部编辑和全局编辑等多种能力，这些能力往往存在冲突，导致模型性能下降。因此，需要一种能够有效组合这些专家能力的方法。
AI.method: 提出 DanceOPD 框架，将多种能力定义为共享流状态空间上的速度场。该方法通过在轨（on-policy）采样，将每个样本路由至特定能力场，查询学生诱导的状态，并使用简单的速度均方误差（MSE）目标函数进行训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，DanceOPD 在 T2I、图像编辑、真实感场吸收及无分类器引导（CFG）吸收方面表现优异，显著提升了多能力组合的性能，并有效保持了锚点生成质量。
AI.conclusion: DanceOPD 是一种有效的框架，能够将多种图像生成能力集成到单一流匹配模型中，在提升特定任务性能的同时保持了基础生成质量。
AI.translation: 现代图像生成要求单一模型能够统一多种功能，包括文本生成图像 (T2I)、局部编辑和全局编辑。然而，这些能力很少能自然对齐，且经常发生冲突。例如，编辑往往会降低 T2I 的性能，而全局和局部编辑之间也会相互干扰。因此，有效组合这些能力已成为图像生成模型训练的核心挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 DanceOPD，这是一种用于流匹配模型的在轨生成场蒸馏框架，它将每个样本路由到一个能力场，查询一个低噪声的学生诱导状态，并使用简单的速度 MSE 目标进行训练。随着每个能力源被定义为共享流状态空间上的速度场，学生从其自身 rollout 状态上查询的场中学习以组合专家能力。该公式还吸收了操作员定义的场，如无分类器引导 (CFG)。在 T2I、编辑、真实感场吸收和 CFG 吸收方面的综合实验表明，我们的方法改进了多能力组合，在保持锚点生成质量的同时增强了目标能力。我们相信这项工作为流匹配模型中的生成场蒸馏建立了一条实用的路径。
AI.summary: DanceOPD 是一种用于流匹配模型的在轨生成场蒸馏框架，它通过将多种互斥的图像生成能力统一为速度场，并利用学生模型在自身 rollout 状态下进行学习，实现了多能力的高效组合与统一。
AI.keywords: 流匹配, 图像生成, 生成场蒸馏, 在轨学习, 多任务组合
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入“生成场蒸馏”的概念，巧妙地将多种相互冲突的图像生成任务（T2I、局部编辑、全局编辑）统一在流匹配（Flow-matching）框架下。其创新之处在于利用“在轨（on-policy）”学习机制，使得学生模型能够根据自身状态动态组合多种专家场，这为构建通用多功能生成模型提供了一种高效且实用的范式。

title: hp-Optimal DG Approximation and Robust Schwarz Decompositions on One-Irregular Cubical Meshes
comments: Withdrawn by the authors. The current version requires substantial revision to clarify the assumptions and proof of the main decomposition theorem. The authors will prepare a revised version
summary: We study hp approximation and additive Schwarz decompositions for variable-order cubical finite element spaces on one-irregular meshes. For fitted homogeneous diffusion interface problems on one-irregular hexahedral meshes, we prove an hp-optimal energy-norm estimate for the interior penalty DG method. The interpolation input is a conforming hp interpolant obtained from fitted conforming closures of one-irregular vertex patches. We also derive stable decompositions for conforming and DG spaces. On one-irregular quadrilateral meshes the bounds allow locally comparable variable polynomial degrees and are independent of the mesh size, the local degrees, and, under a local coefficient quasi-monotonicity condition, the coefficient contrast. On one-irregular hexahedral meshes the conforming decomposition has the corresponding polylogarithmic loss; the DG-to-conforming reduction is used there for uniform-degree DG spaces. Numerical experiments illustrate the p-optimal DG error estimate and the robustness of the DG Schwarz preconditioner.

title: A Physics-Grounded Benchmark for Multi-Agent Dynamics in World Models
summary: Generative world models hold immense promise as scalable simulators for autonomous systems, particularly for synthesizing rare but safety-critical multi-agent interactions, such as vehicle collisions. However, current evaluation paradigms index heavily on visual fidelity and semantic alignment, leaving a critical blind spot: they cannot reliably quantify whether generated dynamics actually obey the fundamental physical laws required for reliable simulation. Assessing this physical plausibility is inherently difficult due to a lack of physical metrics and the challenge of extracting metric-scale kinematics from uncalibrated video rollouts. To bridge this gap, we introduce CrashTwin, a physics-grounded evaluation framework designed to stress-test the physical trustworthiness of world models. CrashTwin couples a diverse dataset of multi-agent collision scenarios, comprising 25K controllable synthetic and 12K in-the-wild real-world collision sequences with a novel calibration-free reconstruction pipeline, enabling the recovery of 3D physical attributes directly from world model rollouts. We propose a diagnostic suite that systematically evaluates three dimensions: spatio-temporal consistency, momentum and kinetic energy conservation, and world-dynamics integrity. Extensive benchmarking of state-of-the-art models reveals a crucial insight: high perceptual quality frequently masks severe physical violations during complex interactions. By quantitatively exposing these failure modes, CrashTwin provides a vital diagnostic tool for developing physically grounded world models capable of reliable real-world simulation.

AI.title_translation: 用于世界模型中多智能体动力学的物理基础基准测试
AI.tldr: CrashTwin 框架通过定量评估物理守恒定律和运动学指标，揭示了当前世界模型在生成碰撞场景时视觉逼真但物理违规的严重问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的世界模型评估过度依赖视觉质量，忽视了对物理定律的遵循，导致模型在处理复杂安全关键场景（如车辆碰撞）时可能表现出严重的物理违规。
AI.method: 提出了 CrashTwin 评估框架，包含一个多智能体碰撞数据集（25K合成+12K真实序列）以及一个无需校准的3D运动学重构流水线，并从时空一致性、守恒定律和动力学完整性三个维度进行定量诊断。
AI.result: 研究表明，目前最先进的模型虽然视觉表现优异，但在复杂碰撞交互中常出现显著的物理违规，证明了该评估框架在揭示模型缺陷方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CrashTwin 能够有效揭示现有世界模型在处理复杂交互时的物理违规行为，为开发更安全、更可靠的物理一致性生成模型提供了重要的诊断工具。
AI.translation: 生成式世界模型作为自动驾驶系统的可扩展模拟器具有巨大潜力，尤其是在合成罕见但安全关键的多智能体交互（如车辆碰撞）方面。然而，当前的评估范式过于依赖视觉逼真度和语义对齐，留下了一个关键盲点：它们无法可靠地量化生成的动力学是否真正遵循了可靠模拟所需的物理基本定律。由于缺乏物理指标以及从未经校准的视频输出中提取度量尺度运动学的挑战，评估这种物理合理性本质上很困难。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了 CrashTwin，这是一个旨在压力测试世界模型物理可信度的物理基础评估框架。CrashTwin 将包含 25K 个可控合成和 12K 个野外真实碰撞序列的多样化多智能体碰撞数据集与一种新颖的免校准重构流水线相结合，能够直接从世界模型输出中恢复 3D 物理属性。我们提出了一个诊断套件，系统地评估三个维度：时空一致性、动量和动能守恒以及世界动力学完整性。对最先进模型的广泛基准测试揭示了一个关键见解：高感知质量经常掩盖复杂交互过程中的严重物理违规。通过定量暴露这些失效模式，CrashTwin 为开发能够进行可靠现实世界模拟的物理基础世界模型提供了至关重要的诊断工具。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 CrashTwin，这是一个旨在评估世界模型物理真实性的基准测试框架。通过结合多智能体碰撞数据集与无校准运动学重构技术，该框架能够定量分析模型在时空一致性、物理守恒律及动力学完整性方面的表现，从而揭示视觉高质量模型中潜藏的物理错误。
AI.keywords: 世界模型, 多智能体动力学, 物理一致性, 碰撞模拟, 评估基准
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将物理定律（如动量和能量守恒）引入世界模型的评估中，揭示了“视觉逼真度”与“物理真实性”之间的脱节，对于推动自动驾驶等安全关键领域的发展具有重要意义。

title: Categorizing Mathematical Concepts with LLM Voting Ensembles in Mathswitch
comments: Submitted (pre-peer-review) version. Accepted at CICM 2026; the Version of Record will appear in Springer LNAI. We'll add the DOI once the proceedings are published
summary: Mathswitch is an open-source project that imports mathematical concept records from sources such as Wikidata, Wikipedia, MathWorld, Encyclopedia of Mathematics, nLab, ProofWiki, and Agda-Unimath, and links records that refer to the same concept. It does not reorganize or redefine the imported content; each source retains its own structure. The current focus is on importing concept data from Wikidata and the resources it links to, with plans to expand to further sources and better concept linking. Because the concept set is approximated through queries over Wikidata's collaboratively edited graph, the imported data is noisy: some items are non-mathematical, while others are ambiguous. In this paper, we test whether a voting ensemble of LLM judges can filter this noise. We evaluate it on Wikidata items with known MathWorld identifiers as a positive control, and examine how classification changes when database identifiers are removed from context. We then inspect the cases where the judges disagree with MathWorld and group these disagreements into three categories (degenerate descriptions, narrow scope bias, and editorial-scope mismatches) that suggest different remediation strategies.

title: Active Quantum Kernel Acquisition for Gaussian Process Regression
summary: Quantum kernel estimation on near-term hardware is shot-budgeted: every entry of the kernel Gram matrix is a Bernoulli expectation that must be sampled with a finite number of circuit executions. Recent work on quantum kernel classification has shown that allocating shots non-uniformly across kernel entries, weighted by their downstream task sensitivity, can reduce the shot budget required to reach a target accuracy. We extend this idea to Gaussian process (GP) regression, a setting whose downstream quantities (full-spectrum posterior variance, log-determinant, marginal likelihood) couple to kernel error more tightly than the sign-only outputs of classification. We derive three closed-form pair-level sensitivities predictive coupling $|α_iα_j|$, leave-one-out residual, and marginal-likelihood gradient and plug them into a Neyman-style minimum-variance allocation rule. To prevent catastrophic over-concentration when the warm-up sensitivity estimate is itself noisy, we add a high uniform coverage floor justified by a Frobenius lower bound on the missing-entry perturbation. On four UCI benchmarks and two synthetic RBF + Bernoulli controlled studies, the resulting allocator delivers $10$--$21\%$ test-RMSE improvement over uniform allocation across the moderate-budget regime. The gain transfers (i) to genuine ZZ and Pauli-Z quantum kernels on quantum-natural data ($-13$--$15\%$ at low budget, $p<0.05$ paired) and (ii) to four downstream tasks (Bayesian quadrature, heteroscedastic regression, hyperparameter learning, multi-output Cokriging). On UCI features embedded into a ZZ kernel the gain disappears, consistent with the exponential-concentration regime where shot allocation has nothing to exploit.

AI.title_translation: 用于高斯过程回归的主动量子核获取
AI.tldr: 通过针对回归任务的特定指标优化量子电路采样分配，显著减少了量子核回归所需的采样预算并提升了预测精度。
AI.motivation: 在近期的量子硬件上进行核估计受限于有限的采样次数（shot budget）。现有的研究表明，非均匀分配采样可以提高分类任务的效率，但针对高斯过程回归中更复杂的下游指标（如后验方差、对数行列式等）尚缺乏有效的采样分配策略。
AI.method: 推导了三种闭式成对敏感度（预测耦合、留一法残差、边际似然梯度），并结合奈曼型最小方差分配规则进行采样分配；同时引入了基于Frobenius范数下界的均匀覆盖底线，以缓解初始敏感度估计噪声带来的过拟合风险。
AI.result: 在UCI基准测试和合成数据实验中，该方法相比均匀分配实现了10%到21%的测试RMSE改进；在实际量子核数据集及多种下游任务中也展现了明显的性能提升。但在指数集中区域，由于采样分配可利用空间有限，改进效果会消失。
AI.conclusion: 本研究证明，在量子核回归中采用主动采样分配策略，能有效提升在有限采样预算下的预测性能，特别是在处理具有特定结构的任务时效果显著。
AI.translation: 近期硬件上的量子核估计受限于采样预算：核Gram矩阵的每一个条目都是一个伯努利期望，必须通过有限次数的电路执行进行采样。近期的量子核分类研究表明，根据下游任务敏感度非均匀分配采样数，可以降低达到目标精度所需的采样预算。我们将这一思想扩展到高斯过程（GP）回归，该设置下的下游量（全谱后验方差、对数行列式、边际似然）与核误差的耦合比分类任务的符号输出更紧密。我们推导了三种闭式成对敏感度——预测耦合|α_iα_j|、留一法残差和边际似然梯度，并将它们代入奈曼型最小方差分配规则。为了防止当预热敏感度估计本身存在噪声时出现灾难性的过度集中，我们增加了一个由缺失条目扰动的Frobenius下界证明的高均匀覆盖底线。在四个UCI基准测试和两个合成RBF+伯努利对照研究中，所得的分配器在中等预算范围内比均匀分配实现了10%-21%的测试RMSE改进。这种增益转移到了（i）量子自然数据上的真实ZZ和Pauli-Z量子核（低预算下-13%至-15%，p<0.05配对）和（ii）四个下游任务（贝叶斯求积、异方差回归、超参数学习、多输出协同克里金法）。在嵌入ZZ核的UCI特征上，增益消失，这与采样分配无用武之地的指数集中区域一致。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对高斯过程回归的主动量子核获取方法，通过计算下游任务指标的敏感度，实现非均匀采样分配，从而在有限的量子硬件采样预算下显著提升回归任务的预测精度。
AI.keywords: 量子核估计, 高斯过程回归, 主动学习, 采样分配, 量子机器学习
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的主动量子核获取策略，通过优化量子电路的采样分配（shot allocation）来提高高斯过程回归的精度。其核心贡献在于将非均匀采样分配策略从分类任务扩展到了回归任务，并推导出了针对回归任务特定指标的敏感度分析方法，这在处理量子硬件资源受限问题上具有重要的工程实用价值。

title: Underwater Source Detection and Classification for Signal-based Surveillance: Audio Dataset Curation and Cross-Domain Evaluation
comments: 6 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the 2026 International Conference on Advanced Visual and Signal-Based Systems (AVSS) - Lecce, Italy
summary: Machine learning for underwater acoustics is constrained by the scarcity of publicly available labeled datasets. In contrast to air-acoustic domains, where large benchmarks enable rapid model development, underwater datasets are typically small and limited in acoustic diversity, restricting robust model training and cross-domain generalization. To help address this gap, we introduce a curated underwater audio dataset derived from an open-source maritime sound archive. The dataset contains over one thousand labeled audio segments across eight biologically and mechanically relevant acoustic classes, providing an additional resource for training models in data-limited underwater environments. Additionally, we establish a lightweight Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) baseline and propose a margin-enhanced loss with feature alignment to mitigate class confusion arising from data imbalance, acoustic similarity, and cross-domain mismatch. While the baseline achieves 96.35% in-domain accuracy, evaluation on ShipsEar reveals substantial domain shift; the proposed feature alignment improve zero-shot ship detection by 42.60%, demonstrating stronger robustness under distribution mismatch. We further release a transparent curation pipeline and reproducible benchmark to support future research on imbalance mitigation, domain adaptation, and data-efficient underwater acoustic classification.

AI.title_translation: 基于信号监控的水下声源检测与分类：音频数据集构建与跨域评估
AI.tldr: 针对水下声学数据稀缺问题，本文构建了新的标注数据集，并提出特征对齐方法，显著提升了船舶检测在跨域环境下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 水下声学领域缺乏公开的标注数据集，且现有模型在数据有限的环境下难以实现鲁棒的跨域泛化。
AI.method: 构建包含八类声学信号的标注数据集；采用轻量级卷积神经网络（CNN）作为基线模型；引入带有特征对齐的边缘增强损失函数（margin-enhanced loss）来解决数据不平衡和跨域失配问题。
AI.result: 构建了包含一千多个音频片段的数据集；基线模型在域内准确率达到96.35%；通过特征对齐，在ShipsEar数据集上的零样本船舶检测性能提升了42.60%。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过发布新的数据集和改进的CNN模型，有效缓解了水下声学领域的数据不平衡和跨域泛化难题，为未来相关研究奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 水下声学的机器学习研究受到公开标注数据集稀缺的限制。与拥有大型基准测试以实现快速模型开发的空气声学领域相比，水下数据集通常规模较小且声学多样性有限，这限制了稳健的模型训练和跨域泛化。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了一个源自开源海事声音档案的精选水下音频数据集。该数据集包含八个生物和机械相关声学类别的超过一千个标注音频片段，为数据受限的水下环境中的模型训练提供了额外资源。此外，我们建立了一个轻量级卷积神经网络（CNN）基线，并提出了一种带有特征对齐的边缘增强损失函数，以减轻因数据不平衡、声学相似性和跨域失配引起的类混淆。虽然基线模型实现了96.35%的域内准确率，但在ShipsEar上的评估显示存在显著的域偏移；所提出的特征对齐方法使零样本船舶检测性能提高了42.60%，证明了在分布失配下的更强鲁棒性。我们进一步发布了一个透明的策展流程和可复现的基准测试，以支持未来在不平衡缓解、域适应和数据高效水下声学分类方面的研究。
AI.summary: 本文针对水下声学数据稀缺问题，构建了一个包含八种声学类别的标注数据集，并提出了一种结合特征对齐的轻量级CNN模型，有效解决了数据不平衡和跨域检测性能下降的问题。
AI.keywords: 水下声学, 数据集构建, 跨域评估, 卷积神经网络, 特征对齐
AI.comments: 该研究针对水下声学领域数据匮乏的痛点，通过构建公开数据集并提出有效的特征对齐方法，显著提升了模型在跨域场景下的泛化能力，为水下监测提供了重要的技术基准。

title: When Prices Double in a Week: Forecasting of Agricultural Volatility in Import-Isolated Markets
summary: Vegetable prices in Sri Lanka are highly volatile because the market is largely import-isolated, so supply disruptions quickly drive prices up. This study develops a machine learning framework to forecast such volatility by incorporating supply-chain-aware features and explicitly modelling the country's two cultivation seasons, Maha (October-April) and Yala (May-September). An integrated dataset was constructed by combining retail and farmer-gate prices with origin-aligned weather variables, diesel costs, and exchange rates across 12 vegetable varieties and 14 market centres from 2013 to 2019. A gradient-boosted ensemble model (XGBoost and LightGBM) was trained and optimised using Optuna, and unified and season-specific configurations were compared. Results show that season-specific models improve within-season fit, with the Yala-specific model achieving the highest R2 of 0.9420 (95% CI [0.690, 1.000]), while the unified model delivers the best overall predictive accuracy of 90.84% (95% CI [88.34%, 91.52%]) and an R2 of 0.9281 (95% CI [0.760, 1.000]). Notably, the unified model maintains 85.96% accuracy on a completely unseen 2024 hyperinflationary period without retraining, successfully tracking major price surges. These findings suggest that agricultural price movements in import-constrained markets are meaningfully predictable when models capture supply-chain dynamics, offering practical value for early warning and decision making by farmers, traders, and policymakers. Existing studies on Sri Lankan vegetable prices are confined to Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) and Generalized Autoregressive Conditional Heteroskedasticity (GARCH) applied to single markets, with no supply-chain features, seasonal segmentation, or cross-regime validation.

AI.title_translation: 当价格一周翻倍时：进口受限市场中的农产品波动预测
AI.tldr: 本文通过引入供应链动态和季节性因素，利用机器学习模型成功预测了斯里兰卡进口受限环境下的蔬菜价格波动，并在极端通胀期间展现了优异的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 斯里兰卡蔬菜市场因进口孤立导致供应中断引发价格剧烈波动，而现有研究多局限于单市场且缺乏供应链特征或季节性分析，难以有效应对此类波动。
AI.method: 构建包含零售价、农场交货价、天气、柴油成本和汇率的综合数据集；利用XGBoost和LightGBM梯度提升集成模型，通过Optuna进行参数优化，并对比统一模型与季节性特定模型的性能。
AI.result: 季节性模型在特定季节拟合度更高（Yala季节R2达0.9420），统一模型整体预测准确率达90.84%（R2为0.9281），并在未经重训练的情况下在2024年恶性通胀期仍保持85.96%的预测准确率。
AI.conclusion: 在进口受限的市场中，通过整合供应链动态和季节性特征，机器学习模型能够有效预测农产品价格波动，即使在极端通胀环境下也具备良好的泛化能力。
AI.translation: 斯里兰卡的蔬菜价格波动剧烈，因为该市场在很大程度上是进口孤立的，供应中断会导致价格迅速上涨。本研究开发了一个机器学习框架来预测这种波动，通过纳入供应链感知特征并明确模拟该国的两个种植季节：Maha（10月至4月）和Yala（5月至9月）。我们构建了一个综合数据集，结合了2013年至2019年间12个蔬菜品种和14个市场中心的零售价和农场交货价，以及与产地相关的天气变量、柴油成本和汇率。我们利用Optuna训练并优化了梯度提升集成模型（XGBoost和LightGBM），并比较了统一和特定季节的配置。结果表明，季节特定模型改善了季节内的拟合度，其中Yala特定模型达到了最高的R2值0.9420（95% CI [0.690, 1.000]），而统一模型提供了90.84%（95% CI [88.34%, 91.52%]）的最佳整体预测准确率和0.9281（95% CI [0.760, 1.000]）的R2值。值得注意的是，统一模型在未经重新训练的情况下，在完全未见的2024年恶性通胀期间保持了85.96%的准确率，成功跟踪了主要的价格飙升。这些发现表明，当模型捕捉到供应链动态时，进口受限市场中的农产品价格变动是可预测的，为农民、贸易商和政策制定者的早期预警和决策提供了实用价值。现有的斯里兰卡蔬菜价格研究仅限于应用于单一市场的自回归综合移动平均（ARIMA）和广义自回归条件异方差（GARCH）模型，缺乏供应链特征、季节性细分或跨制度验证。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对进口受限市场（以斯里兰卡为例）的农产品价格波动预测机器学习框架。通过整合供应链感知特征及季节性（Maha和Yala）因素，利用梯度提升算法构建预测模型。研究表明，该方法不仅提升了常规时期的预测精度，在面临极端通胀冲击时依然表现出强大的泛化与跟踪能力。
AI.keywords: 农产品价格预测, 机器学习, 供应链动态, 季节性模型, 斯里兰卡市场
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入供应链感知特征和季节性建模，显著提升了进口受限市场农产品价格的预测精度。其创新之处在于超越了传统的ARIMA/GARCH模型，并验证了模型在极端通胀时期的鲁棒性，具有极高的现实政策参考价值。

title: FADE: Mitigating Hallucinations by Reducing Language-Prior Dominance in Large Vision-Language Models
summary: Despite the impressive capabilities of Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), they remain susceptible to hallucination, generating content inconsistent with the input image. Recent studies attribute this to the dominance of language priors over visual inputs and employ contrastive decoding methods to mitigate this dominance, but the mechanistic origin remains unexplored. We investigate the information flow through each transformer layer and find that attention modules consistently aggregate visual evidence, while FFN modules at critical layers act as the source of language priors. These priors can override visual evidence, causing correct predictions in intermediate layers to drift toward incorrect outputs. Based on this insight, we propose FADE (FFN Attenuation for DEcoding), a training-free method that attenuates FFN outputs to reduce language-prior dominance. Evaluations on POPE, CHAIR, and MME benchmarks across LLaVA-1.5, mPLUG-Owl2, and InstructBLIP show that FADE effectively mitigates hallucinations while preserving inference efficiency.

title: Sparse Sensor Placement in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Control of Rayleigh-Bénard Convection
summary: This paper studies sparse sensor placement for control of Rayleigh-Bénard convection with multi-agent reinforcement learning. We train dense expert policies with windowed observations and distill sparse apprentice policies by supervised learning with grouped regularization on encoder input weights. The framework combines ordered non-convex grouped regularization and iterative reweighted grouped regularization, and uses a grouping construction that enforces consistent pruning across overlapping observation windows. Experiments with fixed and varying initial conditions show that Multi-Agent Transformer policies train more stably than proximal policy optimization baselines, while sparse apprentices retain control behavior comparable to dense experts. Sparsity results are strong for the proposed grouped methods across settings, including maximal sparsity in all fixed-initial-condition setting variants and maximal or near-maximal sparsity in varying-initial-condition setting variants. As an additional proof of concept, training from learned minimal sensor sets reduces per-agent observation size from 360 to 12 and preserves the overall training trend in simulation while reducing data throughput. The results provide both an interpretable basis for identifying control-relevant spatial regions and state components, and a practical pathway toward sensor-efficient control under realistic hardware constraints.

title: KYON: Semi-Modular Wheel-Legged Quadruped With Agile Bimanual Capability
summary: This paper presents KYON, a hybrid wheel-legged quadruped robot equipped with a bimanual upper body for loco-manipulation tasks. The platform features a semi-modular design with a reconfigurable lower legs, enabling both wheeled and legged locomotion depending on the environment. A design approach that places actuators in the base and uses transmission mechanisms reduces distal inertia, improving agility and dynamic performance. The robot integrates a whole-body control framework together with a reinforcement learning based policy to handle nonlinear dynamics and enhance robustness to disturbances for the execution of locomotion and manipulation tasks, independently. Experimental results demonstrate effective dynamic locomotion and bimanual manipulation, validating the platform's capability to operate in complex and unstructured scenarios.

title: Adjoint-Based Bayesian Uncertainty Quantification for PDE-Constrained Inverse Problems with Application to Semiconductor Imaging
summary: We formulate a Bayesian framework for reconstructing doping profiles in pn-junction semiconductor devices from boundary flux measurements. The unknown doping field is modeled as a piecewise-constant function characterized by an unknown interface and two plateau concentrations, leading to a nonlinear ill-posed inverse problem governed by a Poisson-Boltzmann-type equation. To represent this structure while enabling efficient gradient-based inference, we introduce a pushforward prior constructed by mapping a latent Gaussian field with Matérn-type covariance through a sigmoid transformation. The latent field is parameterized by a truncated Karhunen-Loève expansion, while the two piecewise-constant levels are represented by scalar plateau parameters. The prior yields differentiable approximations of piecewise-constant fields with controllable interface sharpness. We establish well-posedness of the Bayesian formulation by proving Lipschitz continuity of the forward map and Hellinger stability of the posterior. We then sample the posterior using the No-U-Turn Sampler (NUTS) with gradients computed by the adjoint method. Numerical experiments show that the combination of the proposed prior and NUTS provides more efficient posterior exploration than the dimension-robust preconditioned Crank-Nicolson (pCN) sampler, yielding one to two orders of magnitude larger effective sample sizes. In the known-plateau setting, the method reconstructs both planar and curved interfaces and provides spatially resolved uncertainty quantification (UQ). When the interface geometry and plateau concentrations are inferred jointly, posterior correlations reveal structural non-identifiability. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of combining pushforward priors with adjoint-gradient-based sampling for reliable UQ in nonlinear partial differential equation-constrained inverse problems with sharp interfaces.

AI.title_translation: 基于伴随算子的贝叶斯不确定性量化方法在PDE约束反问题中的应用：以半导体成像为例
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合推前先验和伴随梯度采样的高效贝叶斯框架，解决了半导体掺杂分布重构中的非线性反问题，显著提升了不确定性量化的计算效率。
AI.motivation: 针对半导体器件掺杂分布重构中存在的非线性、病态反问题，旨在克服传统采样方法效率低的问题，并实现对尖锐界面和掺杂水平的可靠不确定性量化。
AI.method: 采用推前先验（通过Sigmoid变换映射高斯场）来表示分段常数掺杂分布；利用Karhunen-Loève展开对潜在场进行参数化；通过伴随方法计算梯度，并使用NUTS采样器进行后验推理。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，该方法在后验探索效率上比pCN采样器高出1到2个数量级，能够准确重构平面及弯曲界面，并有效揭示了界面几何与掺杂浓度间的结构性非可辨识性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证实了将推前先验与伴随梯度采样相结合的方法，能够高效且鲁棒地解决PDE约束下的尖锐界面反问题，并能有效揭示参数间的非可辨识性。
AI.translation: 我们构建了一个贝叶斯框架，用于从边界通量测量中重构pn结半导体器件的掺杂分布。未知的掺杂场被建模为由未知界面和两个平台浓度表征的分段常数函数，这导致了一个由泊松-玻尔兹曼型方程控制的非线性病态反问题。为了在表示这种结构的同时实现高效的基于梯度的推理，我们引入了一个推前先验，通过Sigmoid变换映射具有Matérn型协方差的潜在高斯场。潜在场由截断的Karhunen-Loève展开参数化，而两个分段常数水平则由标量平台参数表示。该先验产生了具有可控界面锐度的分段常数场的可微近似。我们通过证明正向映射的Lipschitz连续性和后验的Hellinger稳定性，确立了贝叶斯公式的适定性。然后，我们使用No-U-Turn Sampler (NUTS) 对后验进行采样，其中梯度通过伴随方法计算。数值实验表明，所提出的先验与NUTS的结合提供了比维度稳健的预处理Crank-Nicolson (pCN) 采样器更高效的后验探索，产生了高出1到2个数量级的有效样本量。在已知平台设置下，该方法重构了平面和弯曲界面，并提供了空间分辨的不确定性量化 (UQ)。当联合推断界面几何形状和平台浓度时，后验相关性揭示了结构性的非可辨识性。这些结果证明了将推前先验与基于伴随梯度的采样相结合，对于解决具有尖锐界面的非线性偏微分方程约束反问题中的可靠UQ是有效的。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于推前先验的贝叶斯框架，用于解决半导体pn结掺杂分布的PDE约束反问题。通过将潜在高斯场映射为分段常数场，并结合伴随梯度与NUTS采样，该方法实现了高效的后验推理，不仅提升了采样效率，还为尖锐界面反问题的参数重构与不确定性量化提供了强有力的工具。
AI.keywords: 贝叶斯不确定性量化, PDE约束反问题, 半导体成像, 推前先验, 伴随方法
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于成功将基于伴随算子的梯度采样方法（NUTS）与推前先验（pushforward prior）相结合，解决了PDE约束反问题中分段常数场重构的计算效率瓶颈。其理论分析（如后验稳定性证明）严谨，且在处理尖锐界面和空间不确定性量化方面具有很强的实用价值。

title: Computing the Integral R2 Indicator by Perspective Mapping and Box Decomposition
comments: 27 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Restructured the three-dimensional section, revised conclusions and graphics, removed probabilistic reasoning from the proof, two-dimensional Jacobian determinant explanation figures. Added keywords. Scope in introduction
summary: The continuous integral R2 indicator is a Pareto-compliant refinement of the classical finite-weight-vector R2 indicator, used in performance assessment, bounded archiving for a-posteriori multi-objective optimization, and skyline selection in databases. This work introduces a bidirectional perspective mapping between continuous integral R2 computation and integration over unions of anchored axis-aligned boxes. After translating the ideal point of a minimization problem to the origin, approximation points become strictly positive loss vectors, and the subgraph of the lower weighted Tchebycheff envelope over the weight simplex maps to the complement of an anchored-box union in reciprocal objective space. The Jacobian gives an absolute R2 formula as a weighted complement volume with density $(x_1+\cdots+x_N)^{-(N+1)}$, while differences of R2 values become finite weighted hypervolume differences. Hence, hypervolume algorithms that emit box decompositions can be reused by replacing ordinary box volumes with closed-form weighted box integrals. For $N$ objectives, this gives an output-sensitive overhead $O(2^N M)$ for an $M$-box decomposition, or $O(M)$ for fixed $N$. Using existing box-decomposition approaches, the integral R2 can be computed in $O(n \log n)$ for $N=2,3$, in $O(n^2)$ for $N=4$, and in $O\left(n^{\lfloor (N-1)/2\rfloor+1}\right)$ for $N\geq4$, with $n$ denoting the size of the approximation set. On the lower-bound side, exact value computation has an $Ω(n\log n)$ lower bound in the algebraic decision-tree model already in two objectives, this bound lifts to every fixed $N\geq2$, and exact computation is $\#P$-hard when $N$ is part of the input. Together, the proposed perspective mapping provides a powerful tool for transferring algorithmic and structural results between anchored-box union and hypervolume theory and integral R2 computation.

AI.title_translation: 通过视角映射与盒分解计算积分R2指标
AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种将积分R2指标计算转换为盒分解问题的映射方法，从而能够利用现有的超体积算法高效计算R2值，并分析了其在不同目标维度下的计算复杂度。
AI.motivation: 现有的积分R2指标计算复杂且缺乏高效的通用算法，需要寻找一种能复用现有成熟几何计算方法（如超体积算法）的计算途径。
AI.method: 提出了一种双向视角映射方法，将连续积分R2计算转换为对锚定轴对齐盒并集的积分；利用超体积算法生成的盒分解，通过替换闭式加权盒积分来计算R2值。
AI.result: 实现了积分R2指标的高效计算，对于N=2,3目标，复杂度为O(n log n)；对于N=4目标，复杂度为O(n^2)；对于N>=4目标，复杂度为O(n^(floor((N-1)/2)+1))。此外，证明了在N为输入的一部分时，精确计算是#P-hard的。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种通过视角映射和盒分解来计算积分R2指标的高效方法，证明了该方法可以复用现有的超体积算法，并给出了相应的计算复杂度分析。
AI.translation: 连续积分R2指标是经典有限权重向量R2指标的帕累托兼容细化版本，广泛应用于多目标优化的性能评估、后验有界归档以及数据库中的天际线选择。本文引入了一种双向视角映射，用于连接连续积分R2计算与锚定轴对齐盒并集的积分。通过将最小化问题的理想点平移至原点，近似点转化为严格正的损失向量，加权切比雪夫包络下的子图映射为倒数目标空间中锚定盒并集的补集。雅可比矩阵给出了一个绝对R2公式，即带有密度(x1+...+xN)^(-(N+1))的加权补集体积，而R2值的差分则转化为有限加权超体积差。因此，通过将普通盒体积替换为闭式加权盒积分，可以复用输出盒分解的超体积算法。对于N个目标，这给出了M个盒分解的输出敏感开销O(2^N M)，或对于固定N为O(M)。利用现有的盒分解方法，积分R2可以在N=2,3时以O(n log n)计算，N=4时以O(n^2)计算，N>=4时以O(n^(floor((N-1)/2)+1))计算，其中n为近似集的大小。在下界方面，精确值计算在代数决策树模型中对于两个目标已经具有Ω(n log n)的下界，该界限适用于每个固定的N>=2，且当N是输入的一部分时，精确计算是#P-hard的。总之，所提出的视角映射为在锚定盒并集理论、超体积理论与积分R2计算之间转移算法和结构性结果提供了一个强大的工具。
AI.summary: 本文引入了一种将连续积分R2指标计算映射为锚定盒并集积分的新方法。通过视角映射，研究者能够利用现有的超体积盒分解算法来计算R2值，从而极大地优化了计算效率，并为相关理论研究提供了新的桥梁。
AI.keywords: 积分R2指标, 多目标优化, 视角映射, 盒分解, 超体积算法
AI.comments: 该论文通过视角映射将连续积分R2指标计算转化为盒分解问题，巧妙地利用了超体积算法的成熟成果，具有很高的理论价值和实际应用潜力。限制在于当目标维度N作为输入的一部分时，计算复杂度存在#P-hard的问题。

title: Reweighting Framewise Attention in Video Transformers for Facial Expression Understanding
summary: Understanding facial expressions in videos requires modeling subtle and localized facial dynamics under unconstrained conditions. Although recent Vision Transformer (ViT)-based video models have shown strong performance through large-scale self-supervised pretraining, their attention mechanisms often emphasize dominant global motions and coarse temporal dynamics, limiting sensitivity to fine-grained facial variations. To address this limitation, we propose MiRA (Marginal-induced Attention Redistribution), a plug-in frame-marginal attention redistribution framework for ViT backbones that enhances spatio-temporal selectivity toward subtle facial dynamics without introducing additional trainable parameters. MiRA derives frame-level confidence and intra-frame concentration statistics from self-attention maps to estimate frame-wise marginal importance and redistribute attention toward spatiotemporally localized facial cues. We first introduce a principled exact mode based on post-softmax attention redistribution. To further improve efficiency, we propose flashLite mode, a lightweight pre-softmax approximation that integrates frame-marginal redistribution into FlashAttention kernels while preserving the effectiveness of the exact formulation. Experimental results on challenging Facial Expression Recognition (FER) benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong ViT baselines.

title: SAMBA: A Scatter-Guided Masked Bidirectional Mamba Foundation Model for SAR Target Recognition
summary: Synthetic aperture radar automatic target recognition (SAR ATR) is critical for Earth observation and defense, but its practical deployment is constrained by scarce annotated training data. Self-supervised pre-training alleviates this label bottleneck, yet prevailing Transformer architectures incur prohibitive quadratic computational complexity, and conventional universal masking neglects the unique electromagnetic scattering properties intrinsic to SAR imagery. To address these limitations, we propose SAMBA (Scattering-Guided Bidirectional Mamba), an efficient self-supervised pre-training foundation model for SAR target interpretation. Our framework features three core innovations: (i) a linear-complexity Mamba encoder with a mid-sequence class token to mitigate computational bottlenecks; (ii) a three-level hierarchical Scattering-Guided Masked Autoencoder (SG-MAE) masking strategy guided by SAR physical priors, aligning the pretext task with SAR's intrinsic imaging mechanism; (iii) a lightweight SpatialMix feature interaction module to enhance cross-region feature fusion. We also design a two-stage cross-domain pre-training pipeline to optimize the overall pre-training process. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that SAMBA consistently delivers superior performance across all pre-training configurations, with substantially fewer parameters than both CNN and Transformer baselines. Compared with the default masking strategy in standard MAE, the proposed SG-MAE strategy further boosts the model's few-shot transfer capability. Benchmarking on seven downstream datasets covering classification and detection tasks shows SAMBA achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance on most metrics, fully validating its robust generalizability across diverse SAR interpretation tasks. Source code and pre-trained weights are publicly available at https://github.com/mynswkk/SAMBA.

AI.title_translation: SAMBA：一种用于SAR目标识别的散射引导掩码双向Mamba基础模型
AI.tldr: SAMBA通过结合Mamba架构与SAR物理先验的掩码策略，实现了高效、高精度的SAR目标识别。
AI.motivation: SAR自动目标识别面临标注数据稀缺的瓶颈，而现有的Transformer架构存在计算复杂度过高的问题，且通用的掩码策略忽略了SAR图像独特的电磁散射特性。

AI.result: SAMBA在参数量显著少于CNN和Transformer基线的情况下，在七个下游数据集的分类和检测任务中均取得了优异表现，在大多数指标上达到SOTA水平。

AI.translation: 合成孔径雷达自动目标识别（SAR ATR）对地球观测和国防至关重要，但其部署受限于稀缺的标注数据。自监督预训练缓解了这一标签瓶颈，然而现有的Transformer架构存在难以承受的二次计算复杂度，且传统的通用掩码忽略了SAR图像固有的电磁散射特性。为了解决这些限制，我们提出了SAMBA（散射引导的双向Mamba），这是一种用于SAR目标解释的高效自监督预训练基础模型。我们的框架具有三个核心创新：（i）具有中间序列类标记的线性复杂度Mamba编码器，以缓解计算瓶颈；（ii）受SAR物理先验引导的三层分级散射引导掩码自编码器（SG-MAE）策略，使预训练任务与SAR的内在成像机制对齐；（iii）增强跨区域特征融合的轻量级SpatialMix特征交互模块。我们还设计了一个两阶段跨域预训练流水线以优化整体预训练过程。广泛的评估表明，SAMBA在所有预训练配置中均表现出优越性能，且参数量远少于CNN和Transformer基线。与标准MAE中的默认掩码策略相比，提出的SG-MAE策略进一步提升了模型的少样本迁移能力。在涵盖分类和检测任务的七个下游数据集上的基准测试表明，SAMBA在大多数指标上达到了最先进（SOTA）的性能，充分验证了其在多种SAR解释任务中的强大通用性。源代码和预训练权重已在https://github.com/mynswkk/SAMBA公开。
AI.summary: SAMBA是一个针对SAR目标识别的高效自监督预训练基础模型。它通过线性复杂度的Mamba编码器、基于物理先验的SG-MAE掩码策略以及SpatialMix交互模块，克服了计算开销大和特征提取不充分的挑战，实现了在少样本场景下的卓越性能。
AI.keywords: SAR目标识别, Mamba模型, 自监督学习, 散射引导掩码, 基础模型
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将Mamba架构应用于SAR图像处理，并结合了SAR特有的电磁散射物理先验，解决了传统Transformer计算复杂度高和通用掩码策略不适应SAR成像机制的问题。这种领域特定先验与高效架构的结合，是SAR领域自监督学习的一个重要研究方向。

title: Vertigo Vertigo: Reconstructing a Cinematic Ideal through its Predictive AI Double
comments: Accepted to Ars Electronica EXPANDED 2026 - Conference on Animation and Interactive Art (in cooperation with ACM SIGGRAPH), Ars Electronica Festival, Linz. 7 pages, 7 figures. Authors' version
summary: Vertigo Vertigo is a scene-for-scene AI reconstruction of Hitchcock's Vertigo (1958), generated from only 2.78% of the original film's frames. Using this sparse set of keyframe anchors, we perform first-last frame interpolation via a large video diffusion model to predict the intervening sequences. Vertigo is itself a film about the obsessive reconstruction of an artificial ideal; Vertigo Vertigo extends this logic to the material of the film, treating the canonical text as a probe for the normative conventions of classical cinema encoded within generative systems. Evaluated through computational analysis and critical feedback from media theorists (Lev Manovich, Shane Denson, Kevin L. Ferguson), the artifact demonstrates remarkable structural fidelity: 73.1% of frames are recognizable as plausible renditions of Vertigo and only 3.6% fail catastrophically. This fidelity suggests that cinematic norms are deeply compressed within the model's latent priors. Aesthetically, the reconstruction is rendered as an unstable overlay between the original film and its predictive shadow, fueling a persistent doubt in the viewer's perception of authenticity -- a 21st-century vertigo. The work argues that generative media is not a paradigm shift from cinema but an acceleration of its logic of desire and false authenticity, extending from classical Hollywood through to the predictive media environments now reshaping contemporary perception.

AI.title_translation: 迷魂记中的迷魂记：通过预测性AI替身重构电影理想
AI.tldr: 通过AI重构《迷魂记》的研究表明，生成模型已内化了经典电影的叙事规范，生成式媒体是电影虚构逻辑的延伸与加速。

AI.method: 利用《迷魂记》仅2.78%的关键帧作为锚点，通过大型视频扩散模型进行首尾帧插值，重构整部电影。

AI.conclusion: 生成式媒体并非电影的范式转移，而是电影逻辑（欲望与虚假真实感）的加速，它通过预测性媒体重新塑造了当代感知。
AI.translation: 《Vertigo Vertigo》是对希区柯克1958年电影《迷魂记》的逐场景AI重构，仅由原片2.78%的帧生成。利用这组稀疏的关键帧锚点，我们通过大型视频扩散模型进行首尾帧插值以预测中间序列。《迷魂记》本身就是一部关于痴迷于重构人造理想的电影；《Vertigo Vertigo》将这一逻辑扩展到电影素材本身，将经典文本视为探测生成系统中编码的古典电影规范的探针。通过计算分析和媒体理论家（Lev Manovich, Shane Denson, Kevin L. Ferguson）的批评反馈评估，该制品展示了显著的结构保真度：73.1%的帧被识别为《迷魂记》的可信呈现，仅3.6%发生灾难性失败。这种保真度表明，电影规范被深度压缩在模型的潜在先验中。在美学上，重构呈现为原始电影与其预测阴影之间不稳定的叠加，激起了观众对真实性认知的持续怀疑——一种21世纪的“迷魂”。该作品认为，生成式媒体并非电影的范式转移，而是其欲望逻辑和虚假真实性的加速，从古典好莱坞一直延伸到现今重塑当代感知的预测性媒体环境。
AI.summary: 《Vertigo Vertigo》是一项通过大型视频扩散模型对希区柯克电影《迷魂记》进行的场景重构实验。研究仅使用原片2.78%的关键帧，通过插值预测补全了影片。实验结果表明，生成模型深刻内化了经典电影的规范，作品呈现出一种不稳定的视觉叠影，揭示了生成式媒体作为电影虚构逻辑的延伸，正在重塑当代观看体验。
AI.keywords: 生成式AI, 电影重构, 扩散模型, 电影理论, 预测性媒体
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地将希区柯克电影《迷魂记》的主题——对虚构理想的痴迷重构——投射到生成式AI技术本身，通过技术实验揭示了生成模型内部隐含的经典电影叙事规范，具有很高的跨学科研究价值。

title: HARC: Coupling Harmfulness and Refusal Directions for Robust Safety Alignment
summary: Understanding how aligned LLMs internally represent safety is critical for diagnosing alignment vulnerabilities, as it explains why jailbreaks succeed and informs the design of robust alignment strategies. Prior work shows that aligned LLMs encode harmfulness and refusal as separable directions in the residual stream at prompt-side token positions. We show that jailbreaks succeed at prompt encoding by suppressing either the refusal or harmfulness direction before any token is generated, with distinct attack classes occupying separable regions of the harmfulness-refusal plane. Extending the analysis to response-token positions, we find that the model recognizes harmful content while it is generating that content, even when it failed to recognize the input as harmful at the prompt side. Motivated by our findings, we introduce HARC (Harmfulness-And-Refusal Coupling), a fine-tuning method that pairs the two directions across both prompt and response positions. Since the intervention is confined to the harmfulness-refusal subspace, it leaves the rest of the residual stream intact and does not degrade general capability or inflate over-refusal. Across extensive experiments, HARC achieves the strongest robustness-capability-usability trade-off among six baselines spanning the major training-time and inference-time safety methods. The harmfulness and refusal directions at prompt and response positions transfer across the five model families and two scales we tested without architecture-specific tuning.

title: Emergence of Preferential Attachment and Glass-Ceiling Effects in Autonomous Networks of LLMs
summary: We investigate the emergence of structural disparities in networks of collaborating large language model (LLM) agents. When LLM agents autonomously choose collaborators, the resulting communication network exhibits preferential-attachment dynamics: agents that are already prominent become increasingly likely to attract additional connections. In some cases, weaker LLM agents (agents with smaller base model or older version) can disproportionately occupy central and influential network positions relative to stronger LLM agents. We interpret this as a type-dependent glass-ceiling effect (GCE). We model the network of LLM agents as a time-evolving sequence of directed weighted graphs, where the vector-valued edge weights represent cumulative tokens exchanged, number of interaction rounds, and reasoning effort. Using a contraction mapping argument on the mean-field dynamics, we prove that the importance (centrality) of each agent type converges to a unique stable equilibrium. To ground the model in LLM decision mechanisms, we introduce a cross-attention-inspired utility for collaborator selection. This utility specifies the local connection dynamics and, together with the mean-field model, yields a predictive characterization of the limiting network structure and its type-dependent centrality gaps. To validate the theory, we develop an experimental testbed with 100 LLM agents. Our experiments show that autonomous network formation can generate persistent centrality disparities, with their magnitude and direction depending on model family, model size, system-prompt design, and task context. They further show that the effect of preferential attachment depends on its alignment with model capability: reinforcing it improves collective performance when stronger agents become central, whereas weakening it improves performance when network dynamics instead favor weaker agents.

AI.title_translation: 自主大语言模型网络中偏好依附与玻璃天花板效应的涌现
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了自主LLM代理网络会自发形成偏好依附结构，导致类似“玻璃天花板”的中心性差异，并通过调整这种动力学机制可改善系统整体性能。
AI.motivation: 探究在自主协作的LLM代理网络中，结构性差异（如偏好依附和玻璃天花板效应）是如何产生的，并理解其对网络中心性和系统性能的影响。
AI.method: 构建时间演化有向加权图模型；利用平均场动力学的压缩映射论证证明中心性均衡；引入交叉注意力启发的效用函数模拟代理协作选择；通过100个LLM代理的实验平台进行验证。
AI.result: 研究表明，自主网络形成会导致持久的中心性差异；偏好依附与模型能力的对齐至关重要：当强代理处于中心时，强化偏好依附可提升性能；反之，当弱代理处于中心时，削弱偏好依附则更利于整体表现。
AI.conclusion: 自主LLM网络会自动形成具有偏好依附特征的结构，并可能产生不公平的“玻璃天花板”效应，这种效应的本质取决于模型能力与网络中心性的对齐程度。
AI.translation: 我们研究了协作大语言模型（LLM）代理网络中结构性差异的涌现。当LLM代理自主选择合作者时，产生的通信网络表现出偏好依附动力学：已经很突出的代理越来越可能吸引额外的连接。在某些情况下，较弱的LLM代理（基础模型较小或版本较旧的代理）相对于较强的LLM代理，可能会不成比例地占据中心和有影响力的网络位置。我们将此解释为一种类型依赖的玻璃天花板效应（GCE）。我们将LLM代理网络建模为随时间演化的有向加权图序列，其中向量值边权重代表累计交换的Token、交互轮数和推理工作量。利用平均场动力学上的压缩映射论证，我们证明了每种代理类型的重要性（中心性）收敛于一个独特的稳定均衡。为了将模型建立在LLM决策机制的基础上，我们引入了一种受交叉注意力启发的协作选择效用。该效用指定了局部连接动力学，并与平均场模型一起，对限制网络结构及其类型依赖的中心性差距进行了预测性表征。为了验证该理论，我们开发了一个包含100个LLM代理的实验平台。我们的实验表明，自主网络形成可以产生持久的中心性差异，其大小和方向取决于模型家族、模型大小、系统提示词设计和任务上下文。实验进一步表明，偏好依附的影响取决于其与模型能力的对齐程度：当较强的代理变得中心化时，强化它会提高集体表现；而当网络动力学偏向较弱的代理时，削弱它会提高表现。
AI.summary: 本文研究了自主协作LLM代理网络中结构性差异的出现。研究发现，网络展现出偏好依附动力学，且由于“玻璃天花板”效应，不同能力的代理在中心性上会出现不均衡分布。作者通过理论建模与实验验证了这一现象，并指出通过调整偏好依附机制可以优化多代理系统的整体性能。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 多代理系统, 偏好依附, 玻璃天花板效应, 网络动力学
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将复杂网络动力学与大语言模型代理的社会行为相结合，揭示了AI代理网络中可能出现的结构性不平等。其重要性在于提醒人们，即使是自主的AI系统也可能产生类似于人类社会的“马太效应”和“玻璃天花板”现象，这对于设计稳健的多代理系统具有深远意义。局限性在于模型基于特定的效用函数假设，真实场景中的复杂交互可能更为多样。

title: Token Geometry
summary: Language models learn continuous programs over discrete symbols, with the embedding table and LM-head acting as the read/write interface between them. We show that this interface has gradient geometry distinct from dense hidden weights which can be exploited to improve the Pareto frontier across supervised finetuning, RL, and pretraining, while only utilizing kilobytes of optimizer state. We introduce Ember, a lightweight optimizer for embedding and LM-head matrices that utilizes O(V + D) VRAM, instead of Adam's O(2VD), and forgoes the need to shard both token table optimizer states. We provide empirical evidence that Ember scales effectively across batch size and parameter count. We show that the optimization trajectory of tokens can be well described by a simple 1D ray, counter to the popular belief that neural net parameters navigate a heavily nonconvex landscape. We provide a principled view on the surprisingly narrow space of optimizers that suffice for Transformer training. Finally, we open-source our distributed Ember implementation that merges cleanly with existing ZeRO/FSDP setups to support further research at https://github.com/katop1234/ember

title: Anti-Prompt: Image Protection against Text-Guided Image-to-Video Generation
summary: Recent advances in Image-to-Video generation allow a single image to be animated into a convincing video under text guidance, raising serious copyright and privacy risks. We propose Anti-Prompt, an image protection approach that injects imperceptible perturbations into an image, inducing visible inconsistencies and structural failures in text-guided I2V generation. Our method is motivated by a simple empirical observation. When text guidance is removed from modern I2V models, generation quality degrades markedly, not only in motion realism but also in subject preservation, structural coherence, and temporal consistency. Building on this insight, Anti-Prompt exploits the model reliance on textual guidance by attenuating text-conditioned interactions during denoising while strengthening visual-only pathways. To further systematically evaluate protection effectiveness, we introduce a Video-LLM-assisted evaluation protocol that provides interpretable, frame-grounded analyses of generation artifacts and inconsistencies. Experiments on two representative I2V architectures demonstrate that our method achieves strong protection performance while improving efficiency and cross-model transferability.

AI.title_translation: Anti-Prompt：针对文本引导图像转视频生成的图像保护技术
AI.tldr: Anti-Prompt通过向图像添加不可见的扰动，破坏AI视频生成模型对文本的依赖，从而防止图像被未经授权地转化为视频。
AI.motivation: 随着图像转视频（I2V）技术的发展，单张图片极易被非法生成视频，导致严重的版权和隐私问题，因此需要一种有效的图像防御机制。
AI.method: 提出Anti-Prompt方法，通过注入不可见的扰动来削弱去噪过程中的文本条件交互，同时增强视觉路径；并开发了基于Video-LLM的评估协议，用于分析生成过程中的伪影与不一致性。
AI.result: 实验表明，Anti-Prompt在两种主流I2V架构上均表现出强大的保护性能，能够显著诱发视频生成中的结构失败与视觉不一致，且具有更高的效率和跨模型迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: Anti-Prompt 通过向图像注入微小扰动，有效地破坏了基于文本引导的视频生成质量，为数字图像版权保护提供了一种高效、鲁棒的解决方案。
AI.translation: 近期图像转视频（I2V）技术的进步使得单张图像可以在文本引导下被转化为令人信服的视频，这引发了严重的版权和隐私风险。我们提出了Anti-Prompt，这是一种图像保护方法，通过向图像注入不可察觉的扰动，从而在文本引导的I2V生成中诱导产生明显的视觉不一致和结构性失败。我们的方法基于一个简单的实证观察：当从现代I2V模型中移除文本引导时，生成质量会显著下降，不仅在运动真实感方面，在主体保持、结构连贯性和时间一致性方面也是如此。基于这一见解，Anti-Prompt利用模型对文本引导的依赖，在去噪过程中削弱文本条件交互，同时增强仅视觉的路径。为了进一步系统地评估保护效果，我们引入了一种视频大模型（Video-LLM）辅助的评估协议，该协议能够对生成过程中的伪影和不一致性提供可解释的、基于帧的分析。在两种代表性I2V架构上的实验表明，我们的方法在实现强大保护性能的同时，提高了效率和跨模型迁移能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Anti-Prompt，一种旨在防止单张图像被恶意用于文本引导视频生成的保护方法。通过在图像中注入不可察觉的扰动，该方法破坏了模型对文本引导的依赖，导致生成的视频出现明显的结构性失败和视觉伪影，并配套了基于Video-LLM的评估协议。
AI.keywords: 图像保护, 视频生成, 对抗扰动, 版权隐私, 文本引导
AI.comments: 该研究针对图像被恶意用于AI生成视频的版权与隐私风险，提出了一种创新的防御机制。其亮点在于利用了I2V模型对文本引导的强依赖性，通过“去文本化”的扰动策略实现保护，并引入了基于Video-LLM的自动评估协议，具有良好的跨模型迁移能力和实用价值。

title: PHOENIX: Resilient LLM Training with Hot-Swapping via Zero-Overhead Checkpoint
summary: State-of-the-art large language model (LLM) training takes tens of thousands of graphics processing units (GPUs) for months and encounters failures across the software and hardware stack. Existing fault-tolerance mechanisms either impose non-trivial overhead during failure-free execution or suffer from prolonged recovery latency, particularly under scenarios where a small subset of compute nodes experience permanent failures. %The tradeoff between failure-free overhead and recovery latency forms a space forms a Pareto frontier We present PHOENIX to simultaneously address both optimization objectives. PHOENIX incorporates a fault-tolerance mechanism that restores LLM training via hot-swapping, namely by replacing failed nodes with spare nodes without terminating the complete job. The hot-swapping of PHOENIX is enabled by two ideas: First, it exploits an off-critical-path in-memory checkpointing mechanism for spatial redundancy. Second, it introduces a communicator reconstruction protocol that replaces failed nodes with spare nodes at runtime. PHOENIX efficiently overlaps the in-memory checkpointing with computation, thus introducing zero overhead during error-free execution. Upon permanent node failures, PHOENIX can rebuild memory states with minimal recomputation by leveraging in-memory checkpoints. We evaluate PHOENIX across scales (up to 512 NVIDIA A100 GPUs) and LLMs (up to 65B parameters), and observe zero checkpoint overhead with hot-swapping recovery completing in under 40 seconds. These results show that PHOENIX simultaneously achieves both zero-overhead error-free execution and extremely low recovery cost.

title: Learning the Supports for Categorical Critic in Reinforcement Learning
comments: In RLC 2026. Project page at https://isatine.xyz/projects/dysel, code at https://github.com/atine/dysel
summary: Value functions are an essential component in actor-critic based deep reinforcement learning (RL). Conventionally, these functions are trained as a regression task by minimising the mean squared error (MSE) relative to bootstrapped target values. Meanwhile, in distributional RL, a distribution of returns is modelled based on the distributional Bellman operator. This work investigates the Gaussian Histogram Loss (HL-Gauss), a recent approach that reframes value estimation as classification by encoding each scalar Bellman target as a Gaussian-smoothed categorical target. Despite its potential, applying histogram-based losses to RL presents inherent challenges, most notably the requirement to pre-define a fixed support interval, which is often complicated by the non-stationary and stochastic nature of target values typically found in RL tasks. In this work, we propose an approach that dynamically learns the lower and upper bounds of the support instead of assigning them beforehand. We derive an objective that jointly learns these bounds whilst learning the categorical representation of the scalar values, and we show that this objective forms an upper bound on the mean-squared Bellman error. Our theoretical analysis further shows that this bound is tighter than that of non-learned supports of HL-Gauss. Empirically, the proposed objective enables stable adaptation of the support interval and matches HL-Gauss-based actor-critic algorithms on most continuous-control tasks whilst improving on a subset, without requiring a pre-specified support interval.

AI.title_translation: 强化学习中分类评论家的支撑区间学习
AI.tldr: 提出了一种动态学习分布强化学习中支撑区间的方法，解决了预设支撑区间困难的问题，并提升了训练的稳定性和性能。
AI.motivation: 传统分布强化学习中基于直方图的损失函数（如HL-Gauss）需要预设固定的支撑区间，但强化学习任务中目标值的非平稳性和随机性使得预设这些参数非常困难。
AI.method: 提出了一种动态学习支撑区间上下界的方法，通过联合学习这些边界与标量值的分类表示，并推导出该目标函数作为均方贝尔曼误差的上界。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法能够稳定地自适应调整支撑区间，在大多数连续控制任务中与现有的HL-Gauss算法性能相当，并在部分任务中实现了性能提升，且无需预先指定支撑区间。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种动态学习支撑区间的方法，消除了预设支撑区间的需求，不仅在理论上证明了其作为均方贝尔曼误差上界的优越性，且在实验中验证了其在连续控制任务中的有效性。
AI.translation: 价值函数是基于演员-评论家（actor-critic）架构的深度强化学习中的核心组件。传统上，这些函数通过最小化相对于自助目标值的均方误差（MSE）作为回归任务来训练。同时，在分布强化学习中，回报的分布是基于分布贝尔曼算子进行建模的。本文研究了高斯直方图损失（HL-Gauss），这是一种将价值估计重构为分类任务的方法，通过将每个标量贝尔曼目标编码为高斯平滑的分类目标。尽管具有潜力，但将基于直方图的损失应用于强化学习存在固有的挑战，最显著的是需要预先定义固定的支撑区间，而这通常因强化学习任务中目标值的非平稳性和随机性而变得复杂。在本文中，我们提出了一种动态学习支撑区间上下界的方法，而不是提前指定它们。我们导出了一个目标函数，在学习标量值的分类表示的同时联合学习这些边界，并证明了该目标函数构成了均方贝尔曼误差的上界。我们的理论分析进一步表明，该边界比非学习支撑的HL-Gauss更紧。实验证明，所提出的目标函数能够实现支撑区间的稳定自适应，并在大多数连续控制任务中与基于HL-Gauss的演员-评论家算法性能相当，同时在部分任务上有所提升，且无需预先指定支撑区间。
AI.summary: 针对分布强化学习中直方图损失函数依赖预设支撑区间的局限性，本文提出了一种能够动态学习支撑区间上下界的新方法。该方法将支撑区间学习与分类目标联合优化，在理论上提供了更紧的误差边界，并在实验中展现了良好的适应性和性能。
AI.keywords: 分布强化学习, 价值函数, 支撑区间, 高斯直方图损失, 连续控制
AI.comments: 该论文通过将价值估计重构为分类问题，巧妙地解决了传统分布强化学习中固定支撑区间（support interval）预设困难的问题。其核心创新在于动态学习支撑区间的边界，并证明了该目标函数是均方贝尔曼误差的上界，理论支撑扎实，且在连续控制任务中表现出了良好的稳健性和性能。

title: Actuator Reality Shaping for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Robot Learning
summary: Sim-to-real transfer in robot learning is often limited by discrepancies between the ideal actuator dynamics assumed during policy training and the nonlinear, hardware-dependent behavior of physical motors. While conventional approaches attempt to bridge this gap by increasing simulator fidelity through system identification, domain randomization, or learned actuator models, we introduce an alternative paradigm: actuator reality shaping. Instead of modifying the simulator to match the real world, our method shapes the closed-loop behavior of physical actuators to match the idealized second-order reference dynamics used in simulation. By equipping each joint with a two-degree-of-freedom feedforward--feedback controller, we decouple reference-response shaping from robust stabilization, thereby providing a standardized actuator interface for reinforcement learning policies. As a result, policies trained only with the prescribed reference model can be deployed zero-shot on real hardware without task-level fine-tuning or learned actuator models. We validate the approach on a single-joint high-gear-ratio servo under external loads and a 7-DOF robotic arm reaching task, where actuator reality shaping substantially reduces sim-to-real tracking error and improves zero-shot task performance compared with standard servo-control and representative real-to-sim-to-real baselines. We further demonstrate zero-shot transfer on a wheeled-legged robot driving over a slope and a humanoid robot walking, suggesting that actuator reality shaping can serve as a reusable interface for robot learning across diverse hardware platforms. Project page: https://syamamori.github.io/ActuatorRealityShaping.github.io/

title: Cadence: Extreme Pipelining with Multiple Concurrent Proposers
summary: We present Cadence, a Byzantine fault-tolerant multi-proposer consensus protocol with arbitrarily low block intervals, optimal resilience, and optimal fast-path latency. Cadence divides time into equally spaced slots, one block per slot, each finalized in its own consensus instance. Blocks do not build directly on their predecessor, so instances run independently and none waits for an earlier block to finish or propagate; we call this extreme pipelining, decoupling the block interval from network latency. Cadence also removes the single-leader monopoly over transaction inclusion and ordering: under multiple concurrent proposers (MCP), several validators propose for each block, and it guarantees that, under synchrony, a transaction a correct proposer includes cannot be censored or deferred (short-term censorship resistance), and that no proposer can craft its proposal in reaction to the others' (hiding). To realize extreme pipelining, we introduce a general framework that turns any one-shot consensus meeting our slot-consensus specification into a multi-shot protocol. We instantiate it for MCP with two protocols of our own: Chorus, a slot consensus whose fast path finalizes a block in an optimal three rounds, with speculative finality one round earlier, and Conductor, an orchestrator that opens slots at an even cadence, more slowly under asynchrony to keep open slots bounded. To our knowledge, Cadence is the first MCP protocol to provide short-term censorship resistance and hiding at the fast-path latency of single-leader consensus. We prove safety, liveness, censorship resistance, and hiding under partial synchrony with optimal resilience (n = 3f+1). In simulation over Monad's 200 validators with five proposers per slot, finalization averages 219 ms (167 ms to speculative finality); at a 100 ms block interval a transaction waits on average 50 ms to enter a proposal.

title: Know Your Source: A Public Knowledge Store for Media Background Checks
summary: LLM-based retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is increasingly used for automated fact-checking (AFC) and related tasks. By grounding LLM outputs in retrieved evidence, RAG-based systems provide transparent justifications while allowing external information to be updated independently of the underlying model. However, existing approaches often assume retrieved evidence is reliable, although real-world information may be conflicting, outdated, and can originate from unreliable or biased sources. Recent work on *source-critical reasoning* addresses this challenge through media background checks (MBCs) (Schlichtkrull, 2024), which assess the credibility of evidence sources to support downstream fact verification. However, generating MBCs relies on costly proprietary search APIs, limiting reproducibility. To mitigate this issue, we introduce MEDIAREF, a publicly available knowledge store of web-sourced documents that enables reproducible, low-cost evaluation of MBC generation across 200 media sources. We describe a reproducible methodology for constructing and updating the collection, assess widely used LLMs on the MBC generation task, and demonstrate that MEDIAREF supports higher-quality MBC generation through both automatic and qualitative evaluation.

title: AgentsCAD: Automated Design for Manufacturing of FDM Parts via Multi-Agent LLM Reasoning and Geometric Feature Recognition
summary: Parts manufactured with Fused Deposition Modeling (FDM) often require Design for Additive Manufacturing (DFAM) modifications to ensure printability, structural integrity, and reduced post-processing. Current slicers identify defects such as steep overhangs but are unable to modify the underlying geometry. This work presents AgentsCAD, a multi-agent system that bridges raw boundary-representation (B-Rep) geometry and Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning to automate targeted DFM. The workflow begins by parsing a STEP file. The agentic system detects overhangs above a 45°threshold, constructs a face-adjacency topology graph, and optionally injects semantic feature labels from a GraphSAGE model trained on MFCAD++ (59,665 parts), before dispatching a Claude Sonnet design-reasoning agent that recommends reorientations, fillets, chamfers, and similar modifications. A GPT-4o vision-language verifier inspects rendered views to confirm geometric integrity. Outputs include a modified STEP file and a human-readable report. A test case on a birdhouse model demonstrates that the system correctly diagnoses overhangs, selects appropriate defect mitigation strategies, and proposes physically valid corrections, partially solving the geometry-to-language translation problem central to LLM-driven CAD modification.

title: VLRC: Vision-Language Reprojection Consistency as a scalable signal for better feed-forward 3D pretraining
summary: Feed-forward 3D models are commonly trained using either expensive geometric supervision or self-supervised photometric objectives, both of which provide incomplete learning signals. We introduce Vision-Language Reprojection Consistency (VLRC), a scalable auxiliary objective that exploits frozen vision-language representations as semantic multi-view supervision. Given a predicted 3D reconstruction, VLRC reprojects dense vision-language features across views and enforces feature consistency between corresponding image locations, requiring no additional 3D annotations. The objective integrates seamlessly with both self-supervised monocular reconstruction and supervised-pretrained feed-forward 3D models during unlabeled adaptation. By aligning geometry with language-grounded features, VLRC not only improves depth and camera estimation but also enables more coherent multi-view semantic fusion for open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding. Experiments on indoor and outdoor benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains in 3D reconstruction accuracy and zero-shot open-vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation.

title: Not All Refusals Are Equal: How Safety Alignment Fails Cybersecurity at Scale
comments: 14 pages, 11 figures. Under review at NeurIPS 2026
summary: There is no doubt that safety alignment is an essential step in LLM training. However, conceptually it does not distinguish between various domains and the level of potential harm of a query, which creates significant complications in the fields like cyber security, where a model should not be constrained by its safety circuits to accomplish the goals of legitimate, authorized operations. In this work, we share our findings from a large scale abliteration experiment on 24 open-source LLMs and show that domain-specific abliteration is achievable with standard methodology on the example of a 1T-parameter Kimi K2. Building on recent work showing that refusal in LLMs occupies a multi-dimensional subspace within layers, we find that it is also distributed widely across layers, especially in trillion-parameter MoE architectures, and so we aim to capture the part of it that represents harmful concepts in the cybersecurity domain exclusively. We also investigate the correlation between models' features and the effect of domain-specific abliteration, identifying that the type of safety training and architecture are the most reliable predictors. Finally, we classify the models into 3 abliteration susceptibility tiers and put forward a set of conjectures as to why a particular effect from this intervention might be observed in a given model.

title: Rank-Order N-of-M Codes for Sparse Distributed Memory: Disentangling Representation and Learning Effects in Noise Robustness Against Contemporary Neuromorphic Architectures
comments: 14 pages, 8 tables, 2 figures. Revisits rank-order sparse distributed memory for continual learning and memory-augmented AI. Includes comparisons with CALM and SpikingMamba, statistical evaluation, and real embedding experiments
summary: Large language models remain limited as continual learning systems, motivating renewed interest in Sparse Distributed Memory (SDM) as an explicit online episodic memory. CALM (Nechesov and Ruponen, 2025) identifies its threshold-binary encoder as an open design question. This paper evaluates rank-order N-of-M encoding (Furber et al., 2007) as an alternative. We make three contributions. First, a faithful reimplementation validates the published architecture by confirming exact equivalence between WheelSDM and RankOrderSDM (cosine similarity 1.0000 across 10 seeds) and reproducing the documented divergence of RDLIF neurons under interference. Second, multi-seed capacity experiments show RankOrderSDM outperforming StandardSDM by 13.4 percentage points at saturation in the scaled configuration and by 0.8 percentage points at the published architecture scale. Third, BER robustness experiments disentangle representation and learning effects, showing that the large robustness gain arises primarily from the interaction of rank-order encoding with MAX-Hebbian learning, while the encoder alone provides only a small advantage under matched learning conditions. Experiments on GloVe-100 embeddings confirm this small but consistent encoding benefit on real structured data, whereas sentence embeddings exhibit a ceiling effect at low memory load. A secondary analysis shows that idealized rank-order encoding requires half the component-level encoding energy of SpikingMamba's SI-LIF neurons at four-bit precision, although decoder costs dominate overall system energy. These results identify which components of the original rank-order SDM architecture provide measurable benefits for contemporary memory-augmented AI systems, offering practical guidance for architectures such as CALM.

title: CONFLUX: A Latent Diffusion Model for 3D Chest-CT Synthesis with RL Post-Training
summary: Controllable generative models of 3D medical images can synthesize volumes with specified clinical attributes, but this demands samples that are simultaneously high-fidelity, natively 3D, and faithful to the requested conditioning. We present CONFLUX, a latent diffusion model for chest computed tomography (CT): a 3D variational autoencoder compresses each volume, and a rectified-flow transformer generates in the latent space. Generation is conditioned on structured radiological metadata (18 abnormality findings, sex, age, and reconstruction kernel) through adaptive layer normalization. The model leads strong volumetric baselines on tri-planar Frechet distance (FID 32.3 vs. 74.6 for MAISI) while exposing direct control over clinical attributes. To strengthen that control we add an online reinforcement-learning post-training stage (group-relative policy optimization) that rewards how reliably a classifier recovers the requested findings from each generated volume. Judged by a separate, independent classifier, post-training removes 47% of the shortfall relative to real-scan reliability. We release the model and a ~200k synthetic chest-CT dataset with conditioning metadata spanning a wide variety of clinical findings.

title: $C^3$ASD: Multi-Level Consistency-Driven Representation Learning
summary: Active Speaker Detection determines whether a visible person in a video is speaking at each moment. While recent audio-visual fusion methods perform well on clean data, they degrade under real-world corruptions such as background noise, occlusion, or simultaneous modality degradation. We attribute this limitation to the absence of explicit consistency constraints that promote robust, semantically aligned representations across modalities. Without such guidance, models tend to learn fragile modality-specific shortcuts that fail under corrupted conditions. We propose $C^3$ASD, a multi-level consistency-driven framework with three complementary constraints: embedding-level inter-modality consistency aligns audio-visual representations during speech; sequence-level intra-modality consistency separates speaking and non-speaking clusters via track-aware contrastive learning; and prediction-level consistency stabilizes fusion through knowledge distillation. Extensive experiments demonstrate significant improvements under diverse audio, visual and joint corruptions, while maintaining competitive performance on clean data.

title: ACPO: Adaptive Credit Policy Optimization via Fine-Grained Surrogate Entropy
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has substantially improved the reasoning ability of large language models (LLMs), but sparse outcome rewards still make token-level credit assignment difficult. Existing scalable RL methods typically assign trajectory-level rewards uniformly across tokens, while recent entropy-aware approaches either rely on coarse detached heuristics or directly optimize true entropy, which can introduce non-local gradient components misaligned with sampled-token policy updates. We propose Adaptive Credit Policy Optimization (ACPO), a token-level credit assignment framework based on a mode-local surrogate entropy. ACPO asymmetrically modulates policy updates by emphasizing uncertain decisions in successful rollouts and overconfident tokens in failed rollouts. We show that the surrogate admits deterministic entropy bounds and, under modal alignment and proximal updates, preserves the policy-gradient direction to leading order. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and coding benchmarks, including AIME 2025 and HumanEvalPro, show that ACPO consistently improves over strong RL baselines such as DAPO, GTPO, and SAPO.
